### `datasets_google_map_facets`

Facet stored Google Maps businesses. Returns terms aggregation counts for Google Maps businesses. Facet enum: 'category', 'country', 'state', 'state_code', 'county', 'county_code', 'city', 'town', 'website_status'. Category facet values are exact locale-specific Google Maps labels and can be localized, non-ASCII, or contain punctuation; pass a returned value unchanged to the category filter. 'state' and 'county' keep each country's own administrative vocabulary (e.g. 'Provincia de Madrid', 'Département du Nord'); 'state_code' and 'county_code' are ISO 3166-2 codes populated today only for Canadian provinces and territories (e.g. 'CA-ON') and Irish counties (e.g. 'IE-D'); every other record, including all US rows, carries no code and is absent from the code facets.

### `datasets_google_map_item`

Get a stored Google Maps business. Returns one stored Google Maps business by Google place_id from dataset id enum value 'google-map-businesses'. The 'category' field contains the exact Google Maps category label returned for the business locale and can be localized, non-ASCII, or contain punctuation. A 'rating' of 'null' means no aggregate rating is available. A 'review_count' of 'null' means Google did not return a count; numeric '0' means Google confirmed zero reviews. Locationless service-area businesses (online/mobile/home-based) have a 'null' 'geo'. A 'permanently_closed' of 'true' means Google marks the business permanently closed; 'false' means a crawl confirmed it does not; 'null' means the business has not been status-checked since capture shipped on 2026-08-31 and is UNKNOWN, not open — so any total computed from this dataset includes an unknown number of closed businesses.

### `datasets_google_map_nearby`

Search nearby stored Google Maps businesses. Searches stored Google Maps businesses near a coordinate in dataset id enum value 'google-map-businesses'. 'category' is the exact Google Maps category label returned for the business locale; it can be localized, non-ASCII, or contain punctuation, so use the category facet to discover exact filter values. A 'rating' of 'null' means no aggregate rating is available. A 'review_count' of 'null' means Google did not return a count; numeric '0' means Google confirmed zero reviews. 'min_rating' above 0 excludes unrated businesses. Billing: this endpoint costs 1 credit per record returned, with a minimum of 2 (an empty result costs 2, a full page of 100 costs 100).

### `datasets_google_map_search`

Search stored Google Maps businesses. Searches Google Maps business records stored in a search index. Sort enum: 'relevance', 'updated_at_desc', 'rating_desc', 'review_count_desc', 'distance_asc'. 'category' is the exact Google Maps category label returned for the business locale; it can be localized, non-ASCII, or contain punctuation, so use the category facet to discover exact filter values. A 'rating' of 'null' means no aggregate rating is available. A 'review_count' of 'null' means Google did not return a count; numeric '0' means Google confirmed zero reviews. 'rating_desc' sorts unrated businesses last, and 'min_rating' above 0 excludes them. Use 'has_geo=false' to isolate locationless service-area businesses (which have a 'null' 'geo'). A 'permanently_closed' of 'true' means Google marks the business permanently closed; 'false' means a crawl confirmed it does not; 'null' means the business has not been status-checked since capture shipped on 2026-08-31 and is UNKNOWN, not open — so any total computed from this dataset includes an unknown number of closed businesses. Use 'permanently_closed=false' to exclude the confirmed-closed ones. Billing: this search costs 1 credit per record returned, with a minimum of 2 (an empty result costs 2, a full page of 100 costs 100).

Find postings near a coordinate. Finds crawled job postings within 'radius_km' of a 'lat'/'lon', nearest first. Only geocoded postings participate (the geo-enrich worker back-fills coordinates from each posting's location). Open roles only by default. provider enum: 'greenhouse', 'lever', 'ashby', 'workday', 'smartrecruiters', 'workable', 'recruitee', 'rippling', 'personio', 'teamtailor', 'oracle', 'ukg', 'icims', 'eightfold', 'gem', 'pinpoint', 'amazon-jobs', 'apple-jobs', 'google-jobs', 'meta-jobs', 'tesla-jobs'. ### `datasets_jobs_search`

Search the jobs dataset (all companies' live postings). Full-text + faceted search over every job posting crawled from every discovered company ATS board (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, SmartRecruiters, Workable, Recruitee, Rippling, Personio, Teamtailor, Oracle, UKG, iCIMS, Eightfold, Gem, Pinpoint) plus 5 single-company big-tech careers platforms (Amazon, Apple, Google, Meta, Tesla). Open roles only by default (set include_closed=true for historical/filled roles). Salary is parsed from a structured field when the provider has one, or from an explicit pay figure stated in the description otherwise, so coverage varies by posting rather than by provider; min_salary/max_salary filter on it and require salary_currency, since comparing raw compensation numbers across currencies is meaningless. Location is also exposed as structured city/state/country fields alongside the free-text location string, so city/state/country filter on an exact match of those parsed components rather than substring-matching the display string. job_family is an exact level-2 ISCO family label assigned from ESCO occupation evidence; ambiguous postings remain unclassified and do not match that filter. employment_type is never populated for google-jobs/meta-jobs, and posted_at (so sort=posted_desc) is never populated for meta-jobs/tesla-jobs -- their upstream APIs expose no such field. provider enum: 'greenhouse', 'lever', 'ashby', 'workday', 'smartrecruiters', 'workable', 'recruitee', 'rippling', 'personio', 'teamtailor', 'oracle', 'ukg', 'icims', 'eightfold', 'gem', 'pinpoint', 'amazon-jobs', 'apple-jobs', 'google-jobs', 'meta-jobs', 'tesla-jobs'. workplace_type enum: 'onsite', 'hybrid', 'remote'. sort enum: 'relevance', 'posted_desc', 'company_asc'. Billing: this search costs 1 credit per 10 records returned, rounded up, with a minimum of 1 (up to 10 records cost 1, a full page of 100 costs 10).

Every item carries a name, description, product-meta text when the upstream provides it (calorie counts on restaurant items, per-unit pricing like "380g · £15.79/kg" on grocery/shopping items), price, availability, and its resolved customization options (e.g. "Choose your meal", "Add ingredients?") with each option's own price and required/multi-select bounds.

Each result carries its uname (the value the restaurant and menu endpoints take), name, image, branch_type, and, when available, rating, delivery time, and distance. Optional collection, cuisine, dietary, dish, min_rating, max_delivery_minutes, max_delivery_fee_pounds, has_offer, deliveroos_choice, and sort parameters narrow and order the same feed -- call /deliveroo/search/filters for the current, complete, location-scoped list of every valid cuisine/dietary/dish value with live result counts. Get a Denver Post author archive. Returns a Denver Post author's profile and the articles on the first page of their archive. Give exactly one of 'slug' (for example 'aldo-svaldi') or 'url' (a denverpost.com/author/<slug>/ link). The profile has name, job title, bio, email and Twitter handle where the page shows them; each article has a title, URL, summary and publication time.

### `denverpost_headlines`

Get Denver Post section headlines. Returns current headlines for one Denver Post section or topic archive. 'section' is required and must be a slug from the sections endpoint, such as 'business', 'denver-broncos', 'colorado' or 'weather'; an invalid value returns an invalid-params error. Items carry title and URL, plus summary, author, publication time and image when the card shows them. Cards without a dated Denver Post article URL are skipped.

### `denverpost_news`

Get Denver Post top stories. Returns the article cards on the Denver Post homepage, about 91 when last checked, though the count varies as the site updates. Each item has a title and URL and can carry a summary, author, publication time, image and 'type'. It takes no parameters.

### `denverpost_sections`

Get Denver Post section and topic inventory. Lists the Denver Post slugs that the headlines endpoint accepts: 56 editorial sections and 19 topic archives, checked on 2026-09-30. Examples are 'colorado', 'denver-broncos', 'economy' and 'hiking'. Each entry has a 'slug', 'name' and 'url'. Branded content and cartoons are left out.

### `depop_brands`

Depop's full brand directory. Returns Depop's full brand directory (id, name, slug), not just brands with active listings for a given search -- resolves the search endpoint's otherwise-opaque brand_ids filter to human-readable names. Public data sourced from Depop's own brand-directory API.

### `depop_categories`

Get Depop's category taxonomy. Returns Depop's full department, category, and subcategory taxonomy -- every value usable with /depop/search's and /depop/shop/{username}'s category/subcategory filters. Tries a live refresh from Depop's own category-filter API first and falls back to a static snapshot on any failure, so this never errors.

### `depop_item`

Get Depop item detail. Returns a Depop item-detail page: description, all photos, price, condition, brand, size, seller info, and a "similar items" carousel when the page has one.

### `depop_item_similar`

Get Depop items similar to a listing. Returns items similar to a given Depop listing, via Depop's dedicated similar-items API -- richer and paginated (up to 150 per page) compared to the small, non-paginated "similar items" carousel already included in item detail. Public data sourced from Depop's own similar-items API.

### `depop_search`

Search Depop listings. Searches Depop's resale-fashion marketplace by free-text keyword, with optional price, condition, colour, category, subcategory, gender, kids-department, brand, discount, and sort filters, returning listing summaries (title, price, brand, condition, like count, photos, sizes), a pagination cursor, and the total matching count.

### `depop_search_facets`

Depop search result-count breakdowns. Returns result-count breakdowns per department/category/subcategory for a search query, via Depop's dedicated aggregates API -- a distinct upstream call from search itself, not embedded in its response. Public data sourced from Depop's own search-aggregates API.

### `depop_search_sellers`

Search Depop sellers by name. Finds Depop users/sellers by name or username. A matched result's username can be passed directly to GET /depop/shop/{username} for that seller's full shop. Public data sourced from Depop's own user-search API.

### `depop_shop`

Get a Depop seller's shop. Returns a Depop seller's public shop: profile (rating, sold count, followers, bio) plus current listings, with optional price, condition, colour, category, subcategory, gender, discount, and sort filters. Public data sourced from Depop's own shop pages.

### `depop_sizes`

Get Depop's size taxonomy. Returns Depop's full, multi-region size taxonomy -- every composite id usable with /depop/search's and /depop/shop/{username}'s sizes filter. Public data sourced from Depop's own size-filter API.

### `depop_suggest`

Depop search-box autocomplete. Returns Depop's own search-box autocomplete suggestions for a partial query, including the category a suggestion maps to when relevant. Public data sourced from Depop's own search-suggestions API.

### `developer_search`

Search indexed developer documentation. Searches indexed sources only; this operation never starts ingestion or contacts upstream sources. The current ready source is 'go:docs' and it covers only the 18 selected verified pages documented by 'developer-sources'. Search matches Unicode-aware lexical terms and punctuation-bearing identifiers such as 'context.Context'; passages retain byte/line locators into the indexed document. 'types' accepts 'doc', 'readme', 'issue', and 'pull_request', but the current source supports only 'doc'; unsupported values return 400. The 'version' filter is not supported by the current unversioned source and returns 400. Continuation bodies contain only 'cursor' and optional 'limit'; their pages come from the frozen snapshot and do not repeat the search.

### `developer_sources`

Discover indexed developer sources. Returns the registered developer source catalog and each source's exact supported operations, filters, artifact types, and index state. The current catalog contains only 'go:docs', a selected set of 18 parser-verified Go documentation/specification pages. A source is 'not_indexed' until a complete generation is promoted. The catalog does not accept a cursor; 'limit' may be 1–100.

### `discogs_artist`

Get a Discogs artist profile. Returns a Discogs artist profile: real name, bio, links, name variations, aliases, and group memberships.

### `discogs_artist_releases`

List a Discogs artist's releases. Returns the releases and masters credited to a Discogs artist, identified by the required 'id'. Paged with 'page' (default 1) and 'per_page' (default 50, max 100). Each entry has its 'id', 'type' ('release' or 'master'), title, artist, role, format, label, year, thumbnail, and want and collection counts, alongside the total item count and page count.

### `discogs_label`

Get a Discogs label profile. Returns the profile of a Discogs label by its required label 'id': name, profile text, contact info, website URLs, images, data quality rating, and Discogs page URI. The parent label and the list of sub-labels are included, and the parent label appears only when the label has one.

### `discogs_label_releases`

List a Discogs label's releases. Lists the releases on a Discogs label, identified by the required label 'id'. Paged with 'page' (default 1) and 'per_page' (default 50, max 100). Each entry has its release 'id', title, artist, format, catalogue number ('catno'), status, year and thumbnail, and the response reports the total item count across all pages.

### `discogs_master`

Get a Discogs master release. Returns a Discogs master release: the version-agnostic grouping of a release across pressings/reissues (artists, tracklist, genres/styles, videos, images, marketplace stats).

### `discogs_release`

Get a Discogs release. Returns a Discogs release: artists, labels, formats, tracklist, credits, identifiers, videos, images, and community want/have/rating.

### `discogs_search`

Search the Discogs database. Searches the Discogs database for releases, masters, artists and labels, optionally filtered to one 'type', with 'page' and 'per_page' (max 100). Release and master results carry country, year, formats, labels, genres, styles, catalog number and barcodes; artist and label results carry id, title and thumbnail.

### `dominos_coupons`

Get one Domino's store's available coupons and deals. Returns one Domino's US store's available coupons and deals: standalone coupons (code, name, description, price, valid service methods, and any alternate promo/marketing codes that resolve to the same coupon), plus tiered volume-discount coupon groups (e.g. "order 7+ pizzas, get 15% off"). Reads the same structured menu response as GET /dominos/menu, so it costs no additional upstream request. A store can genuinely have zero active coupons -- an empty list is not an error. Store ids come from GET /dominos/store-locator. An unknown store id returns 404.

### `dominos_customization`

Get one Domino's store's full build-your-own customization catalog. Returns one Domino's US store's full build-your-own customization catalog, grouped by product category (Domino's own names, e.g. "BuildYourOwnDomino" for pizza, "GSalad" for garden salads): every selectable size, crust/flavor style, topping, and side, each with its own code, name, description, dietary/placement flags (e.g. Meat, Vege, Sauce, WholeOnly), and any other attributes Domino's attaches (e.g. ExclusiveGroup for mutually-exclusive options). Also returns cooking instructions (bake level, cut style, seasoning), grouped. Store ids come from GET /dominos/store-locator. An unknown store id returns 404.

### `dominos_menu`

Get one Domino's store's full structured menu. Returns one Domino's US store's full menu, as a flat list of categories (each with a stable code/name path, e.g. "Pizza > Specialty Pizzas") and their items. Each item carries its code, name, description, and product type, plus every purchasable variant (size/style) with its own code, name, and price. Store ids come from GET /dominos/store-locator. An unknown store id returns 404.

### `dominos_nutrition`

Get calorie information for one Domino's product configuration. Returns calorie information (Domino's own "Cal-O-Meter" data) for one product at one store. For a named/fixed menu item (a specialty pizza, bread, wing, pasta, sandwich, salad, drink, or dessert -- any item code from GET /dominos/menu), give only store_id and product_code; the item's default configuration is used. For a build-your-own pizza, also give size, base, and any topping codes -- calories are computed for that exact configuration, matching Domino's own live calculator. size and base must be given together; toppings requires both. Reads live, not from a cache -- each call creates and discards one anonymous cart server-side, so it is slower than this family's other endpoints. An unknown product code, or an invalid size/base/topping combination, returns an error.

### `dominos_store`

Get one Domino's store's full profile record. Returns one Domino's US store's full profile -- richer than /dominos/store-locator's per-store summary. Includes the store's complete weekly hours (general hours and each service method's own hours, Monday-first, with every open/close window per day), Domino's own free-text hours summary per service method, per-service-method estimated wait windows, open/online status, per-service-method order availability (delivery, carryout, drive-up carryout, dine-in), contactless option status, and delivery/carryout order minimums. Store ids come from GET /dominos/store-locator. An unknown store id returns 404.

### `dominos_store_locator`

Find Domino's stores near an address, city/state, or ZIP code. Returns Domino's US stores that can serve a location: store id, address with coordinates, phone, open/online status, per-service-method availability (delivery, carryout, drive-up carryout), contactless option status, Domino's own hours summary per service method, and estimated wait windows. At least one of postal_code, or both city and state, is required; address is an optional street line that improves precision when combined with city/state. The response's query field echoes how Domino's own address resolver actually interpreted the input, including its granularity (e.g. resolved to a specific street range vs. only a city/region).

### `doordash_explore`

Get DoorDash nearby stores explore feed. Returns DoorDash's location-based "nearby stores" browse feed from the Android mobile guest experience. Unlike search or autocomplete, no search query is required. No DoorDash account or caller-supplied token is required.

### `doordash_feed`

Get DoorDash store discovery feed. Returns nearby stores for a location from the Android mobile guest experience: store ID, name, cover image and tags, plus rating, price range, delivery fee and ETA when the upstream feed surface reports them. Those metric fields are omitted rather than estimated when it does not, so treat their absence as "not reported". No DoorDash account or caller-supplied token is required.

### `doordash_search`

Search DoorDash pickup restaurants. Searches the Android mobile guest catalog for pickup restaurants near a location and supports optional result filters. No DoorDash account or caller-supplied token is required.

### `doordash_search_autocomplete`

Get DoorDash pickup search suggestions. Returns pickup restaurant matches from the Android mobile guest search experience near a location. No DoorDash account or caller-supplied token is required.

### `doordash_search_filters`

Get DoorDash search filter options. Returns the cuisines and filter values supported by the Android mobile guest search experience for a location. No DoorDash account or caller-supplied token is required.

### `doordash_search_items`

Search DoorDash dishes and items. Searches menu items across nearby merchants from the Android mobile guest experience. Nearby candidate stores are selected first, then their menus are read and every item whose name or description matches the query is returned with its parent store. At most five proximity-ranked stores are inspected per request, and a store whose menu cannot be read is skipped, so results are best-effort across that candidate set. An empty result array means no candidate store menu matched, not that no nearby merchant sells the item. No DoorDash account or caller-supplied token is required.

### `doordash_store`

Get a DoorDash store. Returns public metadata for a DoorDash store by its numeric 'store_id', as seen from the delivery location given by the required 'latitude' and 'longitude'. The response has the name, URL, images, average rating, rating count, and menu section and item counts. Address, coordinates and price range appear only when DoorDash supplies them. Missing or out-of-range coordinates return '400'.

### `doordash_store_fulfillment`

Get DoorDash store fulfillment details. Returns store fulfillment methods, delivery fee info, and scheduling details from the Android mobile guest experience. No DoorDash account or caller-supplied token is required.

### `doordash_store_info`

Get DoorDash store contact info. Returns a lightweight store info card (map coordinates, address, phone number) from the Android mobile guest experience. This is a distinct upstream contract from the full store endpoint and reliably includes address and coordinates. No DoorDash account or caller-supplied token is required.

### `doordash_store_item`

Get DoorDash menu item details. Returns details for a specific menu item from the Android mobile guest experience. The item is matched by name, case-insensitively, against the store menu: DoorDash's anonymous menu surface exposes no stable per-item identifier, so use a name returned by the store menu or item search. A name that is not on the menu returns 404; no substitute item is returned. No DoorDash account or caller-supplied token is required.

### `doordash_store_menu`

Get a DoorDash store menu. Returns the location-aware DoorDash mobile menu, grouped into sections with item names, descriptions, and displayed prices. No DoorDash account or caller-supplied token is required.

### `doordash_store_reviews`

Get DoorDash store reviews. Returns store ratings and customer reviews from the Android mobile guest experience for a location. No DoorDash account or caller-supplied token is required.

### `draftkings_casino_cleopatra_guide`

DraftKings Cleopatra slot guide. Returns written gameplay sections from DraftKings Casino's public Cleopatra tutorial. The image-only payout table and promotional recommendation/CTA sections are omitted. This is informational page content, not wagering advice.

### `draftkings_casino_directory`

DraftKings Casino slots directory. Returns the public Online Slots and How to Play Slots links from the DraftKings Casino homepage. Fetch the guide sections with draftkings_casino_slots_guide. It does not fetch game catalogs, promotions, winners, jackpots, or account data.

### `draftkings_casino_slots_categories`

DraftKings Casino slot categories. Lists public slot-category sections from the logged-out Casino configuration. It returns category labels and upstream IDs only; it does not return game listings, winners, jackpots, promotions, personal data, or jurisdiction eligibility.

### `draftkings_casino_slots_guide`

DraftKings Casino slots guide. Returns the public slots guide's basic rules and responsible-play sections. Account setup, payments, promotions, and strategy sections are omitted. This is informational page content, not gambling advice.

### `draftkings_casino_wheel_of_fortune_guide`

DraftKings Wheel of Fortune slot guide. Returns written gameplay instructions from DraftKings Casino's public Wheel of Fortune: Triple Extreme Spin tutorial. The video embed, demo-mode call to action, and jurisdiction-specific footer are omitted. This is informational content, not wagering advice.

### `draftkings_dfs_glossary`

DraftKings Daily Fantasy glossary. Returns the public Daily Fantasy glossary terms and definitions from DraftKings' How to Play page. It does not access the contest lobby, player pool, or account data.

### `draftkings_dfs_guide`

DraftKings Daily Fantasy guide. Returns public contest-type summaries and sport landing-page links from DraftKings' Daily Fantasy Sports guide. Use draftkings_dfs_glossary for the page's public terminology definitions. This is a read-only guide directory; it does not access contests, lineups, player pools, or accounts. Availability and age limits vary by location.

### `draftkings_dfs_nfl_best_ball_featured_contests`

DraftKings NFL Best Ball featured contests. Lists the contest cards currently shown in DraftKings' public NFL Best Ball Featured Contests section, including displayed entry-fee and top-prize amounts and maximum entries. This is the landing-page selection, not the full contest lobby or a guarantee that a contest remains open. It does not follow tournament-detail links or return promotions, entries, lineups, or account data.

### `draftkings_dfs_rules_and_scoring`

DraftKings DFS Rules & Scoring. Returns the public Daily Fantasy rules and scoring overview plus visible sports and contest-style rules. Each rule includes upstream game-type IDs and sanitized scoring content. Hidden records, including XFL rules, are omitted; contests, players, prizes, lineups, and account data are not returned.

### `draftkings_dfs_sports`

DraftKings Daily Fantasy sports catalog. Returns the public US-DK sport catalog with exact sport codes and DraftKings' enabled/public-contests flags. The flags describe the source catalog, not caller-specific location eligibility. This endpoint does not access contests, lineups, prizes, or account data.

### `draftkings_event`

DraftKings Sportsbook event. Returns one event's metadata (league id, sport id, teams, status, start time). 'event_id' is a numeric DraftKings event identifier (find it from an event's DraftKings Sportsbook page, or from the 'id' field of an event returned by /draftkings/sportsbook/odds). The returned 'league_id' is accepted by /draftkings/sportsbook/odds and /draftkings/sportsbook/futures. This endpoint does not include betting markets/odds.

### `draftkings_event_context`

DraftKings Sportsbook event context. Returns public sport, league, and event navigation identifiers for a numeric DraftKings event id. Use it to associate an event with DraftKings Sportsbook's public sport and league navigation.

### `draftkings_event_markets`

DraftKings Sportsbook event markets. Returns one event's betting markets and selections for a specific market category. 'event_id' is a numeric DraftKings event identifier (find it from the 'id' field of an event returned by /draftkings/sportsbook/odds). 'subcategory_id' selects the market category (e.g. game lines, a player-prop category, an alternate-line category) -- find one from the 'subcategory_id' field on a market returned by /draftkings/sportsbook/odds. An empty 'markets' list is a valid response when the category has no markets currently posted for this event.

### `draftkings_featured_leagues`

DraftKings Sportsbook featured leagues. Returns public DraftKings Sportsbook leagues currently marked as featured in its sport navigation. Each item includes its numeric 'id', capability 'tags', live-offer status, and upstream featured ordering. Use the 'id' as 'league_id' with /draftkings/sportsbook/odds and /draftkings/sportsbook/futures.

### `draftkings_futures`

DraftKings Sportsbook futures. Returns league-level futures markets and selections for a specific DraftKings market category. 'league_id' is a numeric DraftKings league identifier and 'subcategory_id' is a numeric futures category identifier. An empty 'events' list is a valid response when the category has no markets currently posted for that league.

### `draftkings_league_events`

DraftKings Sportsbook league event directory. Returns a DraftKings Sportsbook league's current public event directory, including event IDs, teams or other participants, start times, status, and public availability tags. Supply a numeric 'league_id' from /draftkings/sportsbook/leagues, /draftkings/sportsbook/quick-links, /draftkings/sportsbook/featured-leagues, or /draftkings/sportsbook/event. This endpoint does not include betting markets or odds.

### `draftkings_leagues`

DraftKings Sportsbook sports and leagues. Returns DraftKings Sportsbook's current public sport and league directory. Each league 'id' is accepted as 'league_id' by /draftkings/sportsbook/odds and /draftkings/sportsbook/futures.

### `draftkings_live`

DraftKings Sportsbook live events. Returns the live events currently shown by DraftKings Sportsbook, including score state, period, primary markets, and market categories that can be used with /draftkings/sportsbook/event-markets. An empty 'events' list is valid when DraftKings has no live events at request time.

### `draftkings_odds`

DraftKings Sportsbook odds. Returns the primary betting markets (moneyline, spread, total) for every upcoming event in a DraftKings Sportsbook league. 'league_id' is a numeric DraftKings league identifier (find it from a league's DraftKings Sportsbook page). An empty 'events' list is a valid response when nothing is currently scheduled.

### `draftkings_pick6_rule_page`

DraftKings Pick6 sport-specific rules. Returns public scoring and rule sections for one supported Pick6 sport/format page. Discover supported slugs with draftkings_pick6_rules. This endpoint does not return player picks, projections, user entries, or location tokens.

### `draftkings_pick6_rules`

DraftKings Pick6 rules. Returns public rule sections from the DraftKings Pick6 Rules and Scoring page plus child pages with verified detail routes. Unverified upstream links are omitted from the slug directory. It does not return player picks, projections, user entries, or location tokens.

### `draftkings_pick6_sports`

DraftKings Pick6 sport directory. Returns the dated public Help Center snapshot of Pick6 sports and contest formats, with exact sport codes and links published by the Help Center, plus the CFB/CBB jurisdiction restriction. Product-page reachability is not verified. This directory does not return picks or projections and does not imply availability in the caller's location.

### `draftkings_predictions_availability`

DraftKings Predictions availability map. Returns the 52 region/status mappings shown on DraftKings Predictions' public availability map. Allowed 'status' values: 'all_markets_available', 'financial_markets_only', 'sports_markets_unavailable', 'no_markets_available'. This source map is not a complete legal eligibility matrix and does not separately classify all territories or tribal land. It does not read caller location or trading/account state.

### `draftkings_predictions_categories`

DraftKings Predictions categories. Returns the public category and league navigation from the DraftKings Predictions homepage. It excludes market quotes, trade-slip selections, accounts, balances, promotions, and location data. Market availability varies by location and time; this endpoint is a navigation directory, not trading advice.

### `draftkings_predictions_rules`

DraftKings Predictions rules and settlement sources. Lists public rulebook and settlement-source links from the DraftKings Predictions Rules and Settlements page. It does not fetch market data, quotes, trades, user state, or location context.

### `draftkings_quick_links`

DraftKings Sportsbook quick links. Returns the ordered league shortcuts currently prioritized on DraftKings Sportsbook's public home page. Each item includes a numeric 'league_id' accepted by /draftkings/sportsbook/odds and /draftkings/sportsbook/futures.

### `draftkings_racing_race_info`

DraftKings Racing race card and results. Returns public race-card details for one race ID from DraftKings Racing, including entries, horse identifiers, morning-line and live odds, and finish positions when posted. It excludes pools, probable payouts, bet-form IDs, real-time WebSocket requests, favorites, and participant personal names.

### `draftkings_racing_schedule`

DraftKings Racing schedule. Returns public race-card metadata from the DraftKings Racing homepage, including track, race number, scheduled post time, and status. Favorite-track and wager data are excluded.

### `draftkings_racing_tracks`

DraftKings Racing tracks. Returns the public All Tracks directory with track type, status, schedule count, and country metadata. Favorite IDs, runner details, and wagering controls are excluded.

### `draftkings_team`

DraftKings Sportsbook team. Returns stable team metadata embedded in a public DraftKings Sportsbook team page. Supply 'team_id', 'sport', and 'slug' from an item returned by /draftkings/sportsbook/teams. Allowed 'sport' values: 'football', 'hockey', 'basketball', 'baseball'.

### `draftkings_teams`

DraftKings Sportsbook league teams. Returns the teams listed on DraftKings Sportsbook's public Teams page for one league. Allowed 'league' values: 'nfl', 'nhl', 'nba', 'cbb', 'mlb', 'cfb'.

### `dramabox_browse`

Browse DramaBox short dramas by genre. Returns one page of 12 DramaBox short dramas, optionally within one genre: id, title, description, cover, link, episode count, tags, genres, rating, update status and displayed views, with the page and total page count. Genre ids come from dramabox-genres. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

### `dramabox_categories`

List DramaBox category filters. Returns the DramaBox app's category navigation as six groups: language, production type, dub mode, two genre rows (genre_1 and genre_2) and sort order. Each group lists the selectable options as display names and the values to pass to dramabox-category-books. The "All" pseudo-option is dropped because omitting a filter means all. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

### `dramabox_category_books`

Browse DramaBox titles by category. Returns one page of 20 DramaBox short dramas from the app's category feed, optionally filtered by values from dramabox-categories: language, production type, dub mode, either genre row and sort order. Filters are ANDed; an omitted filter means all. Each title carries its id, title, description, cover, website link, episode count, tags with tag ids, protagonist, play count, library flag and listing times. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

### `dramabox_channels`

List DramaBox theater channels. Returns the 8 DramaBox app theater channels as ids and names: Popular, New, Rankings, Categories, Anime, Live-Action, VIP and Original+. The channel value for dramabox-theater is the lowercase name (popular, new, rankings, categories, anime, live-action, vip, original). Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

### `dramabox_drama`

Get a DramaBox short drama and its episodes. Returns one DramaBox short drama: title, description, cover, link, language, episode count, lifetime views, follows, tags, genres, listing times, the languages it is available in, the episode list with each episode's number, id, duration, free flag and thumbnail, and related titles. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

### `dramabox_genres`

List DramaBox genres. Returns the genres DramaBox's browse accepts (Romance, Werewolves, Revenge, Billionaire, ...) as ids and names, read live from DramaBox. Pass a genre id to dramabox-browse. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

### `dramabox_home`

List DramaBox's featured titles and shelves. Returns DramaBox's (dramabox.com) home page: the featured short dramas and the three curated shelves (Trending, Must-sees, Hidden gems), each title with its id, title, description, cover, DramaBox link, episode count, tags, genres and the view count as the site prints it. Use dramabox-more for a whole shelf. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

### `dramabox_more`

Get a whole DramaBox curated shelf. Returns one page of 18 titles from a DramaBox curated shelf (trending, must-sees or hidden-gems): id, title, description, cover, link, episode count, tags, genres and displayed views, with the page and total page count. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

### `dramabox_performer`

Get a DramaBox performer and their titles. Returns one DramaBox performer from the Android app API: name, gender, avatar, video count, follow flag, and one page of the titles they appear in (each with id, title, description, cover, website link, episode count, tags with their tag ids, protagonist, library flag and listing times). Get performer ids from dramabox-search or dramabox-suggest's people results. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

### `dramabox_rank`

Get a DramaBox ranking list. Returns one DramaBox ranking list from the DramaBox Android app API: the available tabs (Most Trending, Top Searched, New Releases) and 20 ranked titles, each with its id, title, description, cover, website link, episode count, tags, protagonist, rank position, hot metric, library flag and listing times. Pass a tab's type as rank_type to read that tab. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

### `dramabox_recommend`

Get a page of DramaBox's recommendation feed. Returns one page of DramaBox's own "You Might Like" recommendation feed from the Android app API: the feed title and its titles, each with id, title, description, cover, website link, episode count, tags with their tag ids, protagonist, library flag and listing times. The upstream page size is fixed, so page is the only paging control. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

### `dramabox_search`

Search DramaBox titles and performers. Searches the DramaBox Android app API and returns one page of mixed results: book rows (id, title, description, cover, website link, tags, protagonist) and performer rows (id, name, avatar, series count), plus an is_more flag for the next page. The keyword is trimmed and truncated to 80 characters like the app; sort selects one of the app's result orderings. Performer ids can be passed to dramabox-performer. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

### `dramabox_suggest`

Get DramaBox search-box suggestions. Returns the DramaBox Android app API's autocomplete suggestions for a partial query: book rows (kind "book", cover_url) and performer rows (kind "actor", avatar, series count). The keyword is trimmed and truncated to 80 characters like the app; a query with no match returns an empty items list. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

### `dramabox_tag`

List the DramaBox titles carrying a tag. Returns one page of DramaBox titles carrying a tag, as the Android app shows them: each title's id, title, description, cover, website link, episode count, tags with their tag ids, protagonist, library flag and listing times, plus the tag's own name. Get tag ids from any title result's tag_refs (dramabox-rank, dramabox-search, dramabox-category-books and the other list endpoints all expose them). An unknown tag id returns an empty list rather than an error. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

### `dramabox_theater`

Get a DramaBox theater channel feed. Returns one page of a DramaBox app theater channel: the channel, its titled shelves (each with styles and 10 to 20 titles), poster banners and search hot words. Each title carries its id, title, description, cover, website link, episode count, tags with tag ids, protagonist, play count, library flag and listing times. Channel values are the lowercase names from dramabox-channels. An empty feed is a valid answer. Only public catalog metadata and poster images are read; no playable video is returned.

### `dramabox_trending`

Get DramaBox's search landing feeds. Returns the DramaBox Android app API's search landing page: the hot, trending and new-release title lists, the ranking tabs (pass a tab's type to dramabox-rank as rank_type) and the app's preset search keyword. Takes no parameters. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

### `duckduckgo_image`

Search DuckDuckGo image results. Returns DuckDuckGo image results for a query string: title, source page URL, image URL, thumbnail, dimensions, and hostname, plus page-based pagination.

### `duckduckgo_news`

Search DuckDuckGo news results. Returns DuckDuckGo news results for a query string: title, destination URL, source, excerpt, thumbnail, and relative/published time, plus page-based pagination.

### `duckduckgo_search`

Search DuckDuckGo web results. Returns DuckDuckGo web search results for a query string: title, destination URL, description, and hostname, plus page-based pagination. DuckDuckGo wraps every result link in its own click-tracking redirect; this endpoint always returns the decoded destination URL, never the raw redirect link.

### `duckduckgo_shopping`

Search DuckDuckGo shopping results. Returns DuckDuckGo shopping results for a query string: title, brand, merchant, description, price, rating, and review count, plus total page count. DuckDuckGo's shopping vertical is ad-funded, syndicated product listings, not organic content; every product link is wrapped in an ad-click-tracking redirect with no clean destination to unwrap, so no destination URL is returned. DuckDuckGo's own pagination token for this vertical is an opaque per-response blob rather than a plain page offset, so only the first page is supported.

### `duckduckgo_suggest`

Suggest DuckDuckGo search queries. Returns DuckDuckGo search-box autocomplete completions for a query prefix, in DuckDuckGo's own ranking order. DuckDuckGo never returns more than 8 suggestions per prefix.

### `duckduckgo_video`

Search DuckDuckGo video results. Returns DuckDuckGo video results for a query string: title, destination URL, description, duration, thumbnail, publisher/uploader, published time, and view count, plus page-based pagination.

### `dunkin_directory`

Browse the Dunkin store directory. Returns one level of Dunkin's store directory tree. Omit path for the root, which lists every US state Dunkin operates in; pass a state's path (e.g. "ny") to list its cities, or a state/city path (e.g. "ny/new-york") to list its stores. Each child carries its name, path, URL and how many stores sit under that branch. A child with is_store true is a store rather than another directory level -- pass its path (a store id) to GET /dunkin/store. This is a directory browse, not a proximity search: use GET /dunkin/nearby for a radius lookup.

### `dunkin_menu`

Get Dunkin's national menu. Returns Dunkin's national menu: item names, descriptions and photos grouped into categories (Iced Drinks, Hot Drinks, Frozen Drinks, Sandwiches & Wraps, Savory Bites, Donuts & Bakery, Snacks and Sides). Dunkin publishes one shared menu across every US store, so this takes no store parameter. Does not carry prices or nutrition -- pricing varies by market/franchisee and isn't part of this content.

### `dunkin_nearby`

Find Dunkin stores near a coordinate, nearest first. Returns Dunkin restaurants within a radius of a latitude/longitude, ordered nearest first, each with its distance in miles and kilometres, full address, phone, coordinates, the published week of hours, whether it's permanently closed, amenities, payment methods, pickup/delivery service types, which third-party delivery platforms are active, its Google Place id, timezone, and website/menu/order URLs. This is the proximity search the directory browse cannot do -- GET /dunkin/directory walks a state to city to store tree, which requires knowing the administrative path in advance. Each result carries the store id as 'path', which GET /dunkin/store also takes, so the two chain directly. 'total_in_radius' reports how many stores fall inside the radius overall, which is usually far more than one page; use 'offset' to walk it. A coordinate with no Dunkin nearby returns an empty list rather than an error.

### `dunkin_store`

Get one Dunkin store's detail. Returns one Dunkin store: name, full postal address, phone, coordinates, opening hours for every day of the week, whether it's permanently closed, amenities (curbside pickup, drive-thru, wifi, kosher, turbo oven, K-Cup pods), Dunkin's own free-text feature labels, accepted payment methods, pickup/delivery service types, which third-party delivery platforms are active, the Google Place id, and the store's website/menu/order URLs. path is a store id -- from a /dunkin/directory child with is_store true, a /dunkin/nearby result's path, or the trailing digits of a dunkindonuts.com store URL. An unknown id returns a 404.

### `dw_article`

Get DW article content. Returns one Deutsche Welle article by its canonical 'url', either a standard '/en/<slug>/a-<id>' article or a '/en/<slug>/live-<id>' live-blog page. The response has the title, description, publish time, section, authors, lead image and body 'paragraphs'. Blocked or malformed pages return an upstream error.

### `dw_author`

Get a DW author profile. Returns one Deutsche Welle correspondent's public profile (name, expertise, biography) and their recent articles from a canonical person-profile URL. Many DW breaking-news items are bylined to the "Deutsche Welle" editorial organization rather than a named person; those articles have no person-profile URL to look up.

### `dw_headlines`

Get DW section headlines. Returns the latest Deutsche Welle headlines for one section. 'section' is required and takes one of 18 slugs, such as 'africa', 'middle-east', 'germany', 'climate', 'migration', 'human-rights', 'business' or 'sports'. Each item has its title and URL, plus an image when the card shows one.

### `dw_news`

Get DW top stories. Returns the current Deutsche Welle top stories. Each item has its title, URL, summary and publication time. Takes no parameters; use 'dw-headlines' for a single region, topic or category.

### `dw_sections`

Get DW sections. Lists the DW English-edition sections accepted by 'dw-headlines', grouped under the site's three navigation groups: regions, topics and categories. Each entry has a stable 'slug', display 'name' and the section 'url'. Takes no parameters.

### `ebay_item`

Get eBay item details. Returns the details of one eBay listing by 'item_id': title, link, images, price and price text, condition, availability, item specifics, description, location and shipping. It also carries the seller's name, store, feedback score, followers and items sold, along with the listing's rating and rating count.

### `ebay_live_stream`

Get an eBay Live stream. Returns one eBay Live stream or event by 'id', taken from the 'streams[].id' of the stream list. The response has title, description, state, start and end times, viewer, watch and like counts, tags, channels and the live, preview and replay URLs. Each host carries a 365-day feedback summary and four average ratings. An unknown id returns '404'.

### `ebay_live_stream_items`

List an eBay Live stream's featured items. Lists the items currently featured in an eBay Live stream, identified by the required event 'id'. Each item has its listing id, title, price and currency, bid count, sale type, leader and winner usernames, and 'auction_status' ('READY', 'LIVE' or 'ENDED'). A stream with no featured items, or an unknown id, returns an empty 'items' array.

### `ebay_live_streams`

List eBay Live streams. Lists live and upcoming eBay Live streams for one category channel, set with 'category' (default 'explore'; other values are channel ids such as 'IPqZx79LNuwFcSVt' for Sports Singles). Each stream has its title, state, start time, watch count, hosts, tags and preview media. Host feedback is not included. Page on with 'next_request_number' and 'session_id', passed back as 'request_number' and 'session_id'.

### `ebay_live_streams_batch`

Get multiple eBay Live streams. Returns summaries for several eBay Live streams in one call. 'ids' is required and takes up to 9 stream ids, comma-separated or repeated. Each stream has its title, state, watch count, hosts, tags and preview media, without the per-host feedback summary. Ids that do not resolve are silently omitted, and the order may differ from the request.

### `ebay_search`

Search eBay listings. Searches eBay listings by keyword from a JSON body, with page, page size (60, 120 or 240) and a listing-status filter ('active', 'sold', 'completed' or 'sold_completed'). Each result has the item id, title, link, image, price or price range, bid count, seller and rating, location, shipping information, and sold and watcher counts.

### `ebay_seller`

Get eBay seller profile. Returns the public profile of an eBay seller by the required 'seller' username: display name, store name and URL, profile URL, description, location, member-since date, positive feedback percentage, feedback count, items sold, followers, and detailed seller ratings. Feedback details are included when eBay provides them.

### `ebay_seller_about`

Get eBay seller about details. Returns seller about information from the eBay store about tab, including seller stats, top-rated status, optional location/member-since fields, and cleaned store categories.

### `ebay_seller_feedback`

Get eBay seller feedback. Returns the feedback eBay shows for a seller, identified by the required 'seller' username. The response has the total feedback count, positive feedback percentage, overall rating summary, detailed seller ratings, and review cards with buyer, comment, rating, period and verified-purchase flag. Page with 'page' (default 1) and 'per_page' (24, 48 or 72; default 48), using 'has_more' and 'next_page'.

### `ebay_seller_shop`

Get eBay seller shop listings. Lists the items in an eBay seller's shop, identified by the required 'seller' username, one page at a time with 'page' (default 1). Each result has its item id, title, link, image, price or price range, shipping note, location, bid count and watcher count. The response gives the 'total' and a 'has_more' flag.

### `economictimes_article`

Get Economic Times article content. Returns public Economic Times article metadata (title, author(s), published/updated dates, section, lead image) and body paragraphs from a canonical article URL. An ETPrime subscription-gated story returns a permission error instead of a truncated or fabricated body.

### `economictimes_author`

Get an Economic Times author profile. Returns an Economic Times reporter profile for a 'url' like 'https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/etreporter/author-<name>-<id>.cms'. The response has the name, job title (role and desk in one string), biography, headshot and recent articles with title and URL. Job title, biography and image may be empty; no email field exists.

### `economictimes_headlines`

Get The Economic Times section headlines. Returns the latest Economic Times headlines for one section. 'section' is required and takes a slug such as 'top-stories', 'markets-stocks', 'mf-mf-news', 'industry-banking-finance', 'jobs-fresher' or 'news-india'. Each item has its title, URL, summary, publication time and image.

### `economictimes_news`

Get The Economic Times top stories. Returns the current Economic Times top stories. Each item has its title, URL and publication time, plus a summary for some stories. Takes no parameters; use 'economictimes-headlines' for a single section.

### `economictimes_sections`

Get The Economic Times sections. Returns the complete public section inventory accepted by /api/v1/economictimes/headlines: business/markets verticals, industry, tech, wealth, mutual funds, small business, NRI, careers, opinion, astrology, and ETPrime (subscription-gated) sections.

### `engadget_article`

Get Engadget article content. Returns public Engadget article metadata and body paragraphs from a canonical article URL. Engadget articles are free to read, so the full body is returned.

### `engadget_author`

Get an Engadget author profile. Returns one Engadget author's public profile: name, biography, expertise, social links, and the latest stories listed on their page (a single fixed batch; the page has no further pagination).

### `engadget_headlines`

Get Engadget section headlines. Returns the latest Engadget headlines for one category. 'section' is required and takes one of 48 slugs such as 'ai', 'gaming', 'apple', 'laptop-pc-reviews' or 'transportation-evs'; other values return an invalid-parameter error. Small categories, such as buying guides, may hold only a few items.

### `engadget_news`

Get Engadget top stories. Returns the current Engadget technology news. Each item has a title, URL, summary, publish time, author and image when available. Engadget articles are free to read. Takes no parameters; use 'engadget-headlines' for a single category.

### `engadget_sections`

Get Engadget sections. Lists the 48 Engadget categories accepted by 'engadget-headlines', such as 'ai', 'cybersecurity', 'smartphone-reviews', 'space' and 'xbox'. Each entry has the 'slug', display 'name' and category feed 'url'. Categories with an empty feed are not listed.

### `eonline_article`

Get E! News article content. Returns one E! News article by its 'url', in the form 'https://www.eonline.com/news/<numeric id>/<slug>'. The response has the title, description, publish time, byline, lead image, body 'paragraphs' and 'section', which is the article's first tag. Photo galleries, videos and show pages are rejected; an unknown id returns not-found.

### `eonline_author`

Get an E! News author page. Returns an E! News writer's 'name' and the articles on their author page, about 45 per page, for a 'url' like 'https://www.eonline.com/authors/natalie-finn' (add '/page/<n>' for older ones). There is no biography or photo. 'published_at' is the page's own text, such as '18 minutes ago', not a timestamp.

### `eonline_headlines`

Get E! News section headlines. Returns up to 30 E! News headlines for one section. 'section' is required and must be one of 'top_stories', 'tv', 'movies', 'music', 'celebrities', 'couples', 'royals', 'red_carpet', 'influencer', 'style', 'fashion' or 'shop'. Each item has its title, URL, summary, publication time, author and image.

### `eonline_news`

Get E! News top stories. Returns up to 30 top stories from the US edition of E! News. Each item has its title, canonical article URL, summary, publication time, byline and thumbnail. Takes no parameters; use 'eonline-headlines' for a single section.

### `eonline_sections`

Get E! News sections. Lists the 12 E! News sections accepted by 'eonline-headlines', from 'top_stories', 'tv' and 'movies' to 'royals', 'fashion' and 'shop'. Each entry has the 'slug', 'name' and feed 'url'. The list is curated from the main navigation hubs and major tag feeds, not every tag.

### `espn_athlete`

ESPN athlete. Returns one athlete's bio/overview (name, position, jersey, physicals, current team). The 'sport' enum accepts 'football', 'basketball', 'baseball', 'hockey', and 'soccer'. The 'league' enum accepts 'nfl', 'college-football', 'nba', 'wnba', 'mens-college-basketball', 'womens-college-basketball', 'mlb', 'nhl', 'eng.1', 'esp.1', 'ita.1', 'ger.1', 'fra.1', 'usa.1', and 'uefa.champions'; it must be valid for the chosen sport.

### `espn_game_summary`

ESPN game summary. Returns one game's matchup, betting odds, and boxscore stat totals. The 'sport' enum accepts 'football', 'basketball', 'baseball', 'hockey', and 'soccer'. The 'league' enum accepts 'nfl', 'college-football', 'nba', 'wnba', 'mens-college-basketball', 'womens-college-basketball', 'mlb', 'nhl', 'eng.1', 'esp.1', 'ita.1', 'ger.1', 'fra.1', 'usa.1', and 'uefa.champions'; it must be valid for the chosen sport. Get an 'event' id from the scoreboard endpoint.

### `espn_news`

ESPN league news. Returns recent news articles (headline, description, link) for a league. The 'sport' enum accepts 'football', 'basketball', 'baseball', 'hockey', and 'soccer'. The 'league' enum accepts 'nfl', 'college-football', 'nba', 'wnba', 'mens-college-basketball', 'womens-college-basketball', 'mlb', 'nhl', 'eng.1', 'esp.1', 'ita.1', 'ger.1', 'fra.1', 'usa.1', and 'uefa.champions'; it must be valid for the chosen sport.

### `espn_rankings`

ESPN poll rankings. Returns poll rankings (e.g. AP Top 25) for a college league. Rankings are only published for college leagues: the 'sport' enum accepts 'football' and 'basketball', and the 'league' enum accepts 'college-football', 'mens-college-basketball', and 'womens-college-basketball'.

### `espn_scoreboard`

ESPN scoreboard. Returns games (scores, schedule, status, and odds when available) for a sport and league. The 'sport' enum accepts 'football', 'basketball', 'baseball', 'hockey', and 'soccer'. The 'league' enum accepts 'nfl', 'college-football', 'nba', 'wnba', 'mens-college-basketball', 'womens-college-basketball', 'mlb', 'nhl', 'eng.1', 'esp.1', 'ita.1', 'ger.1', 'fra.1', 'usa.1', and 'uefa.champions'; it must be valid for the chosen sport. The 'seasontype' enum accepts '1' (preseason), '2' (regular season), '3' (postseason), and '4' (offseason).

### `espn_standings`

ESPN standings. Returns league standings grouped by conference/division. The 'sport' enum accepts 'football', 'basketball', 'baseball', 'hockey', and 'soccer'. The 'league' enum accepts 'nfl', 'college-football', 'nba', 'wnba', 'mens-college-basketball', 'womens-college-basketball', 'mlb', 'nhl', 'eng.1', 'esp.1', 'ita.1', 'ger.1', 'fra.1', 'usa.1', and 'uefa.champions'; it must be valid for the chosen sport. The 'seasontype' enum accepts '1' (preseason), '2' (regular season), and '3' (postseason).

### `espn_team`

ESPN team detail. Returns one team's detail (identity, colors, record, standing summary). The 'sport' enum accepts 'football', 'basketball', 'baseball', 'hockey', and 'soccer'. The 'league' enum accepts 'nfl', 'college-football', 'nba', 'wnba', 'mens-college-basketball', 'womens-college-basketball', 'mlb', 'nhl', 'eng.1', 'esp.1', 'ita.1', 'ger.1', 'fra.1', 'usa.1', and 'uefa.champions'; it must be valid for the chosen sport.

### `espn_team_roster`

ESPN team roster. Returns a team's roster (players with position, jersey, age, and experience) plus head coach. The 'sport' enum accepts 'football', 'basketball', 'baseball', 'hockey', and 'soccer'. The 'league' enum accepts 'nfl', 'college-football', 'nba', 'wnba', 'mens-college-basketball', 'womens-college-basketball', 'mlb', 'nhl', 'eng.1', 'esp.1', 'ita.1', 'ger.1', 'fra.1', 'usa.1', and 'uefa.champions'; it must be valid for the chosen sport.

### `espn_teams`

ESPN team list. Returns the full team list for a sport and league. The 'sport' enum accepts 'football', 'basketball', 'baseball', 'hockey', and 'soccer'. The 'league' enum accepts 'nfl', 'college-football', 'nba', 'wnba', 'mens-college-basketball', 'womens-college-basketball', 'mlb', 'nhl', 'eng.1', 'esp.1', 'ita.1', 'ger.1', 'fra.1', 'usa.1', and 'uefa.champions'; it must be valid for the chosen sport.

### `etsy_listing`

Get Etsy listing detail. Returns the details of one Etsy listing by its numeric 'id': title, description, URL, price and currency, quantity, favorites, views, materials, tags, images and category. It also has the shop id and name, listing state, sold-out, customizable and digital flags, when it was made, shipping origin country, and create and update dates.

### `etsy_listing_reviews`

Get Etsy listing reviews. Returns buyer reviews for an Etsy listing, identified by the numeric 'id'. Start from 'offset' (0-based, default 0) and order with 'sort' ('newest', 'oldest', 'highest_rating', 'lowest_rating' or 'most_relevant'). The response has the average rating and total rating count; each review has buyer, date, rating, text, language and whether the seller replied.

### `etsy_search`

Search Etsy listings. Searches Etsy listings across shops for the required keywords 'q', in Etsy's default relevance order. Page with 'offset' (default 0) and 'limit' (default 36, max 100). The response gives the total match 'count', and each result has listing id, title, URL, image, price, shop name and rating, quantity and sold-out flag. Read 'currency', since it is not fixed to USD.

### `etsy_shop`

Get Etsy shop profile. Returns an Etsy shop profile: seller, headline, rating, and sold count. Accepts a numeric shop id or a shop name.

### `etsy_shop_listings`

Get an Etsy shop's listings. Lists the listings in an Etsy shop, identified by the required 'id' (a numeric shop id or a shop name). Narrow with 'q' to filter within the shop's own catalogue, and page with 'offset' (default 0) and 'limit' (default 24). Each listing has its id, title, URL, image, price, currency, quantity, shop rating and sold-out flag.

### `etsy_shop_reviews`

Get Etsy shop reviews. Returns buyer reviews for an Etsy shop, identified by the required 'id' (a numeric shop id or a shop name). Page with 'offset' (default 0) and 'limit' (default 14). The response has the average rating and total rating count. Each review has buyer, date, rating, text, language, the reviewed listing, and whether the seller replied.

### `etsy_shop_search`

Search Etsy shops. Searches Etsy shops by the required keyword 'q', returning up to 'limit' shops (default 10). Each shop has its id, name, avatar, location, active listing count, open date and a vacation-mode flag.

### `euronews_article`

Get Euronews article content. Returns one Euronews English-edition article by its 'url', in the form 'https://www.euronews.com/YYYY/MM/DD/<slug>'. The response has the title, description, publish and update times, section, authors, lead image and body 'paragraphs'.

### `euronews_author`

Get a Euronews author profile. Returns a Euronews author profile for a 'url' like 'https://www.euronews.com/profiles/<id>'. The response has the name, job title, editorial team, 'social_links' (usually one X/Twitter link, empty if none) and recent articles. There is no headshot or biography, and 'job_title' is repeated as Euronews gives it.

### `euronews_headlines`

Get Euronews section headlines. Returns the latest Euronews English-edition headlines for one section. 'section' is required and takes one of 42 slugs, including themes ('business', 'culture', 'earth', 'health', 'next', 'travel') and their sub-sections such as 'business-markets' or 'next-space'. Each item has its title and URL; the 'news' and 'business' sections also carry summary and publication time.

### `euronews_news`

Get Euronews top stories. Returns the current Euronews English-edition top stories. Each item has its title, URL, summary and publication time. Takes no parameters; use 'euronews-headlines' for a single theme or sub-section.

### `euronews_sections`

Get Euronews sections. Lists the 42 Euronews English-edition sections accepted by 'euronews-headlines'. Top-level themes include 'news', 'business', 'culture', 'earth', 'health', 'my-europe', 'next' and 'travel', each with sub-sections such as 'news-africa' or 'earth-climate'. Each entry has the 'slug', 'name' and 'url'.

### `everlane_collection_products`

List Everlane collection products. Returns products from one Everlane (https://www.everlane.com) collection. The storefront URL is fixed server-side; 'handle' is the collection's URL slug.

### `everlane_collections`

List Everlane collections. Returns collections from Everlane (https://www.everlane.com). The storefront URL is fixed server-side. Valid empty result pages return '200' with an empty collections array.

### `everlane_page`

Get a Everlane static page. Returns one Everlane static page by its required 'handle': title, URL, plain-text content, and created, updated and published dates. An unknown handle returns '404'. In a fallback mode flagged by 'transport_mode: "ssr_embedded"', the response omits 'id'.

### `everlane_pages`

List Everlane static pages. Lists Everlane static pages, 50 per page by default ('limit', max 250), with 'page' starting at 1. Each page has its handle, title, URL, plain-text content, and created, updated and published dates. In a fallback mode flagged by 'transport_mode: "ssr_embedded"', items carry only 'handle', 'url' and 'updated_at'.

### `everlane_product`

Get a Everlane product. Returns product detail for one Everlane (https://www.everlane.com) product handle. The storefront URL is fixed server-side; 'handle' is the product's URL slug.

### `everlane_product_recommendations`

List Everlane product recommendations. Returns recommended products for one Everlane (https://www.everlane.com) product handle. The storefront URL is fixed server-side.

### `everlane_products`

List Everlane products. Returns products from Everlane's (https://www.everlane.com) public product catalog. The storefront URL is fixed server-side. Valid empty result pages return '200' with an empty products array.

### `everlane_search_suggest`

Get Everlane search suggestions. Returns products, collections, and query suggestions from Everlane's (https://www.everlane.com) predictive search. The storefront URL is fixed server-side.

### `everlane_sitemap_urls`

List Everlane sitemap URLs. Lists URL entries from Everlane's sitemaps, filtered by 'type' ('all' by default, or 'products', 'collections', 'pages', 'blogs', 'agentic_discovery', 'other') and capped by 'limit' (default 50, max 250). Each entry has its 'loc', inferred type, handle, last modified date, change frequency, and images with caption and title when present.

### `everlane_sitemaps`

List Everlane sitemaps. Lists the child sitemaps in Everlane's sitemap index. Each entry has its 'loc' URL and an inferred 'type': 'products', 'collections', 'pages', 'blogs', 'agentic_discovery' or 'other'. It takes no parameters.

### `everlane_store`

Get Everlane store metadata. Returns storefront metadata for Everlane (https://www.everlane.com). The storefront URL is fixed server-side, so no 'url' parameter is accepted.

### `ew_article`

Get Entertainment Weekly article content. Returns one Entertainment Weekly article by its canonical 'url' in the form 'ew.com/<slug>-<id>'. The response has the title, description, publish and update times, section, authors, lead image, body 'paragraphs' and a 'paywalled' flag. Blocked or malformed pages return an upstream error.

### `ew_author`

Get an Entertainment Weekly author profile. Returns one Entertainment Weekly contributor's public profile (name, job title, biography) and their recent articles from a canonical author URL.

### `ew_headlines`

Get Entertainment Weekly section headlines. Returns the latest Entertainment Weekly headlines for one section. 'section' is required and must be one of 'tv', 'movies', 'music', 'what-to-watch', 'binge', 'celebrity', 'awardist', 'books' or 'theater'. Each item has its title and URL, plus an image when the card shows one.

### `ew_news`

Get Entertainment Weekly top stories. Returns the current Entertainment Weekly top stories. Each item has its title and URL, plus an image when the card shows one. Takes no parameters; use 'ew-headlines' for a single section.

### `ew_sections`

Get Entertainment Weekly sections. Lists the nine Entertainment Weekly primary-navigation sections accepted by 'ew-headlines': 'tv', 'movies', 'music', 'what-to-watch', 'binge', 'celebrity', 'awardist', 'books' and 'theater'. Each entry has the 'slug', display 'name' and section 'url'.

### `expedia_activities_search`

Search Expedia activities. Searches Expedia things to do (activities and tours) for a free-text 'destination' between 'start_date' and 'end_date' ('YYYY-MM-DD'), all required in the JSON body. Optional 'page', 'page_size' (1-50, default 20), 'currency' (default 'USD') and 'locale' (default 'en_US'). Each activity has its id, name, duration, price, review score and label, review count, free-cancellation flag and thumbnail.

### `expedia_flights_search`

Search Expedia flights. Searches Expedia flights between two IATA airport codes, 'origin' and 'destination', on 'departure_date' ('YYYY-MM-DD'). 'return_date' is required for the default 'round_trip'; 'one_way' is the alternative 'trip_type'. Optional 'adults' (1-9, default 1), 'cabin_class' (default 'COACH'), 'currency' and 'locale'. Returns departing-leg offers only, with airline, times, duration, stops, route and price.

### `expedia_locations_search`

Search Expedia destinations. Returns Expedia destination and property suggestions for a free-text 'term' (required, 100 characters or fewer), with optional 'currency' and 'locale'. Each item has its type, geo type, primary and secondary text, full location name, coordinates, and 'region_id', 'property_id' or 'airport_code' where they exist.

### `expedia_properties_detail`

Expedia Stays property detail. Returns a summary for one Expedia hotel by 'property_id', for the stay given by 'check_in' and 'check_out' ('YYYY-MM-DD'), all required in the JSON body. Optional 'adults' (1-9, default 2), 'currency' and 'locale'. The response has the name, star rating, address, city, province, country code, coordinates, top amenities and VIP message.

### `expedia_properties_filters`

Expedia search filters. Returns the sort and filter facets (amenities, star rating, neighborhood, nightly price range, sort options) available for a Stays search.

### `expedia_properties_reviews`

Expedia Stays property guest reviews. Returns the overall rating and a short set of guest reviews, typically around six, for one Expedia hotel. 'property_id', 'check_in' and 'check_out' ('YYYY-MM-DD') are required in the JSON body; 'adults' (1-9, default 2), 'currency' and 'locale' are optional. Each review has the reviewer name, date, rating label, message and verified flag. It is not the full review archive.

### `expedia_properties_search`

Search Expedia Stays properties. Returns Expedia Stays (hotel) search results for a free-text destination and date range. Promotional banners and sponsored ad slots are dropped, so every returned property has an id and name.

### `expresstribune_article`

Get The Express Tribune article content. Returns one Express Tribune story by 'url', which must be a canonical 'tribune.com.pk/story/<id>/<slug>' link. The response has the title, description, section, authors, publication and update times, lead image URL, body 'paragraphs' and a 'paywalled' flag.

### `expresstribune_author`

Get an Express Tribune author's public archive. Returns one page of story cards from a canonical public author archive. Page is 1-based; the publisher's Next link indicates another page.

### `expresstribune_headlines`

Get The Express Tribune section headlines. Returns headlines from one public RSS section. Some directory feeds are historical or infrequently updated; their publisher timestamps are preserved.

### `expresstribune_news`

Get The Express Tribune top stories. Returns current top stories from The Express Tribune's public RSS feed. Feed dates and publisher teasers are returned as published.

### `expresstribune_sections`

Get The Express Tribune sections. Returns every usable feed section listed in the publisher's RSS directory. talko is omitted because its official endpoint currently returns an empty response.

### `extract`

Extract schema-conforming JSON from a URL. Reads a public URL as clean Markdown, then returns data that strictly conforms to the supplied bounded JSON Schema. The response includes 'truncated', which is true when the page was too long and only its first part was used.

### `facebook_marketplace_search`

Search Facebook Marketplace. Fetches Facebook Marketplace search or browse results for a location: listing id, title, price, city/state, and a thumbnail image per result. Only the first page Facebook's own server-rendered results page returns is available — Facebook's own further pagination requires a logged-in session and is out of scope. Omit both query and category to get the location's browse feed instead of running a search. minPrice, maxPrice, sortBy, daysSinceListed, and condition only take effect alongside a query or category (Facebook itself ignores them on the plain browse feed), except for the property_rentals category, which has its own always-filtered listing page. This endpoint can take noticeably longer than other search endpoints (up to roughly a minute in the slowest case) as it retries to get past an intermittent upstream condition; priced accordingly.

### `facebook_page`

Get Facebook page details. Fetches public data about a Facebook Page given its page ID, vanity name, or full page URL: name, follower/like counts, intro, category, business hours/price range, review count, and any public contact details (email, phone, address, website, WhatsApp number) exposed on the Page's About tab.

### `fanatics_categories`

Get Fanatics' league and team navigation tree. Returns Fanatics' full top-level navigation tree: leagues (NFL, MLB, NBA, NHL, Soccer, WWE, College, ...) and, where Fanatics exposes a team-level breakdown, each league's teams (College's several hundred schools included). Each league's or team's url is directly usable as fanatics_category's url input. Public data sourced from fanatics.com's own navigation data.

### `fanatics_category`

Browse a Fanatics league or team category. Returns one page of a Fanatics league or team category's product listing (name, brand, price, availability, image, url). Use GET /fanatics/categories to discover valid category urls.

### `fanatics_product`

Get a Fanatics product's detail. Returns one Fanatics product's detail (name, brand, category, price, availability, condition, images), plus per-size availability/price, a fit/value/quality review-rating breakdown, a richer media gallery, and comparable-product alternates (e.g. a jersey's Game/Limited/Elite stitch tiers) where Fanatics exposes them. Use GET /fanatics/search or GET /fanatics/category to discover product urls.

### `fanatics_search`

Search Fanatics' product catalog. Searches Fanatics products by the required 'query'. Choose 'page_size' (24, 48 or 72; default 24), 'page_number' (default 1) and 'sort' ('TopSellers', 'LowestPrice', 'HighestPrice' or 'NewestArrivals'; default 'TopSellers'). Each item has product id, name, brand, category, price, currency, availability, image and URL. Also returns 'total_items' and 'has_next_page'. An invalid 'page_size' or 'sort' returns '400'.

### `fanaticscollect_auctions`

List Fanatics Collect auction events. Returns Fanatics Collect's current and recent weekly and premier auction events -- the same short list the site's own header auction switcher and countdown banner show. This is the discovery endpoint for Search's auction_urn param: copy an event's urn value to browse every lot in that auction. A small, current/recent set (observed live: around 6 events), not a full historical archive -- older auctions' urn values found on a Search result or a GetListing response remain valid for Search even once they no longer appear here.

### `fanaticscollect_categories`

List Fanatics Collect search filter values. Returns every accepted value for GetListing's marketplace param -- WEEKLY, PREMIER, FIXED -- and for Search's marketplace, category_parent, sub_category, grading_service, status, and sort params. Discovery endpoint for those closed enums.

### `fanaticscollect_instant_rips_categories`

Get Fanatics Collect Instant Rips categories. Returns every category Fanatics Collect's "Instant Rips" mystery-pack product (fanaticscollect.com/instant-rips) currently advertises on its homepage: id, name, and price range. Instant Rips is a "buy a randomized pack, a real graded card is revealed" product; each category's id is a real listing id, fetchable through GetListing with type=FIXED for that entry point's own full detail. This does not cover the individual pack-tier tiles within a category or the homepage's "Recently ripped" live feed.

### `fanaticscollect_listing`

Get Fanatics Collect listing detail. Returns full detail for a single Fanatics Collect listing: a weekly-auction lot, a premier-auction lot, or a fixed-price "buy now" item (including an Instant Rips pack). Fields include title, current bid/starting/asking price, bid count, auction window and status, images, description, completed sale history, and -- when the card is stored in Fanatics' vault -- grading/authentication metadata including a direct PSA cert-verification link.

### `fanaticscollect_search`

Search Fanatics Collect listings. Searches Fanatics Collect's full marketplace -- weekly auctions, premier auctions, and the fixed-price "Buy Now" marketplace -- by free-text query, category, grading service, price/year/grade range, and listing status, in a caller-selected sort order. See GetCategories for the accepted category, grading-service, status, and sort values.

### `fanaticscollect_sold_items`

Search Fanatics Collect sold items. Searches Fanatics Collect's sales-history archive -- every completed sale across every marketplace, not just what the live search index currently surfaces. A separate product from Search, reached from the "View all sold items" link on every marketplace search page. purchase_price is what the buyer paid in US dollars: for WEEKLY and PREMIER auction sales it includes the buyer's premium, so it is higher than the listing's final bid; for FIXED sales it equals the asking price. See GetCategories for the accepted category, grading-service, eye-appeal-grade, and sort values.

### `fanaticscollect_trending_searches`

Get Fanatics Collect trending search terms. Returns Fanatics Collect's own currently trending search terms -- the same list shown in the site's own header search box before the visitor types anything.

### `fanaticslive_browse`

Browse Fanatics Live shows by league. Returns the live and upcoming shows currently listed under a Fanatics Live league: name, status, cover image, viewers, and the hosting channel/shop.

### `fanaticslive_channel`

Get a Fanatics Live channel's detail page. Returns a Fanatics Live channel's own detail page: its parent shop, and a first page of its live/upcoming and past/replay shows. A shop can run several channels (e.g. a league-specific sub-feed) -- see /fanaticslive/shop/{slug} for a shop's full channel list and /fanaticslive/shop/{slug}/shows for cursor-paginated access to a full show history.

### `fanaticslive_instant_rips`

Get a Fanatics Live show's current instant-rip state. Returns a Fanatics Live show's current break's digital-instant-rip state: spot claim/rip progress and the currently revealing item, when a rip is actively in progress. current_break is omitted when the show has no active break at request time.

### `fanaticslive_leagues`

Get Fanatics Live's league taxonomy. Returns Fanatics Live's full league/category list (e.g. "Pokemon", "NFL", "MTG"). Each entry's type is usable directly with /fanaticslive/browse's league filter.

### `fanaticslive_shop`
