Get a Foreign Policy author profile. Returns one Foreign Policy contributor's public profile: name, bio, and their recent articles. Further articles load behind a client-side control this endpoint does not follow, so this is the author page's initial recent-article list, not the contributor's full history.

### `foreignpolicy_headlines`

Get Foreign Policy site-wide headlines. Returns fresh headlines from Foreign Policy's public, site-wide RSS feed. There is no section parameter: use foreignpolicy-topic to scope to one category or tag.

### `foreignpolicy_live`

List Foreign Policy Live conversations. Returns Foreign Policy's public FP Live conversation directory. The upstream renders the complete all-conversations list and applies year filtering in the browser.

### `foreignpolicy_live_detail`

Get a Foreign Policy Live conversation. Returns one public FP Live conversation by the slug returned by foreignpolicy-live, including its description and any embedded video highlight metadata.

### `foreignpolicy_project`

Get a Foreign Policy project hub. Returns a public Foreign Policy curated project hub and its current article cards. Use foreignpolicy-projects to discover live project slugs.

### `foreignpolicy_projects`

List Foreign Policy project hubs. Returns one page of Foreign Policy's live public project directory. Follow next_page until it is zero to enumerate the current project slug space, then pass a slug to foreignpolicy-project.

### `foreignpolicy_topic`

Get Foreign Policy category or tag archive. Returns one page of a public Foreign Policy category or tag archive (newest first). type selects the archive namespace and defaults to category; topic is the slug within it; page is 1-based.

### `fortune_article`

Get Fortune article content. Returns one Fortune article by its canonical 'url'. The response has the title, description, publish and update times, section, authors, lead image, body 'paragraphs' and a 'paywalled' flag. Subscriber-only or blocked articles return an upstream error.

### `fortune_author`

Get a Fortune author profile. Returns one Fortune author's public profile: name, bio, email, social accounts, and one page of their recent articles (30 fortune.com/2026-format article dates use "Month D, YYYY"; converted to YYYY-MM-DD here).

### `fortune_companies`

Search the Fortune company directory. Searches Fortune's company directory, 30 companies per page, with 'page' starting at 1. Filter by 'search' (company name), 'country', 'industry' (exact title), 'ranking' with 'year', and ranges 'min_revenue' and 'max_revenue' (in $M) and 'min_employees' and 'max_employees'. Each item has name, slug, URL, country, revenues and description. Invalid 'country' or 'industry' values return '400'.

### `fortune_company`

Get a Fortune company profile. Returns one company's public Fortune profile: fact sheet (headquarters, CEO, ticker, revenues, employees, ...), the Fortune rankings it appears on, workplace data tables, earnings report links, and social accounts, recovered from the company's own fortune.com page.

### `fortune_company_filters`

Discover Fortune company directory filters. Lists the filter values the Fortune company directory accepts: countries and industries (each with slug and title), the rankings usable with the 'ranking' filter and their available years, and the minimum and maximum revenue and employee counts. The rankings are a subset of all Fortune rankings. It takes no parameters.

### `fortune_headlines`

Get Fortune section headlines. Returns the latest Fortune headlines for one section. 'section' is required and takes one of 36 slugs such as 'latest', 'fortune-500', 'finance', 'artificial-intelligence', 'crypto', 'leadership' or 'europe'. Each item has its title and URL.

### `fortune_news`

Get Fortune top stories. Returns the current Fortune top stories. Each item has its title, URL, summary, publication time, author and image. Takes no parameters; use 'fortune-headlines' for a single section.

### `fortune_ranking`

Search a Fortune ranking. Returns rows from a selected Fortune ranking list and year -- the Fortune 500 franchise (including Fortune China 500) or one of Fortune's award/culture rankings. Search, filters, sorting, and pagination are applied against Fortune's public ranking data and validated against that list/year's filter inventory.

### `fortune_ranking_filters`

Discover Fortune ranking filters. Returns the filter fields and sortable columns for one Fortune ranking list. 'list' selects the ranking (default 'fortune500') and 'year' a historical edition; omit 'year' for the list's current year. Each search field has its field name, title, type and accepted options, and each sortable column has a title and type.

### `fortune_ranking_lists`

List Fortune ranking lists. Returns every public ranking accepted by the other fortune/ranking endpoints -- the Fortune 500 franchise's regional/global variants (including Fortune China 500) plus Fortune's award and culture rankings.

### `fortune_ranking_years`

List Fortune ranking years. Returns every year accepted by Fortune's public ranking source for a selected list, including the 2023-2026 Fortune China 500 editions.

### `fortune_sections`

Get Fortune sections. Lists the Fortune sections accepted by 'fortune-headlines', such as 'latest', 'fortune-500', 'finance', 'tech', 'leadership' and 'crypto'. Each entry has a stable 'slug', display 'name' and the section 'url'. Takes no parameters.

### `fotmob_audio_matches`

FotMob matches with audio commentary. Returns FotMob's current match-to-audio-language availability index. Match ids are open-ended and can be passed to /fotmob/match. The list is independent of a selected match date and may include matches outside the current fixtures feed.

### `fotmob_fifa_ranking_periods`

FotMob FIFA ranking period directory. Lists the FIFA ranking periods FotMob currently offers for the required 'gender' ('men' or 'women'). Each period has a 'periodId' and a 'periodName' date label. Pass a 'periodId' to the FotMob FIFA rankings endpoint; the ids change over time and are not a fixed set.

### `fotmob_fifa_rankings`

FotMob FIFA national-team rankings. Returns ranked national-team points and rank changes for one period. Discover valid periodId values for the selected gender from /fotmob/fifa-ranking-periods.

### `fotmob_latest_news`

FotMob latest football news. Returns the global English latest-news feed. Items are article previews; the upstream response contains up to 20 items per offset. Use start_index increments of 20 to page without overlap.

### `fotmob_league`

FotMob league details and sections. Returns FotMob's public league page payload, including available tabs, overview, table, fixtures, statistics, transfers, and seasons where supplied by the league. Discover valid season values with /fotmob/seasons. shotmap=true includes the optional, larger overview shot-map payload.

### `fotmob_leagues`

FotMob competition directory. Returns FotMob's full public league directory grouped into popular, international, and country collections. Use league ids with other FotMob endpoints.

### `fotmob_lineup_builder_players`

FotMob lineup builder player metadata. Returns public metadata for 1 to 11 selected lineup players. Player ids are open-ended and can be discovered through /fotmob/search or /fotmob/lineup-builder-team. Unknown ids without complete public metadata return 404.

### `fotmob_lineup_builder_team`

FotMob lineup builder team data. Returns the public lineup builder's prefilled formation, starting lineup, and squad for a team id. Discover open-ended team ids with /fotmob/search. Some teams legitimately have no squad list.

### `fotmob_match`

FotMob match details. Returns FotMob's public match-details payload, including available facts, events, statistics, lineups, shot map, momentum, table and head-to-head sections. The data field preserves the upstream JSON shape; individual sections may be absent for a match.

### `fotmob_match_media`

FotMob match videos and media metadata. Returns the public highlight-video and media metadata for one match. The request uses FotMob's English United States variant; unavailable media is represented by null source fields.

### `fotmob_matches`

FotMob matches for a date. Returns FotMob's public match payload for a calendar date and IANA timezone. The data field preserves the upstream JSON shape.

### `fotmob_news`

FotMob league news. Returns a page of FotMob news items for one league. League ids are discoverable from /fotmob/leagues; start_index is a zero-based offset.

### `fotmob_news_article`

FotMob full top-news article. Returns the full article body for a FotMob-authored top-news story. Pass the complete id-and-slug value from the public /topnews/<id> URL. News previews from external publishers remain external and are not fetched.

### `fotmob_player`

FotMob player profile. Returns a public FotMob player profile, including current team, injuries, recent matches, career history, trophies, market values, and the player-specific season identifiers needed for deeper statistics. Discover player ids through /fotmob/search. Market values are included by default.

### `fotmob_player_match_stats`

FotMob player match stats. Returns the public per-match stat rows for one player, including the available stat key, value, and translated label. Discover player ids through fotmob/search and match ids through fotmob/match or fotmob/player-matches.

### `fotmob_player_matches`

FotMob player match history. Returns one page of player match history. The player's matchFilters and permitted league/team pairs are discovered from /fotmob/player. For another page, copy the numeric before timestamp from the upstream previous URL.

### `fotmob_player_stats`

FotMob player season statistics. Returns deep statistics, shot map, heatmap, and goalkeeper shot map for one player-specific season entry. Discover valid season_id values and hasDeepStats from /fotmob/player statSeasons; entry ids vary by player and season.

### `fotmob_search`

Search FotMob entities. Returns public search suggestions for FotMob leagues, teams, players, and matches. term must contain 1 to 50 characters. Suggestions preserve the upstream JSON shape.

### `fotmob_seasons`

FotMob league season discovery. Lists the season values FotMob offers for one league, identified by the required numeric 'league_id' (from the FotMob leagues endpoint). The response has the league id, name and a 'seasons' list such as '2026/2027'. Pass a season to the FotMob league endpoint; the list varies by league.

### `fotmob_stats`

FotMob league player or team statistics. Returns ranked player or team statistics for a stat id discovered from /fotmob/stats-categories. The accepted stat ids vary by league, season, and type. team_id optionally restricts player statistics to one team. position filters player results client-side.

### `fotmob_stats_categories`

FotMob league stat categories and seasons. Returns FotMob's current stat catalog and available seasons for a league. With season_id omitted, the response exposes the season list and initial top-stat choices; pass a returned season id to retrieve that season's full player or team stat catalog.

### `fotmob_table`

FotMob league table. Returns the league standings and the upstream table views, including all, home, away, form, and expected-goals tables. League ids are discoverable from /fotmob/leagues.

### `fotmob_team`

FotMob team details. Returns public team data and the sections currently available for that team, such as overview, table, fixtures, squad, stats, transfers, and history. Team ids can be found with /fotmob/search. The upstream section set varies by team. For older fixtures, pass fixtures.previousFixturesUrl to /fotmob/team-fixtures.

### `fotmob_team_fixtures`

FotMob paginated team fixtures. Returns one page of older team matches. Start with the fixtures.previousFixturesUrl cursor from /fotmob/team, then pass each response's previous value as cursor until it is empty or null. Team ids are open-ended numeric ids discoverable through /fotmob/search.

### `fotmob_team_news`

FotMob team news. Returns the paginated article feed shown on a public FotMob team news page. Team ids can be found with /fotmob/search or /fotmob/team.

### `fotmob_transfers`

FotMob transfer center. Returns confirmed transfers, rumours, or popular transfers with the public transfer-center filters. Fee values are in EUR. Use fotmob/leagues and fotmob/search to discover league and team ids. The upstream returns 50 rows per page and caps its hit count at 10,000.

### `fotmob_trending_news`

FotMob trending football news. Returns the five-story Trending shelf shown on FotMob's public News page. Items are curated previews and may overlap the global latest-news feed; the upstream list is dynamic. No locale or country parameter is exposed because the complete accepted value space is not pinned.

### `fotmob_trending_searches`

FotMob trending search suggestions. Returns FotMob's current grouped trending suggestions for all entities, players, teams, and leagues. The feed is dynamic and may vary by the upstream's inferred region; no region or category parameter is exposed.

### `fotmob_tv_guide`

FotMob football TV guide. Returns the public seven-day football broadcast schedule for a country, with local schedule times. Discover all accepted country codes from /fotmob/tv-guide-countries. Timezone defaults to UTC.

### `fotmob_tv_guide_channels`

FotMob TV guide channels. Discovers channels attached to matches in the selected country's current seven-day public TV guide window. Use the country directory to discover the complete country code set.

### `fotmob_tv_guide_countries`

FotMob TV guide country directory. Lists the countries in FotMob's football TV guide country selector, each with a country 'code' (such as 'us', 'gb', 'de' or 'jp') and a name. Use a code with the FotMob TV guide and TV guide channels endpoints. It takes no parameters.

### `foxnews_article`

Get Fox News article content. Returns public Fox News article metadata and body paragraphs from a canonical article URL. This does not bypass login, subscription, or other access controls.

### `foxnews_author`

Get Fox News author profile. Returns one Fox News author/personality's public bio page: name, biography, and their most recent articles. Provide either the author's name slug or the full https://www.foxnews.com/person/<letter>/<slug> page URL.

### `foxnews_headlines`

Get Fox News section headlines. Returns the latest 25 Fox News headlines for one section. 'section' is required and must be one of 'us', 'world', 'politics', 'science', 'health', 'sports', 'travel', 'tech', 'opinion', 'entertainment', 'media' or 'lifestyle'. Each item has its title, URL, summary, publication time and image.

### `foxnews_news`

Get Fox News top stories. Returns fresh Fox News top stories from the public site-wide RSS feed. The feed is a public headline/body source and does not require credentials.

### `foxnews_search`

Search Fox News public content. Searches Fox News. Results may include article, video, or slideshow records; use type to restrict the result kind.

### `foxnews_sections`

Get Fox News RSS sections. Returns the exact live-verified Fox News article RSS section slugs accepted by foxnews-headlines. The video-only RSS feed is intentionally excluded.

### `foxsports_article`

Get FOX Sports article content. Returns public FOX Sports article metadata and body paragraphs from a canonical foxsports.com/stories/<section>/<slug> URL. Public body content stops at the article body container.

### `foxsports_headlines`

Get FOX Sports section headlines. Returns current FOX Sports headlines for one sport or topic. 'section' is required and takes one of 23 slugs such as 'top', 'nfl', 'nba', 'college-football', 'ufc', 'golf' or 'fifa-world-cup'; others return an invalid-parameter error. Feeds follow FOX Sports' own curation and can include related cross-sport items.

### `foxsports_news`

Get FOX Sports top stories. Returns current cross-sport stories from FOX Sports' All Headlines feed. Each item has its title and canonical story URL, plus summary, publication time, author and image when FOX Sports supplies them. Takes no parameters.

### `foxsports_sections`

Get FOX Sports news sections. Lists the 23 FOX Sports editorial feeds accepted by 'foxsports-headlines', including 'top', 'mlb', 'nfl', 'soccer', 'olympics' and 'wwe'. Each entry has the 'slug', 'name' and feed 'url'. The All Headlines feed is served by 'foxsports-news', not as a section; checked 2026-09-28.

### `france24_article`

Get France 24 article content. Returns public France 24 English-edition article metadata and body paragraphs from a canonical article URL. Live-blog pages are supported and return their chronological update entries as body paragraphs.

### `france24_author`

Get a France 24 author profile. Returns one France 24 byline's public profile (name, job title, biography) and their recent articles from a canonical author-profile URL. This includes the shared "FRANCE 24" newsroom byline used on many stories, which has no individual biography.

### `france24_headlines`

Get France 24 section headlines. Returns the latest France 24 English-edition headlines for one section. 'section' is required and must be one of 'africa', 'americas', 'asia-pacific', 'europe', 'france', 'middle-east', 'business-tech', 'culture', 'environment', 'sport', 'live-news' or 'tv-shows'. Each item has its title, URL, summary, publication time and author.

### `france24_news`

Get France 24 top stories. Returns the current France 24 English-edition top stories. Each item has its title, URL, summary, publication time and author. Takes no parameters; use 'france24-headlines' for a single region or topic.

### `france24_sections`

Get France 24 sections. Lists the 12 France 24 English-edition sections accepted by 'france24-headlines': six regions, four topics, the 'live-news' wire-briefs hub and the 'tv-shows' programmes hub. Each entry has the 'slug', display 'name' and section 'url'.

### `freemalaysiatoday_news`

Get the latest Free Malaysia Today stories. Returns Free Malaysia Today's current public top-stories RSS feed: each story's title, canonical URL, summary, author, publication time, and lead image.

### `freemalaysiatoday_sections`

List Free Malaysia Today sections. Lists every live-verified primary editorial navigation section, with its slug, display name, and landing-page URL. This is the live-verified primary editorial navigation taxonomy; media, promotional, and duplicate commercial destinations are excluded.

### `ft_article`

Get a Financial Times article's content. Returns one public Financial Times article's metadata and body paragraphs from a canonical article URL. Subscriber-only articles that the FT serves as a subscription page are not available.

### `ft_author`

Get an FT author profile. Returns one Financial Times contributor's public byline profile (name, job title, email, social accounts) plus one page of their recent articles. FT author pages carry no bio paragraph, only this byline metadata.

### `ft_categories`

List Financial Times sections. Lists every Financial Times section accepted by /ft/headlines, grouped by top-level section, with each section's slug, display name, and landing-page URL.

### `ft_headlines`

Get the latest stories in a Financial Times section. Returns one page of a Financial Times section front: each story's title, canonical URL, summary, section tag, publication time, and lead image. Section must be a slug returned by /ft/categories.

### `ft_news`

Get the latest Financial Times stories. Returns the Financial Times' current news feed: the newest stories across all sections, each with its title, canonical URL, and publication time.

### `ft_search`

Search Financial Times articles. Returns one page of Financial Times search results: each story's title, canonical URL, summary, section tag, publication time, and lead image. Results can be ordered by relevance or date and filtered by publication window.

### `fussballde_amateur_stats`

Get FUSSBALL.DE amateur top statistics. Returns a page of one of the ten Top-Amateurstatistiken rankings (Kreisklasse to Regionalliga, championship matches): top teams by goals, goal ratio, goals against and points average, highest-scoring matches, biggest draws, and top scorers by goals, ratio and goals in one match per week or season. Filter by season, team type and federation and page with 'limit' and 'offset'. A ranking is bounded to roughly its top 200 entries; 'final' marks the last page.

### `fussballde_club`

Get a FUSSBALL.DE club. Returns one club: name, federation, team counts, profile facts (founding year, address, website) and the club's teams with their competitions and team type. Teams are those of the current season; set 'season' for an earlier one and 'competition_kind' to keep only teams in championships, cups, friendlies and so on. Club ids appear as 'club_id' on teams and matches.

### `fussballde_club_matches`

Get FUSSBALL.DE fixtures and results of a club. Returns the fixtures and results across all of a club's teams (senior and youth). 'all' (default) is the club match plan for a date window (default the current season) optionally for one competition kind and paged with 'limit' and 'offset'; 'next' is the next fixtures and 'previous' the latest results. Each match names its competition and team type.

### `fussballde_club_search`

Search FUSSBALL.DE clubs by name or place. Searches FUSSBALL.DE clubs by club name, postcode or place, or both (both must match), and returns each club's id, name, postal code, city and logo. The first page reports the 'total' hit count; page with 'limit' (1 to 100, default 20) and 'offset', and 'final' marks the last page. Zero results is a valid response. The site's search is not fuzzy and matches a club's official name (for example 'RasenBallsport Leipzig', 'SC Freiburg'), so a looser display name such as 'RB Leipzig' can return nothing: search by place or one distinctive word, or use the 'club_id' that every team, table and match row already carries.

### `fussballde_competition_options`

List FUSSBALL.DE team types, leagues and areas. Returns the team types (Herren, Frauen, A-Junioren, ...), the leagues (Spielklassen) of each team type and the areas (Gebiete) of each league for one federation, season and competition type. Team type, league and area ids are federation-specific, so take them from this response and pass them to 'fussballde-competitions'.

### `fussballde_competitions`

List FUSSBALL.DE competitions for a league and area. Returns the competitions (Staffeln) at one selector path: a federation, season, competition type, team type, league and area. Each competition 'id' (for example '031BFREJC800001BVS5489BUVUR5FS5A-G' for the 2026/27 Bundesliga) is the key used by the matchday, match plan, table and top-scorer endpoints. An empty list is a valid result for a path with no competitions.

### `fussballde_federation`

Get a FUSSBALL.DE federation or regional association. Returns the profile of one of the 22 federations (the DFB and the regional and state associations) or of one of the five regional associations (Norddeutscher, Nordostdeutscher, Süddeutscher, Südwest and Westdeutscher): name, address, website, president, club, member and team counts, and the latest news items. Provide exactly one of 'federation_id' and 'regional_association'.

### `fussballde_filters`

List FUSSBALL.DE federations, seasons and competition types. Returns the competition selector base data of FUSSBALL.DE, the German amateur-football portal: the 22 federations (DFB plus regional associations), the available seasons per federation, and the competition types per federation and season. Use it first to get valid 'federation_id', 'season' and 'competition_type' values for the competition discovery endpoints.

### `fussballde_match`

Get a FUSSBALL.DE match. Returns one match: teams, competition, date, kick-off time, venue, score and half-time score, match number and matchday, officials, goals with minutes and timeline events such as substitutions. Fields the match has not published (for example a future match's score) are omitted.

### `fussballde_match_calendar`

Get FUSSBALL.DE matches near a postcode. Returns the matches FUSSBALL.DE's Matchkalender lists around a five-digit postcode within a date range (default today plus six days, at most 92 days), optionally filtered by team types and competition kind. Each match includes its team type (for example D-Junioren) and league. The upstream returns at most 10 matches per request and has no paging: 'truncated' is true when the page is full, so narrow the dates or filters to see the rest. Zero matches is a valid response.

### `fussballde_match_comparison`

Compare the two teams of a FUSSBALL.DE match. Returns a pre-match comparison for one match: 'history' is the all-time head-to-head record (duels, wins, draws, defeats, goals), 'meetings' lists the other fixtures and results between the two teams, and 'season' compares both teams' current standing, points, goals, form, top scorer and cards.

### `fussballde_match_plan`

Get the full FUSSBALL.DE match plan of a competition. Returns every match of a competition's season (fixtures and results), including the earliest matchdays, optionally filtered to one team and a date window; the date window is applied by the site, so a narrow window is cheaper than filtering a full season. Cups and tournaments are assembled round by round: every match carries its 'round' and the response lists the 'rounds' with their ids. Use it for a complete schedule; use 'fussballde-matchday' for one matchday.

### `fussballde_matchday`

Get FUSSBALL.DE matches of a competition matchday. Returns the matches of a competition's current matchday, of a numbered matchday ('matchday', 1 to the competition's matchday count, reported as 'matchday_count') or of the matchday around a date. Each match has teams, date, kick-off time, score and status ('finished', 'scheduled', 'cancelled' and the other values listed below). Cups and tournaments have no numbered matchdays; for them the response lists the competition's 'rounds' (each round id works as 'competition_id' to read that round) and labels every match with its 'round'. Dates, times and scores are decoded from the site's obfuscated glyph fonts.

### `fussballde_national_top_scorers`

Get the nationwide FUSSBALL.DE top scorers by league level. Returns the top 10 scorers of every league level across Germany for men or women (the site's Torjägerkanone), with goals, matches played and club. Only championship matches count and the upstream refreshes the ranking once a day; the response 'note' carries its last-update time. Adult teams only.

### `fussballde_news`

List FUSSBALL.DE news. Returns news teasers of one FUSSBALL.DE stream (all news, magazine, Regionalliga, federations, service, campaigns or help center) with title, category, publication date and time, and excerpt, paged with 'limit' (1 to 50, default 10) and 'offset'; 'final' is true on the last page. Use 'regional_league' or 'help_category' to narrow the Regionalliga and help-center streams to one league or category. Use the article id with 'fussballde-news-article' for the full text.

### `fussballde_news_article`

Get a FUSSBALL.DE news article. Returns one FUSSBALL.DE news article: title, category, publication date and time, lead image and caption, and the body paragraphs as plain text.

### `fussballde_news_search`

Search FUSSBALL.DE news. Searches FUSSBALL.DE editorial news ('news') or the Profi-Newsflash ('pro_news') by keyword and returns teasers with title, category, date and excerpt. The first page (offset 0) also reports the total hit count; page with 'limit' (1 to 50) and 'offset'. No hits is a valid empty result.

### `fussballde_player`

Get a FUSSBALL.DE player profile. Returns a player's public profile: name, team, team type, birth date and, for registered players ('profile_type' full), the current-season statistics such as appearances, minutes played, goals, goals against and cards. Players without a registered profile ('profile_type' basic) only have name, team and team type. Player ids come from 'fussballde-player-search', scorer lists, squads and amateur statistics.

### `fussballde_player_matches`

Get a FUSSBALL.DE player's match-by-match record. Returns a registered player's matches for one season and team: date, teams, result and per match the goals, the minute they were substituted in or out, and minutes played. Also lists the player's teams and competitions for the season so another team can be selected with 'team_id'. Basic profiles without registration have no match data.

### `fussballde_player_search`

Search FUSSBALL.DE players by name. Searches players registered on FUSSBALL.DE by first and/or last name, optionally narrowed by postcode or place, and returns each player's id, name, birth date, team and team type. The first page reports the 'total' hit count; page with 'limit' (1 to 100, default 20) and 'offset', and 'final' marks the last page. At least one of 'first_name' and 'last_name' is required. No match is a valid empty result.

### `fussballde_position_history`

Get the FUSSBALL.DE fever curve of a competition. Returns every team's table position after each played matchday of a competition (the site's Fieberkurve), as one ordered list of positions per team. Position 1 is the leader; the list index is the matchday.

### `fussballde_postal_codes`

Look up German postcodes by place name. Returns the German postcodes (with city and district) that FUSSBALL.DE's own location search suggests for a place name or postcode prefix. Use it to turn a place such as Dortmund into the five-digit 'postal_code' that 'fussballde-match-calendar' requires. No match is a valid empty list.

### `fussballde_table`

Get a FUSSBALL.DE competition standings table. Returns a competition's standings in one view: 'overall', 'home_away' (home and away tables), 'rounds' (first and second half-season tables), 'fairness' (fair-play table) or 'cross' (cross table of results between every pair of teams). Set 'matchday' to get the standings as they were after that matchday (not available for 'fairness'). Rows carry position, team, played, won, drawn, lost, goals and points where the view has them, plus the raw cells.

### `fussballde_team`

Get a FUSSBALL.DE team. Returns one team page: name, team type, federation, standing summary (competition, table position, points, goal ratio), current competitions, home venues, the club profile (founding year, address, contact) and the team's season-by-season history with final placings and the highest league reached. Use 'fussballde-team-matches' and 'fussballde-team-squad' for fixtures and players.

### `fussballde_team_matches`

Get FUSSBALL.DE fixtures and results of a team. Returns a team's matches across its competitions. 'all' (default) is the match plan for a date window (default the current season, 1 July to 30 June), optionally for one competition kind and paged with 'limit' and 'offset'; 'next' is the next 10 fixtures, 'previous' the latest 10 results, and 'wins', 'draws' and 'losses' the latest 10 finished matches with that outcome.

### `fussballde_team_squad`

Get a FUSSBALL.DE team squad. Returns a team's players for a season: the 'squad' (appearances, minutes, goals), 'arrivals' or 'departures' with the columns the site publishes for each. Player names come in the site's 'Surname, Forename' order.

### `fussballde_top_scorers`

Get the FUSSBALL.DE top scorers of a competition. Returns a page of a competition's top-scorer list with position, player, team and goals; page through it with 'limit' (1 to 100, default 30) and 'offset'. Tied scorers share a position. A competition without recorded scorers returns an empty list; cups and tournaments have no scorer list at all and return 404.

### `gamerant_article`

Get Game Rant article content. Returns one Game Rant article by its 'https://gamerant.com/<slug>/' 'url'. The response has the title, description, publish and update times, section, authors, lead image and body 'paragraphs'. Section hubs, video pages and author pages are rejected as invalid parameters; 'paywalled' is set only if the page declares the article not free.

### `gamerant_author`

Get a Game Rant author profile. Returns a Game Rant author profile for a 'url' of the form 'https://gamerant.com/author/<slug>/'. The response has the name, title, image, biography, 'social_links' (type and URL) and about 20 latest articles. Paginated author URLs are rejected, so older articles are not available.

### `gamerant_headlines`

Get Game Rant section headlines. Returns fresh headlines from one public Game Rant RSS section. Items from video sections have type video and are not readable through the article endpoint.

### `gamerant_news`

Get Game Rant top stories. Lists the latest Game Rant stories, about 10 items. Each item has its title, canonical URL, summary, publish time, author names (co-authors are joined with a comma) and lead image. Takes no parameters.

### `gamerant_sections`

Get Game Rant RSS sections. Lists the 178 Game Rant section slugs accepted by 'gamerant-headlines', covering platforms ('pc-news', 'ps5-news', 'nintendo-switch-news'), franchises ('fortnite-news', 'pokemon-news', 'fallout-news'), 'anime' and 'game-reviews'. Each entry has the 'slug', 'name' and feed 'url'.

### `gamesradar_article`

Get GamesRadar+ article content. Returns one GamesRadar+ article by its canonical 'gamesradar.com' 'url'. The response has the title, description, publish and update times, section, authors, lead image and body 'paragraphs'. Game and hardware review pages work too, taking the author from the page byline when no article-level author exists.

### `gamesradar_author`

Get a GamesRadar+ author profile. Returns a GamesRadar+ author profile, found by 'slug' (for example 'rosalie-newcombe') or by 'url'; send exactly one. 'page' (1-based, default 1) overrides any page in the URL. The response has the name, job title, biography, 'social_links', one page of articles, 'page' and 'has_next_page'.

### `gamesradar_headlines`

Get GamesRadar+ section headlines. Returns the latest GamesRadar+ headlines for one section. 'section' is required and takes one of 21 slugs such as 'games', 'games-reviews', 'hardware-news', 'entertainment-tv', 'lego' or 'dungeons-and-dragons'. Each item has its title, URL and 'type', plus publication time, author and image when the section page shows them.

### `gamesradar_news`

Get GamesRadar+ top stories. Returns the current GamesRadar+ top stories. Each item has its title, URL, summary, publication time, author and image. Takes no parameters; use 'gamesradar-headlines' for a single games, hardware or entertainment section.

### `gamesradar_sections`

Get GamesRadar+ sections. Lists the 21 GamesRadar+ sections accepted by 'gamesradar-headlines', from top-level hubs like 'games', 'hardware' and 'entertainment' to sub-sections such as 'games-guides', 'hardware-reviews' and 'entertainment-streaming'. Each entry has the 'slug', 'name' and 'url'.

### `gbnews_article`

Get GB News article content. Returns one GB News story by its 'gbnews.com' 'url' (news, opinion or sport; query strings are ignored). The response has the title, description, publish and update times, section label, authors, lead image and body 'paragraphs', without captions or widgets. 'paywalled' is never set. Video, audio, author and hub pages return an error.

### `gbnews_author`

Get a GB News author profile. Returns one GB News author's public profile: name, role, biography, image, and their most recent stories (up to 24; older stories are not available).

### `gbnews_headlines`

Get GB News section headlines. Returns the latest GB News headlines for one section or topic. 'section' is required and takes a site path such as 'news', 'news/uk/london', 'news/world/ukraine', 'news/us' or 'news/migrant-crisis'; the accepted values are listed by 'gbnews-sections'. Each item has its title, URL, summary, publication time, author and image.

### `gbnews_news`

Get GB News top stories. Returns the latest 30 GB News top stories. Each item has a title, canonical URL, summary (the story's first paragraph), publication time, author name and lead image, when GB News provides them. Takes no parameters.

### `gbnews_sections`

Get GB News sections. Lists the 390 GB News sections and topics accepted by 'gbnews-headlines'. Each entry has a 'slug' that is the path on the site, such as 'news/uk/scotland' or 'news/world/china', a display 'name' and the feed 'url'. Takes no parameters.

### `gdelt_context`

Sentence-level co-occurrence search across recent GDELT coverage. Searches the last 72 hours of GDELT-monitored news for sentences where every term of the required 'query' appears together. Returns up to 'maxrecords' rows (default 75, max 200), each with the matching sentence, its surrounding context, title, URL, domain, language and an 'is_quote' flag. Filter with 'domain', 'language', 'is_quote', 'timespan' or 'from' and 'to', and order with 'sort'.

### `gdelt_search`

Search global news coverage indexed by GDELT. Searches global news coverage indexed by GDELT for the required 'query', which accepts quoted phrases, '(a OR b)', 'theme:', 'tone<N' and 'domain:'. Narrow with 'country', 'language', 'domain', and 'timespan' or 'from' and 'to' (about the last 3 months are indexed). Returns up to 'maxrecords' articles (default 75, max 250) with title, URL, domain, language, source country and 'seen_at'.

### `gdelt_timeline`

Coverage volume or tone over time for a GDELT query. Returns how coverage of the required GDELT 'query' changes over time, as dated points. 'metric' picks 'volume' (the default, share of monitored articles), 'volume_raw' (matching article count), 'tone' (average sentiment), or 'lang' and 'country' for one series per language or country. Filter with 'country', 'language', 'domain', 'timespan' or 'from' and 'to'; 'smooth' runs 0 to 30 (default 0).

### `gdelt_tonechart`

Sentiment histogram for a GDELT query. Returns a sentiment histogram for the required GDELT 'query': one bin per integer tone value, each with an article 'count' and a short sample of top articles with title and URL. Filter with 'country', 'language', 'domain', and 'timespan' or 'from' and 'to'. A tone value with no matching articles is absent rather than returned with a zero count.

### `gdelt_tv_concept_entities`

List GDELT Television 2.0 AI concept entities. Lists the Google Knowledge Graph concept entities GDELT recognises in US television captioning, most frequent first, up to 'limit' entries (default 100, max 10000). Each has a display 'label' and a 'mid' code. Pass the 'mid', not the label, as 'concept' to the GDELT TV search and chart endpoints. The list does not depend on any query.

### `gdelt_tv_search`

Search US television news coverage (transcripts, captions, OCR, visual labels). Searches GDELT's US television news index on one required 'station' ('CNN', 'MSNBC', 'FOXNEWS', 'BBCNEWS', 'KGO', 'KPIX' or 'KNTV'). Match on 'transcript', 'caption', 'concept', 'onscreen_text' or 'visual', with matching 'exclude_' options. Returns up to 'maxrecords' clips (default 50, max 3000) with show, station, timing, caption, transcript, onscreen text and clip URL. Results lag 24 to 48 hours.

### `gdelt_tv_showchart`

Top US television shows by coverage share for a query. Ranks US television shows by how much they covered a topic. At least one 'station' is required, and a match is set with 'transcript', 'caption', 'concept', 'onscreen_text' or 'visual' (with 'exclude_' counterparts), optionally limited by 'show', 'timespan' or 'from' and 'to'. Returns shows with a 'count'. Omitting the time window searches the archive back to July 2010.

### `gdelt_tv_stationchart`

Compare US television news coverage across stations. Compares how much each US television station covered a topic. At least one 'station' is required, and several are compared side by side. A match is set with 'transcript', 'caption', 'concept', 'onscreen_text' or 'visual' (with 'exclude_' counterparts), optionally limited by 'show', 'timespan' or 'from' and 'to'. Returns each station with a 'count'.

### `gdelt_tv_stationdetails`

List GDELT Television 2.0 AI stations. Lists the television stations GDELT currently monitors, each with its 'id', short 'label' and a 'label_long' that includes its coverage dates. Use the ids as 'station' in the GDELT TV endpoints. It takes no parameters.

### `gdelt_tv_timeline`

Airtime volume over time for US television news coverage. Returns the amount of US television news airtime matching the supplied query over time, using GDELT Television 2.0 AI timeline-volume data. A station is required. Supports the same caption, transcript, concept, and visual match operators as gdelt-tv-search; coverage and processing-delay caveats are documented there.

### `gdelt_tv_visual_entities`

List GDELT Television 2.0 AI visual entities. Lists the computer-vision object and activity labels GDELT recognises in US television video, most frequent first, up to 'limit' entries (default 100, max 10000). The label itself is the value to pass as 'visual' to the GDELT TV search and chart endpoints. The list does not depend on any query.

### `gdelt_tv_wordcloud`

Word cloud for US television news coverage. Returns a frequency-ranked word cloud for US television coverage. 'channel' is required and picks what is counted: 'transcript', 'caption', 'concept', 'onscreen_text' or 'visual'; 'station' is also required. Match with the same channel options (with 'exclude_' counterparts) and limit by 'show', 'day_of_week', 'timespan' or 'from' and 'to'. Each word has a 'label' and 'count'.

### `geocoding_lookup`

Lookup Nominatim OSM ids. Looks up OpenStreetMap objects by the required 'osm_ids', a comma-separated list prefixed 'N' (node), 'W' (way) or 'R' (relation), such as 'W34633854,N123'. Each place has its display name, category and type, coordinates, bounding box, importance and address parts; 'addressdetails' defaults to true, and 'extratags', 'namedetails' and 'accept_language' are optional. Malformed ids return '400'; no match returns '404'.

### `geocoding_reverse`

Reverse geocode coordinates. Returns the nearest OpenStreetMap place for the required 'lat' and 'lon'. 'zoom' (0 to 18, default 18) sets the level of detail; 'addressdetails' defaults to true, and 'extratags', 'namedetails' and 'accept_language' are optional. The place has its display name, category and type, OSM type and id, bounding box, importance and address parts. Out-of-range coordinates return '400'; no place found returns '404'.

### `geocoding_search`

Search Nominatim places. Searches OpenStreetMap places by address. Pass either free-text 'q' or structured fields ('street', 'city', 'county', 'state', 'country', 'postalcode'), not both. 'limit' defaults to 10 and is clamped to 20; 'countrycodes' restricts by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country. Each result has its display name, coordinates, category, type, bounding box, importance and address parts. No match returns '404'.

### `ghanaweb_archive`

List GhanaWeb archive article URLs. Returns paginated canonical article URLs from one month sitemap. Discover accepted month values from ghanaweb-archive-months; the service only fetches child sitemap URLs derived from that official index.

### `ghanaweb_archive_months`

Discover GhanaWeb archive months. Lists the 'YYYYMM' months currently available in GhanaWeb's article archive, each with the time it was last updated. Use a returned month with the GhanaWeb archive endpoint; the set grows over time. It takes no parameters.

### `ghanaweb_article`

Get GhanaWeb article content. Returns public article metadata and readable body paragraphs. GhanaWeb's JSON-LD identifies the publisher rather than person authors, so authors are omitted.

### `ghanaweb_headlines`

Get GhanaWeb section headlines. Returns the article cards currently listed on one GhanaWeb section. 'section' is required and takes one of 15 slugs such as 'news', 'sports', 'crime', 'tabloid' or 'regional'. Each item has its 'title', 'url' and, when the card shows one, 'image_url'. Summary, author and publication time are not returned.

### `ghanaweb_news`

Get GhanaWeb latest stories. Lists GhanaWeb's current stories across the site, with no parameters. Each item carries its headline as 'title', the canonical article 'url' and the 'published_at' time. No author, summary or image is returned.

### `ghanaweb_sections`

Get GhanaWeb article sections. Lists the 15 article sections GhanaWeb accepts for 'ghanaweb-headlines', from 'news' and 'sports' to 'tabloid', 'lifestyle' and 'features'. Each entry has a 'slug', display 'name' and section 'url'. Video and other non-article areas are left out.

### `ghanaweb_video`

Get GhanaWeb TV video metadata. Returns metadata for one GhanaWeb TV video by its required numeric 'id': title, page URL, image URL, published and updated times, and the YouTube embed URL. The video file itself is not returned.

### `ghanaweb_video_sections`

Get GhanaWeb TV video sections. Lists the four GhanaWeb TV video categories accepted by 'ghanaweb-videos': 'news', 'sports', 'business' and 'entertainment'. Each entry has a 'slug', a display 'name' and the category 'url' on GhanaWeb. Takes no parameters.

### `ghanaweb_videos`

List GhanaWeb TV videos. Returns current public video cards for one GhanaWeb TV category, including metadata and a canonical detail URL. This endpoint does not retrieve video media.

### `github_org`

Retrieve a GitHub organization profile. Returns the public profile of a GitHub organization by its required 'org' login, with fields such as name, description, blog URL, location, public repository count, followers and whether the organization is verified.

### `github_org_repos`

List a GitHub organization's public repositories. Lists the public repositories of a GitHub organization, identified by the required 'org' login. Filter with 'type' ('all', 'public', 'forks', 'sources' or 'member'), order with 'sort' ('created', 'updated', 'pushed' or 'full_name') and 'direction', and page with 'page' and 'per_page' (max 100). Each repository has its name, description, language, stars and forks.

### `github_repo`

Retrieve a GitHub repository. Returns the public details of one GitHub repository, identified by the required 'owner' and 'repo'. Fields include the full name, description, main language, topics, stars, forks, watchers, open issues, license, default branch and last push time.

### `github_repo_contributors`

List a repository's contributors. Lists the contributors to a GitHub repository, identified by the required 'owner' and 'repo', ordered by number of contributions. Page with 'page' and 'per_page' (max 100). Each contributor has their login, id, contribution count, profile URL and account type.

### `github_repo_forks`

List a repository's public forks. Lists the public forks of a GitHub repository, identified by the required 'owner' and 'repo'. Order with 'sort' ('newest', 'oldest', 'stargazers' or 'watchers') and page with 'page' and 'per_page' (max 100). Each fork has its full name, owner, stars, language and creation time.

### `github_repo_languages`

Retrieve a repository's language breakdown. Returns the languages detected in a GitHub repository, identified by the required 'owner' and 'repo', as language and byte-count pairs sorted by bytes, largest first.

### `github_repo_releases`

List a repository's releases. Lists the published releases of a GitHub repository, identified by the required 'owner' and 'repo'. Page with 'page' and 'per_page' (max 100). Each release has its tag name, title, URL, prerelease flag, publication time and author.

### `github_search_repositories`

Search public GitHub repositories. Searches public GitHub repositories with the required GitHub search query 'q'. Order with 'sort' ('stars', 'forks', 'help-wanted-issues' or 'updated') and 'order', and page with 'page' and 'per_page' (max 100). The response has 'total_count' and items with full name, owner, description, language, stars, forks, topics and license.

### `github_search_users`

Search public GitHub users. Searches public GitHub user accounts with the required GitHub search query 'q'. Order with 'sort' ('followers', 'repositories' or 'joined') and 'order', and page with 'page' and 'per_page' (max 100). The response has 'total_count' and items with login, id, profile URL, account type and match score.

### `github_trending`

List trending GitHub repositories. Lists the repositories currently trending on GitHub. Filter by programming 'language' (such as 'go' or 'python') and choose the window with 'since' ('daily', 'weekly' or 'monthly'). Each repository has its owner, name, URL, description, language, stars, forks and stars gained today.

### `github_trending_developers`

List trending GitHub developers. Lists the developers currently trending on GitHub. Filter by programming 'language' (such as 'go' or 'python') and choose the window with 'since' ('daily', 'weekly' or 'monthly'). Each developer has a username, display name, profile URL and their popular repository.

### `github_user`

Retrieve a GitHub user profile. Returns a public GitHub user's profile plus user-published social links. Email is included only when the user has made it public on their profile.

### `github_user_events`

List a GitHub user's recent public activity. Lists a GitHub user's recent public events, identified by the required 'username'. Page with 'page' and 'per_page' (max 100). Each event has its id, event type such as 'PushEvent', repository name, timestamp and public flag.

### `github_user_followers`

List a GitHub user's followers. Lists the public accounts that follow a GitHub user, identified by the required 'username'. Page with 'page' and 'per_page' (max 100). Each follower has their login, id, avatar URL, profile URL and account type.

### `github_user_following`

List who a GitHub user follows. Lists the public accounts a GitHub user follows, identified by the required 'username'. Page with 'page' and 'per_page' (max 100). Each account has its login, id, avatar URL, profile URL and account type.

### `github_user_pinned`

List a GitHub user's pinned repositories. Returns the repositories a GitHub user has pinned on their profile, identified by the required 'username'. Each has its owner, name, URL, description, language, stars and forks. The list is empty when the user has pinned nothing.

### `github_user_repos`

List a GitHub user's public repositories. Lists the public repositories of a GitHub user, identified by the required 'username'. Filter with 'type' ('all', 'owner' or 'member'), order with 'sort' ('created', 'updated', 'pushed' or 'full_name') and 'direction', and page with 'page' and 'per_page' (max 100). Each repository has its name, description, language, stars, forks, topics, fork flag and last push time.

### `gizmodo_article`

Get Gizmodo article content. Returns public Gizmodo article metadata and body paragraphs from a canonical article URL. Gizmodo articles are free to read, so the full body is returned.

### `gizmodo_author`

Get a Gizmodo author profile. Returns a Gizmodo author's name, job title, biography, headshot, social links, and most recent articles from a canonical author URL.

### `gizmodo_headlines`

Get Gizmodo section headlines. Returns the latest Gizmodo headlines for one section. 'section' is required and takes a slug such as 'gadgets', 'artificial-intelligence', 'io9', 'science' or 'deals'; any other value returns an invalid-params error. Each item has its title, URL, summary, publication time, author and image. Use 'gizmodo-sections' to list the slugs.

### `gizmodo_news`

Get Gizmodo top stories. Returns Gizmodo's current top stories from the main site-wide listing, with no parameters. Each item has its title, URL, summary, publication time, author and lead image.

### `gizmodo_sections`

Get Gizmodo sections. Returns the Gizmodo section inventory: its five top-level verticals (Tech, Science, io9, Earther, Reviews), their sub-topics, and Deals, each linking to its public RSS feed. Every slug is accepted by the headlines endpoint.

### `globalnews_article`

Get Global News article content. Returns one Global News article by 'url', a canonical 'globalnews.ca' link of the form '/news/<id>/<slug>/' or '/the-curator/<id>/<slug>/'. The response has the title, description, section, authors, lead image, publish and update times, the body as 'paragraphs', and a 'paywalled' flag.

### `globalnews_author`

Get a Global News author profile. Returns a Global News author profile by 'url', a canonical 'https://globalnews.ca/author/<slug>/' link. The response has the author's 'name', 'biography', 'image_url' and a list of recent articles. 'title', 'image_url' and 'biography' appear only if the author page shows them, and each article's 'published_at' is relative text such as '2 hours' or 'Sep 16', not a timestamp.

### `globalnews_headlines`

Get Global News section headlines. Returns recent Global News headlines for one section. 'section' is required and takes a slug such as 'canada', 'world', 'money', 'us-news', 'the-curator' or a local-station slug like 'toronto' or 'calgary'. Each item has its title and URL, plus summary, author, publication time and image when the outlet provides them.

### `globalnews_news`

Get Global News top stories. Returns the latest top stories from Global News (globalnews.ca), with no parameters. Each item has its title and URL, plus summary, author, publication time and image when the outlet provides them, so it works as a quick check on what the outlet is leading with.

### `globalnews_sections`

Get Global News RSS sections. Returns the public Global News RSS section inventory used by the headlines endpoint, covering topical sections and every regional/city hub with its own feed.

### `globeandmail_article`

Get a Globe and Mail article's content. Returns one public Globe and Mail article's metadata and full body paragraphs from a canonical article URL. The Globe and Mail runs a metered paywall on most staff-bylined stories; those return a 403 permission error rather than a truncated or fabricated body -- see the endpoint markdown for the exact detection method.

### `globeandmail_author`

Get a Globe and Mail reporter profile. Returns one Globe and Mail reporter's public profile: name, job title, location, biography, headshot, contact/social links, and their recent articles from a canonical author URL.

### `globeandmail_headlines`

Get the latest stories in a Globe and Mail section. Returns the current public feed for one Globe and Mail section: each story's title, canonical URL, summary, author, publication time, and lead image. Section must be one of the slugs returned by /globeandmail/sections: 'canada', 'world', 'business', 'investing', 'personal-finance', 'politics', 'opinion', 'culture', 'sports', 'life', 'real-estate', 'drive'.

### `globeandmail_news`

Get the latest Globe and Mail stories. Returns The Globe and Mail's current public top-stories feed: each story's title, canonical URL, summary, author, publication time, and lead image.

### `globeandmail_sections`

List Globe and Mail sections. Lists every Globe and Mail section accepted by /globeandmail/headlines, with its slug, display name, and landing-page URL. This is the full public, RSS-backed section taxonomy from the site's primary navigation.

### `gmanews_article`

Get GMA News article content. Returns public GMA News Online article metadata and body paragraphs from a canonical article URL. GMA News articles are free to read; no content is paywalled.

### `gmanews_headlines`

Get GMA News section headlines. Returns up to 15 of the newest GMA News Online stories for one section, newest first. 'section' is required and takes one of 44 slugs such as 'topstories-world', 'money-economy', 'sports-nba' or 'showbiz'. Each item has 'title', 'url', 'summary', 'published_at' (UTC) and 'image_url'. Quiet sections can return only a few items. An invalid or missing 'section' returns 400.

### `gmanews_news`

Get GMA News top stories. Returns fresh GMA News Online top stories from the public top-stories RSS feed, with title, URL, summary, publish time, and thumbnail.

### `gmanews_sections`

Get GMA News sections. Lists the 44 GMA News Online sections accepted by 'gmanews-headlines', each with a 'slug', display 'name' and 'url'. Slugs run from 'topstories' and 'money' to sub-sections such as 'sports-basketball' and 'lifestyle-travel'. Video, photo and TV-show sections are excluded. Takes no parameters.

### `goat_collection`

Get a GOAT curated product collection. Returns a page of one of GOAT's curated product collections (an editorial rail like "top trending" or "new arrivals"), as shown in GOAT's own product-page "you may also like" rails and homepage modules. Collection slugs are not enumerable by this API -- capture one from a live GOAT page.

### `goat_countries`

Get GOAT countries. Returns every country GOAT recognizes -- the accepted values for GET /goat/product/{slug}'s country_code parameter -- with the currency and size unit (us, uk, eu) GOAT localizes to for each, plus whether GOAT ships and accepts returns there. Every country is listed, not only the shippable ones, because country_code localizes pricing and is accepted for all of them; filter on ships_to if you want only GOAT's shipping destinations.

### `goat_curated`

Get GOAT curated links. Returns the shelf of editorially curated links GOAT is currently promoting in its own search box: seasonal collections, specific product searches, and browse-all entry points. Every link is actionable against this API -- a collection link carries a value for GET /goat/collection, a search link carries a query for GET /goat/search.

### `goat_listings_count`

Get GOAT live listing count. Returns how many listings GOAT currently has live across its whole marketplace. This is the only way to see GOAT's true catalog size, because GET /goat/search's total_results saturates at 10000 on a broad query and cannot report a total above that ceiling.

### `goat_product`

Get GOAT product detail. Returns a GOAT product: identity/descriptive metadata (name, brand, SKU, colorway, designer, silhouette, taxonomy, materials, release date, retail price, editorial story, images, full size range, other products featured alongside it), plus live per-size/condition pricing and stock status (lowest price, GOAT Instant Ship price, last sold price, highest current buyer offer).

### `goat_product_recommended`

Get GOAT recommended products for a product. Returns the recommended/related products GOAT's own product page shows for a given product (other colorways, similar products) -- descriptive metadata only, no live pricing.

### `goat_search`

Search GOAT products. Searches or browses GOAT's sneaker/streetwear/collectibles catalog by free-text query and/or facet filters (category, footwear sub-type, activity, color, gender, condition, brand, release year, price range, release-date range, silhouette, designer, in-stock/under-retail/instant-ship, curated collection), returning product summaries (brand, silhouette, category, image, stock status, headline pricing across all sizes) plus the total matching count. Query is optional -- a facet filter alone browses the catalog the same way GOAT's own category/brand pages do.

### `goat_search_facets`

Get GOAT search facet values. Returns the accepted values for goat_search's filter parameters: categories, colors, genders, conditions, brands, and years are returned live so a value GOAT adds is discoverable without any client-side change, while product_types and activities are served from a maintained list because GOAT exposes no live facet for them. brands is GOAT's top brands ordered by product count, not the complete brand list -- when brands_truncated is true, brands beyond the ones listed exist and remain valid goat_search values.

### `goat_suggest`

Autocomplete a GOAT search. Returns GOAT's own search-box autocomplete for a partial query: matching curated collections and matching products. The collections carry the slug values accepted by GET /goat/collection and by GET /goat/search's collection_slug parameter, making this the way to discover collection slugs.

### `goat_trending_searches`

Get GOAT trending searches. Returns the search terms GOAT is currently surfacing as popular, in GOAT's own ranking order -- the same list its own search box shows. Each term is free text ready to pass to GET /goat/search's query parameter.

### `goldin_auctions`

List Goldin's full auction history. Goldin's complete auction event history, back to 2012 -- title, type, status, start/end window, and buyer's premium for every auction Goldin has run. Pass an auction's own id as auction_id to goldin-search to browse its lots.

### `goldin_categories`

List Goldin's search filter enums. Goldin's full filter-enum surface for goldin-search, scoped to one lot pool -- category, sub_category, certification, item_type, and the live auction list (each with its own id, name, and current lot count), plus the sort enum valid for that pool. category/sub_category/certification/item_type are read live from Goldin's own current inventory, not a fixed taxonomy, so results can shift over time. The Auction pool (default) and the Fixed Price "Private Sales" marketplace are disjoint item pools with different certification/item_type values and different sort enums -- pass the same auction_type here and to goldin-search.

### `goldin_listing`

Get one Goldin lot's full public detail. One lot's full public detail: title, description, current bid/starting price, auction window and status, grading info, images, and prev/next lot pointers within the same auction. slug is the meta_slug from a goldin-search result (or the trailing path segment of the lot's own goldin.co/item/{slug} page URL).

### `goldin_search`

Search Goldin's lot auction inventory. Browse or search Goldin's current lot inventory by free-text keyword, category, sub_category, certification, item_type, and auction_id, in a caller-selected sort order. Every filter is optional and combines with AND semantics. All enum values come from goldin-categories -- pass the matching auction_type to both. The Auction pool (default) and the Fixed Price "Private Sales" marketplace are disjoint item pools with different certification/item_type values and different sort enums.

### `goldin_suggest`

Get Goldin's search suggestions for a keyword. Goldin's own search-suggestions/autocomplete for a partial keyword, matching the site's own search box typeahead. keyword is optional -- when omitted, returns Goldin's current trending/popular searches instead of an error.

### `goodreads_author`

Get a Goodreads author. Returns a Goodreads author profile: bio, birth/death dates, website, genres, photo, and aggregate rating stats.

### `goodreads_author_books`

List a Goodreads author's books. Lists the books of a Goodreads author by author 'id', about 30 per page; 'page' is 1-based and defaults to 1. Each book has its 'id', title, author, average rating, ratings count and Goodreads URL, and the 'id' can be used to look up the full book.

### `goodreads_author_quotes`

List a Goodreads author's attributed quotes. Returns an author's paginated attributed-quotes list (quote text, tags, like count, and — when the quote is credited to a specific book — that book's title, id, and work id).

### `goodreads_book`

Get a Goodreads book. Returns a Goodreads book: description, authors, series, genres, format, pages, publisher, publication date, ISBNs, and aggregate rating with the full 1-5 star distribution.

### `goodreads_book_editions`

List a Goodreads book's editions. Returns a work's paginated edition list (per-edition book id, format, page count, publication date, publisher, ISBN/ISBN13/ASIN, language, and rating) — every other translation, printing, and format of the requested book id. Goodreads keys editions by a separate "work id", not the book id in the path; requests against a book with no editions data return an upstream error.

### `goodreads_book_reviews`

Get a Goodreads book's featured reviews. Returns a book's featured reviews (reviewer, rating, text, date, like/comment counts, spoiler flag), sorted by like count.

### `goodreads_genre`

Get a Goodreads genre shelf. Returns up to 50 books on a Goodreads genre/shelf tag page (e.g. fantasy, romance, science-fiction), Goodreads' per-tag "top books" view: title, author, average rating, ratings count, publication year, and how many times the book was shelved under this specific tag. Goodreads' genre/shelf taxonomy is an open, user-generated folksonomy of thousands of tags, not a small fixed list, so there is no directory endpoint — pass any known tag slug, e.g. from a book's genres[] field or a value seen on goodreads.com. There is no pagination beyond the first 50.

### `goodreads_list`

Get a Goodreads Listopia list. Returns a Goodreads Listopia list (ranked book list) by id, paginated.

### `goodreads_lists`

List curated Goodreads Listopia lists. Returns a catalog of well-known Goodreads Listopia lists (id, name, category). Goodreads has no directory or search endpoint for the tens of thousands of user-created lists, so this is served from a live popular-lists source when available, falling back to a curated, hand-picked catalog otherwise. Pass a returned id to GET /goodreads/list/{id} for that list's ranked book contents. Category enum: 'general', 'genre', 'era', 'young_adult', 'children', 'holiday'.

### `goodreads_search`

Search Goodreads books. Searches Goodreads for books by title or author using 'q', returning up to 'limit' results (default 10, max 50). Each result has its id, title, author and author id, average rating, ratings count, page count, a truncated description, cover image URL and Goodreads URL. Only books are returned, not authors or lists.

### `goodrx_answer`

Get a GoodRx health question and answer. Returns one GoodRx health question with its short answer, supporting paragraphs, the source article, the drug it is about, more questions about that drug, related articles, and related medications. Use a slug from /goodrx/answers.

### `goodrx_answers`

List GoodRx health questions. Returns GoodRx's medication and health questions: the index's top questions and every question with its slug, grouped by drug where GoodRx's index groups it (questions GoodRx lists only in its sitemap carry just their slug). Use a slug with /goodrx/answer.

### `goodrx_brands`

List GoodRx featured brand-name drugs. Lists the brand-name drugs GoodRx features on its brand-name drugs page. Each entry has the drug name, 'slug', GoodRx URL, description, information URL and lowest price where shown. The 'slug' feeds the drug prices endpoint. If GoodRx is unreachable, a retained copy up to about a day old is returned and flagged with an 'X-Availability-Mode: stale' header.

### `goodrx_class`

List drugs in a GoodRx drug class. Returns the drugs GoodRx lists for one drug class, with each drug's lowest displayed price and summary. Use a slug from /goodrx/classes.

### `goodrx_classes`

List GoodRx drug classes. Lists the drug classes in GoodRx's class directory, such as ACE Inhibitors, with each class name, GoodRx URL and the 'slug' used to look up that class. If GoodRx is unreachable, a retained copy up to about a day old is returned and flagged with an 'X-Availability-Mode: stale' header.

### `goodrx_comparison`

Get a GoodRx drug comparison. Returns a GoodRx head-to-head drug comparison's key takeaways and the two drugs compared, with their price-page and information slugs. Use a slug from /goodrx/comparisons or /goodrx/drug-info alternatives.

### `goodrx_comparisons`

List GoodRx drug comparisons. Lists GoodRx's head-to-head drug comparisons grouped by health topic, for example ADHD. Each comparison has a name, a 'slug' for the comparison lookup and its GoodRx URL. If GoodRx is unreachable, a retained copy up to about a day old is returned and flagged with an 'X-Availability-Mode: stale' header.

### `goodrx_condition`

Get a GoodRx health condition overview. Returns a health condition's GoodRx overview article as titled sections (definition, types, causes, symptoms, diagnosis, medications, treatments, prevention, references), with the condition's alternate name, authors, publish and modified dates, the medications-list URL, and related articles. Use a slug from /goodrx/conditions.

### `goodrx_condition_drugs`

List GoodRx medications for a condition. Returns the medications GoodRx lists for one health condition, with each drug's lowest displayed price and summary. Use a slug from /goodrx/conditions whose has_medications is true.

### `goodrx_conditions`

List GoodRx health conditions. Lists the health conditions in GoodRx's conditions directory, with each condition's name, 'slug' and GoodRx URL. 'has_medications' tells you whether GoodRx publishes a medications list for that condition. If GoodRx is unreachable, a retained copy up to about a day old is returned and flagged with an 'X-Availability-Mode: stale' header.

### `goodrx_drug_guide`

Get a GoodRx drug guide. Returns one dedicated GoodRx drug guide. side-effects: common and less common side effects with reported frequencies, serious and reported side effects, and the label source. dosage: coupon price per dosage and quantity for each dosage form, and typical dosing. interactions: interacting drugs grouped by severity (not_recommended, usually_not_recommended, increased_risk), with GoodRx slugs where linked. Includes reviewer, last-reviewed date, and related guides. Use pairs from /goodrx/drug-guides; a drug without that guide returns 404. Requests use US egress because GoodRx is US-only.

### `goodrx_drug_guides`

List GoodRx drug guides. Returns GoodRx's dedicated drug guide pages (side effects, dosage, and interactions) as drug slug and topic pairs with last-modified dates, optionally filtered by topic and by the first character of the drug slug. Use the pairs with /goodrx/drug-guide.

### `goodrx_drug_info`

Get GoodRx drug information. Returns a drug's GoodRx information page as titled sections (uses, side effects, pros and cons, pharmacist tips, risks and warnings, dosage, interactions, contraindications, alternatives, pill images, references, and common questions), plus authors, publish and review dates, FAQs, and comparison links to alternatives. With audience=pets it returns the drug's cat and dog page (veterinary uses, side effects, and dosing) for drugs listed by /goodrx/pet-medications; other drugs return 404. Requests use US egress because GoodRx is US-only.

### `goodrx_drug_options`

List a GoodRx drug's prescription options. Returns every brand and generic label, dosage form, strength, and quantity GoodRx prices for one drug, with GoodRx's default prescription. Use these values for /goodrx/drug-prices.

### `goodrx_drug_prices`

Get GoodRx drug prices by pharmacy. Returns GoodRx coupon, membership, and mail-order prices by pharmacy for one drug and prescription (brand/generic label, form, dosage, quantity), plus the drug summary, the priced configuration, the location prices were computed for, and every available label/form/dosage/quantity. Omit label/form/dosage/quantity for GoodRx's default prescription; values must come from /goodrx/drug-options. Pass latitude and longitude (optionally zip_code and state) to price at a US location; otherwise prices reflect a US location chosen by GoodRx. Requests use US egress because GoodRx is US-only.

### `goodrx_drugs`

List GoodRx drugs by letter. Lists the drugs GoodRx files under one letter of its A-Z directory, chosen with the required 'letter' ('a' to 'z'). Each drug has its name, price-page 'slug', GoodRx URL and drug-information URL. If GoodRx is unreachable, a retained copy up to about a day old is returned and flagged with an 'X-Availability-Mode: stale' header.

### `goodrx_health_article`

Get a GoodRx Health article. Returns one GoodRx Health article: headline, description, authors, medical reviewers, published and modified dates, category tag, key takeaways, the body as headed sections of paragraphs and lists, FAQs, references, and related medications. Requests use US egress because GoodRx is US-only.

### `goodrx_health_articles`

List GoodRx Health articles. Returns one page of GoodRx Health articles in a section, optionally one topic, most recently modified first: each article's path, section, topic, URL, and last-modified date, with total and total pages. Use a path with /goodrx/health-article.

### `goodrx_health_topics`

List GoodRx Health article topics. Returns every GoodRx Health article topic as section and topic pairs with article counts and last-modified dates, optionally for one section. Sections: conditions, health-topic, well-being, pet-health, insurance, classes, drugs, healthcare-access, corporate, hcp (clinician resources), and drug (articles about one drug; the topic is the drug slug). Use the pairs with /goodrx/health-articles.

### `goodrx_pet_medications`

List GoodRx pet medications. Lists the drugs that have a GoodRx information page for cats and dogs (21 on 2026-10-03). Each entry has the drug 'slug' and the URL of its pet page; the 'slug' can be passed to the drug information lookup with 'audience=pets'. A retained copy up to about a day old is returned, flagged 'X-Availability-Mode: stale', if GoodRx is unreachable.

### `google_finance_analyst_articles`

Google Finance analyst articles. Returns the analyst articles Google Finance shows for a quote such as 'AAPL:NASDAQ'. Each article has its title, source, URL, publication time (ISO and Unix), thumbnail and the related instruments with price, change and exchange. Articles come back only when Google Finance has them for that quote.

### `google_finance_chart`

Google Finance chart data. Returns the price chart for a Google Finance quote such as 'AAPL:NASDAQ' or 'BTC-USD' over a window from '1d' to 'max' (default '1d'). Each point has a time, price and volume; the response also carries the instrument's name, exchange, currency, current price, change and previous close.

### `google_finance_classification`

Google Finance classification data. Returns the category labels Google Finance assigns to a quote such as 'AAPL:NASDAQ', for example Technology, in 'categories'. The response also carries the instrument itself: ticker, exchange, name, current price, change, previous close, currency and after-hours data.

### `google_finance_company`

Google Finance company data. Returns Google Finance company details for a quote such as 'AAPL:NASDAQ': description, CEO, employee count, headquarters, sector, market capitalisation, P/E ratio, open, day high and low, 52-week high and low, and volume.

### `google_finance_context`

Find Google Finance instruments by query. Searches Google Finance for instruments matching a company name or ticker query and returns results with ticker, exchange, name, price, currency, and change data. Use a returned ticker with quote, company, chart, or news endpoints.

### `google_finance_financials`

Google Finance financial statements. Returns the financial statements Google Finance holds for a quote such as 'AAPL:NASDAQ', as 'annual' and 'quarterly' rows plus a 'currency'. Each row has revenue, net income, EBITDA, EPS, margins, cash flow, assets, liabilities and equity. The rows are empty when Google Finance has no statement data for the quote.

### `google_finance_markets_category_news`

Google Finance category news. Returns Google Finance news for one market category, identified by the 'category' path id. Use 'offset' to page through results. Each item has its title, URL and publication time (ISO and Unix), plus the source, a thumbnail and any related quotes with price, change and percent change when Google provides them. The response also echoes 'category' and 'offset'.

### `google_finance_markets_category_stocks`

Google Finance category stocks. Lists the instruments in one Google Finance market category, chosen by the required 'category' id and paged with 'offset'. Each item has its ticker, exchange, name, price, change and change percent, previous close, currency, country and after-hours data.

### `google_finance_markets_earnings`

Google Finance earnings calendar. Returns the Google Finance earnings calendar. Each item has the company name, fiscal period, event time (including a Unix timestamp), conference call phone and URL when listed, and the instrument with its ticker, exchange, price and change.

### `google_finance_markets_featured`

Google Finance featured stocks. Returns the stocks Google Finance features on its markets page. Each instrument has its ticker, exchange, name, price, change and change percent, previous close, currency, country, time zone and after-hours data.

### `google_finance_markets_headline`

Google Finance top headline. Returns the top headline on Google Finance markets as one article: title, source, URL, publication time (ISO and Unix), thumbnail and the related instruments with price and change. The article is present only when Google Finance shows a headline.

### `google_finance_markets_indices`

Google Finance market indices. Returns the market indices Google Finance lists, such as the Dow Jones Industrial Average. Each index has its ticker, exchange, name, current value, change and change percent, previous close and last update time.

### `google_finance_markets_movers`

Google Finance market movers. Lists Google Finance market movers. 'categories' takes comma-separated numeric categories, 'count' sets how many items to return (default 20) and 'offset' skips ahead. Each item has its ticker, exchange, name, price, change and change percent, and previous close.

### `google_finance_markets_top`

Google Finance top stocks by metric. Lists the top Google Finance instruments for a ranking metric. 'metric' is a Google Finance metric id (default 6) and 'page' is the page number (default 1). Each item has its ticker, exchange, name, price, change and change percent, and previous close.

### `google_finance_markets_trending`

Google Finance trending stocks. Returns the instruments currently trending on Google Finance, up to 'limit' items (default 18). Each has its ticker, exchange, name, price, change and change percent, previous close, currency and after-hours data.

### `google_finance_news`

Google Finance quote news. Returns recent Google Finance news for one quote, such as 'AAPL:NASDAQ', given in the 'quote' path parameter. 'limit' caps the number of articles and defaults to 6. Each article has its title, source, URL, publication time (ISO and Unix), thumbnail, and related quotes with price and change data.

### `google_finance_quote`

Google Finance Quote API. Returns the Google Finance quote page for a symbol such as 'AAPL:NASDAQ' or 'BTC-USD'. The response carries key stats, an about section (CEO, employees, founded, headquarters, website), news, and investment tables for the income statement, balance sheet and cash flow by quarter and year.

### `google_finance_related`

Google Finance related instruments. Returns the instruments Google Finance lists as related to a quote such as 'AAPL:NASDAQ'. The response gives the queried 'instrument' and an 'items' list, each with ticker, exchange, name, price, change and change percent, and previous close.

### `google_finance_search`
