IMDb title public facts analysis. Returns derived public-page summary metrics for IMDb trivia, goofs, quotes, keywords, filming locations, and company credits. This endpoint is not viewing advice. Pass exactly one of 'id' or 'url'. The six sections are gathered from six independent sources, so a section that cannot be fetched is omitted and named in 'missing_sections' with 'partial' set to 'true', rather than failing the whole response; an error is returned only when no section could be fetched. Callers that require a complete analysis should check 'partial'.

### `imdb_title_quotes`

IMDb title quotes. Returns the quotes IMDb lists for a title. Pass exactly one of 'id' or 'url'. Each entry in 'facts' is a whole exchange, with lines prefixed by the speaker, plus a 'spoiler' flag. 'total' is the count IMDb lists, so a short list is normal on popular titles.

### `imdb_title_ratings`

IMDb title ratings breakdown. Returns IMDb's aggregate rating, vote count, ten rating buckets, and country rating summaries. Pass exactly one of 'id' or 'url'.

### `imdb_title_release_info`

IMDb title release info. Returns the release dates and alternate titles IMDb lists for a title. Pass exactly one of 'id' or 'url'. Releases have a country, date and note; alternate titles have a country, title and type. Both lists are often shorter than 'total' and 'alternate_titles_total'.

### `imdb_title_reviews`

IMDb title user reviews. Returns public IMDb user review rows. Limit defaults to 10 and clamps to 20. Pass exactly one of 'id' or 'url'.

### `imdb_title_similar`

IMDb similar titles. Returns the titles in IMDb's More like this recommendations for a title. Pass exactly one of 'id' (such as 'tt0111161') or 'url'. Each title has its id, name, URL, year, type, runtime, content rating, rating, rating count and image.

### `imdb_title_technical_specs`

IMDb title technical specs. Returns public IMDb technical specifications such as runtime, sound mix, color, and aspect ratio. Pass exactly one of 'id' or 'url'.

### `imdb_title_trivia`

IMDb title trivia. Returns the trivia IMDb lists for a title. Pass exactly one of 'id' or 'url'. Each entry in 'facts' has the text, a 'spoiler' flag and, for grouped items, a category such as Director Trademark. 'total' is the count IMDb lists and 'has_more' is true when only part is returned.

### `imdb_title_videos`

IMDb title video metadata. Returns public title video metadata and thumbnail URLs only; playback URLs and media manifests are never returned. IMDb server-truncates this connection and exposes no usable continuation cursor, so 'total' can exceed returned rows and 'has_more' reports that condition. Limit defaults to 50 and clamps to 100. Pass exactly one of 'id' or 'url'.

### `importyeti_company`

Get an ImportYeti company report. Returns an ImportYeti company report: identity, headline US customs shipment-volume metrics (total shipments, average TEU, last shipment date, estimated shipping spend), its supplier list, and recent bill-of-lading shipment activity.

### `importyeti_search`

Search ImportYeti companies and suppliers by name. Searches ImportYeti for companies and suppliers matching a name, returning each match's kind (company or supplier), slug, country, address, and headline shipment stats. A "company" result's slug chains into GET /importyeti/company.

### `indeed_job`

Indeed job detail. Returns one Indeed job posting by its job key (the 'job_key' field returned by search).

### `indeed_locations_suggest`

Indeed location suggestions. Returns Indeed's own location-search autocomplete suggestions for a partial location string -- the same suggestions the app's search bar offers -- for building a valid 'l' value for search.

### `indeed_search`

Indeed job search. Searches Indeed job postings by keyword and location. 'sort' enum: 'relevance' (default), 'date'.

### `independent_article`

Get The Independent article content. Returns one The Independent article by 'url', which must be a canonical HTTPS 'independent.co.uk' article link. The response has the title, description, section, authors, publication and update times, lead image URL, body 'paragraphs' and a 'paywalled' flag.

### `independent_author`

Get an Independent author profile. Returns one Independent author's profile by 'slug' (for example 'lizzie-dearden') or 'url'; exactly one is required. The response has name, job title, bio, X/Twitter handle and the author's recent articles with title, URL, section and section URL. It is a single page of articles with no further pagination.

### `independent_headlines`

Get The Independent section headlines. Returns the current headlines for one The Independent section. 'section' is required and takes one of 17 slugs, such as 'news/uk', 'news/world', 'sport', 'voices', 'money' or 'bulletin'. Each item has its title and URL, plus summary, author, publication time and image when the outlet provides them, and the response echoes the 'section'.

### `independent_news`

Get The Independent top stories. Returns the current top stories from The Independent. It takes no parameters. Each item has its title, URL and, where the outlet gives them, a summary, author, publication time, image URL and 'type'. Use the headlines endpoint for one section.

### `independent_sections`

Get The Independent RSS sections. Lists the 17 The Independent section slugs that the headlines endpoint accepts, from 'news' and 'news/uk' to 'life-style', 'voices', 'money' and 'bulletin'. Each entry has a 'slug', a display 'name' and a 'url'.

### `indianexpress_article`

Get The Indian Express article content. Returns public The Indian Express article metadata and body paragraphs from a canonical article URL. A story gated behind an Express Premium subscription returns a permission error instead of a truncated or paid body.

### `indianexpress_author`

Get a The Indian Express author profile. Returns a The Indian Express author's profile by 'url', a canonical 'indianexpress.com/profile/author/<slug>/' link: name, image URL, biography and recent articles with title, URL, summary and image. 'image_url' and 'biography' may be missing, and 'published_at' is the page's date text such as 'Sep 24, 2026 16:36 IST', not a timestamp.

### `indianexpress_headlines`

Get The Indian Express section headlines. Returns the current headlines for one The Indian Express section. 'section' is required and takes a slug such as 'india', 'explained', 'cities-delhi', 'entertainment-bollywood', 'sports-cricket' or 'political-pulse'. Items carry title, URL, summary, author, publication time and image, and the response echoes the 'section'.

### `indianexpress_news`

Get The Indian Express top stories. Returns the current top stories from The Indian Express. It takes no parameters. Each item has its title, URL and, where the outlet gives them, a summary, author, publication time, image URL and 'type'. Use the headlines endpoint to read one section.

### `indianexpress_sections`

Get The Indian Express RSS sections. Lists the The Indian Express section slugs that the headlines endpoint accepts, including 'politics', 'india', 'explained', 'cities-mumbai', 'entertainment-tamil', 'lifestyle-health' and 'smart-stocks'. Each entry has a 'slug', a display 'name' and a section 'url'.

### `indiatoday_article`

Get India Today article content. Returns public India Today article metadata and body paragraphs from a canonical story URL. Subscriber-only magazine stories return only the public teaser with paywalled set to true.

### `indiatoday_author`

Get an India Today author profile. Returns an India Today author profile by 'url', a canonical 'https://www.indiatoday.in/author/<slug>' link; desk bylines such as 'india-today-business-desk' work too. The response has the name, job title, headshot, biography and the first page of recent text stories (typically 20), each with title, URL, section, summary and image. Stories carry no dates.

### `indiatoday_headlines`

Get India Today section headlines. Returns the text stories listed on one India Today section page, typically 12 to 60. 'section' is required and takes one of 35 slugs such as 'top-news', 'cricket', 'markets', 'bollywood' or 'fact-check'; other values return 400. Items have title, URL, 'type', summary and image when shown, but no 'published_at'.

### `indiatoday_news`

Get India Today top stories. Returns fresh India Today top stories from its public RSS feed (text stories only; video and photo items are omitted).

### `indiatoday_sections`

Get India Today sections. Lists the 35 India Today sections accepted by 'indiatoday-headlines', such as 'top-news', 'south-india', 'markets', 'ott', 'elections' and 'history-of-it'. Each entry has a 'slug', display 'name' and the section page 'url'. Takes no parameters.

### `indiewire_article`

Get IndieWire article content. Returns public IndieWire article metadata (title, author(s), published/updated dates, section, lead image) and the body paragraphs an anonymous visitor sees, from a canonical article URL. Paywalled content is never bypassed; a gated story would return only its public portion.

### `indiewire_author`

Get an IndieWire author profile. Returns one IndieWire staff writer or contributor's public profile: name, headshot, biography, any listed social/contact links, and one page of their recent articles.

### `indiewire_headlines`

Get IndieWire section headlines. Returns fresh headlines from one public IndieWire section feed. Gallery and list pages are omitted because they are not text articles.

### `indiewire_news`

Get IndieWire top stories. Returns IndieWire's current top stories on independent film, TV and awards, with no parameters. Each item has its title, URL, one-sentence summary, author and publication time. Gallery and list pages are left out because they are not text articles.

### `indiewire_sections`

Get IndieWire sections. Lists IndieWire's 32 editorial categories accepted by 'indiewire-headlines', such as 'analysis', 'box-office', 'festivals', 'interviews', 'obituary' and 'trailers'. Each entry has a 'slug', display 'name' and the category feed 'url'. Categories nest under the roots 'news', 'features', 'awards' and 'criticism'.

### `inews_article`

Get i article content. Returns public i article metadata (headline, description, section, authors, publish/update times, lead image) and body paragraphs from a canonical article URL.

### `inews_author`

Get an i author profile. Returns an author profile from i (inews.co.uk) by 'url', a canonical 'https://inews.co.uk/author/<slug>' link. The response has 'name', 'bio', 'image_url', 'same_as' social profiles and up to about 30 recent articles, each with title, URL, summary, section and 'published_at'. Paginated or non-author URLs return 400, and an unknown author returns 404.

### `inews_headlines`

Get i section headlines. Returns fresh headlines from one public i section feed. The section must be a slug returned by the sections endpoint.

### `inews_news`

Get i top stories. Returns fresh i (inews.co.uk) top stories from the site's public RSS feed, with summary, author, publish time, and lead image when present.

### `inews_sections`

Get i sections. Lists the 45 i sections accepted by 'inews-headlines', from 'home' and 'news' to 'football', 'money' and 'relationships'. Each entry has a 'slug', display 'name' and 'url'. 'home' is the site-wide listing, and low-volume sections such as 'golf' or 'comedy' may hold only one or two items.

### `inquirer_article`

Get Philippine Daily Inquirer article content. Returns public Philippine Daily Inquirer article metadata and body paragraphs from a canonical article URL on any of its ten public news subdomains.

### `inquirer_author`

Get a Philippine Daily Inquirer author profile. Returns one Philippine Daily Inquirer byline's public archive page: the contributor's name and their recent articles on that subdomain, from a canonical byline URL. Byline pages are per-subdomain, so an author's articles from a different section require calling this endpoint again with that section's own byline URL.

### `inquirer_headlines`

Get Philippine Daily Inquirer section headlines. Returns the latest Philippine Daily Inquirer stories for one section. 'section' is required and takes 'newsinfo', 'globalnation', 'business', 'sports', 'entertainment', 'lifestyle', 'technology', 'opinion', 'usa' or 'cebudailynews'. Each item has its title, URL, summary, publication time, author and lead image.

### `inquirer_news`

Get Philippine Daily Inquirer top stories. Returns the latest top stories from the Philippine Daily Inquirer's flagship national-news site, newsinfo.inquirer.net. Takes no parameters. Each item has its title, URL, summary, publication time, author and lead image.

### `inquirer_sections`

Get Philippine Daily Inquirer sections. Lists the ten Philippine Daily Inquirer sections that 'inquirer-headlines' accepts, from 'newsinfo' to 'cebudailynews'. Each entry has a 'slug', a display 'name' and the section's 'url'. Takes no parameters.

### `instacart_departments`

Get Instacart store department taxonomy. Returns a store's department/category taxonomy (Produce, Dairy & Eggs, Bakery, ...) two levels deep -- department and subcategory. Metadata only, does not return products. Public data sourced from Instacart's own storefront navigation.

### `instacart_item`

Get Instacart product detail at a store. Returns a single product's detail at a specific Instacart store: name, size, brand, image, current pricing (with any sale/offer badge), availability, stock level, dietary labels, and nutrition facts. Public data sourced from Instacart's own storefront pages.

### `instacart_search`

Search Instacart product terms at a store. Returns Instacart's own search-term autosuggestions for a keyword within one store -- the same suggestion list shown in the site's own search box dropdown. This is term-level (matching search phrases plus a representative thumbnail), not a paginated product-results list. Public data sourced from Instacart's own storefront search.

### `instacart_search_nearby`

Search Instacart product terms near a postal code. Returns Instacart's own search-term autosuggestions for a keyword across every retailer serving a postal code at once, rather than one specific store. Public data sourced from Instacart's own cross-retailer search.

### `instacart_stores`

Find Instacart stores near a postal code. Finds Instacart retailer storefronts (grocery stores, warehouse clubs, and other partner retailers) serving a US postal code, each with the identifiers needed to look up its items and search suggestions. Public data sourced from Instacart's own store-discovery API.

### `instacart_trending`

Get Instacart trending search terms near a postal code. Returns Instacart's own popular/trending search terms across every retailer serving a postal code -- the same blank-state suggestions shown before a user types anything into the search box. Public data sourced from Instacart's own cross-retailer search.

### `instagram_comments`

Retrieve paginated Instagram comments. Returns top-level comments for a public Instagram post or Reel. 'reply_count' is included when the logged-out source exposes it; reply bodies are not available on this anonymous surface. Pass 'paging_info.max_id' back as 'max_id' for the next comment page.

### `instagram_post`

Retrieve a specific Instagram post by URL shortcode. Returns media details for an Instagram URL shortcode. Use media.code from the reels response or shortcode from a public post URL; numeric media IDs are rejected.

### `instagram_profile`

Retrieve an Instagram user profile by username. Returns the public profile of an Instagram account by 'username'. The response has the user id, full name, biography, bio links, external URL, category, follower, following and post counts, verified and private flags, location, profile picture, recent posts with captions and like counts, and related profiles.

### `instagram_reels`

Retrieve Instagram Reels for a user. Returns up to 12 public Reels via anonymous proxied HTTP for the numeric Instagram user ID. Supports opaque 'max_id' pagination. Captions, timestamps and original image dimensions are omitted when the public source does not expose them.

### `instagram_user_posts`

Retrieve paginated Instagram user posts. Returns public posts and Reels from the logged-out Posts tab for an Instagram username. Each item exposes the fields available in Instagram's public grid; source-omitted metrics and dimensions are not inferred. Pass 'paging_info.max_id' back as 'max_id' for the next page.

### `investopedia_article`

Get Investopedia article content. Returns metadata (title, description, dates, section, authors, image) and body paragraphs for a public Investopedia page that uses the article template: news stories, dictionary terms (/terms/...), explainers and Q&A pages (/articles/..., /ask/answers/..., and similar), and product roundups. Section listing pages and author profiles are rejected with a 400 that names the endpoint to use instead.

### `investopedia_author`

Get an Investopedia author or expert profile. Returns an Investopedia writer, editor, reviewer, or expert contributor's public profile (name, job title, summary, photo, credentials such as education, location, and expertise, personal social links, biography, favorite quote) and their recent articles.

### `investopedia_headlines`

Get Investopedia section headlines. Returns the current story list from one Investopedia section, with title, URL, byline, and image. section accepts any slug returned by GET /investopedia/sections.

### `investopedia_news`

Get Investopedia latest news. Returns the newest Investopedia news stories (markets, companies, earnings, economy, government, crypto, rates, and personal finance news), with title, URL, byline, and image.

### `investopedia_sections`

Get Investopedia sections. Returns the full Investopedia section inventory (43 news, investing, banking, personal finance, economy, and reviews sections), each with a slug, display name, and public listing URL. Use a returned slug as the section parameter on GET /investopedia/headlines.

### `iol_article`

Get IOL article content. Returns an IOL article by 'url', a canonical 'iol.co.za' story link. The response has the title, description, section (the deepest in the breadcrumb, such as 'Crime and Courts'), authors, lead image, publish and update times, and body 'paragraphs'. Section, author, tag and search pages are rejected. 'paywalled' is never set.

### `iol_author`

Get an IOL author profile. Returns an IOL author profile, identified by 'slug' (such as 'xolile-mtembu') or a canonical 'iol.co.za/authors/<slug>/' 'url'; provide exactly one. The response has the name, 'role' and 'image_url' when present, and up to 25 recent articles with title, URL, summary, section and a 'published_date' taken from the article URL. Unknown authors return not found.

### `iol_headlines`

Get IOL section headlines. Returns recent IOL headlines for one section path. 'section' is required and takes a value such as 'news', 'news/south-africa/gauteng', 'sport/rugby/springboks', 'business/economy' or 'entertainment/music'. Each item has its title, URL, summary, publication time and image, plus the author when the outlet names one. Unlisted values are rejected.

### `iol_news`

Get IOL top stories. Returns the 30 newest stories from IOL (Independent Online, South Africa), with no parameters. Each item has its title, canonical article URL, short summary, publication time, author byline and lead image.

### `iol_sections`

Get IOL sections. Returns the verified IOL section inventory accepted by the headlines endpoint: news, sport, business, lifestyle, entertainment, technology, motoring, travel and opinion, their sub-sections, provincial news and the sister-title feeds.

### `irishindependent_article`

Get Irish Independent article content. Returns public Irish Independent article metadata (headline, description, section, authors, publish/update times, lead image) and body paragraphs from a canonical article URL. Premium articles are served to anonymous readers as a one-paragraph teaser; those are returned with paywalled set to true and only the teaser paragraph.

### `irishindependent_author`

Get an Irish Independent author profile. Returns an Irish Independent author's name, biography, published email and social links, headshot, and their most recent articles (the first page of the profile's article list) from a canonical author URL.

### `irishindependent_headlines`

Get Irish Independent section headlines. Returns fresh headlines from one public Irish Independent section feed. The section must be a slug returned by the sections endpoint.

### `irishindependent_news`

Get Irish Independent top stories. Returns fresh Irish Independent (independent.ie) top stories from the site's public RSS feed, with summary, author, publish time, and lead image when present. Some stories are premium (subscriber) content; open them with the article endpoint to see the paywalled flag.

### `irishindependent_sections`

Get Irish Independent sections. Returns every Irish Independent section slug accepted by the headlines endpoint (national, regional and county news, sport, business, comment, lifestyle and entertainment), with its display name and public RSS feed URL.

### `irishtimes_article`

Get Irish Times article content. Returns public Irish Times article metadata and body paragraphs from a canonical article URL. A subscriber-only (premium) article returns a permission error instead of its body; metered articles are returned in full.

### `irishtimes_author`

Get an Irish Times author profile. Returns an Irish Times author's name, job title, biography, headshot, contact details, and recent articles from a canonical author URL.

### `irishtimes_headlines`

Get Irish Times section headlines. Returns current Irish Times headlines for one section. 'section' is required and takes one of 16 slugs such as 'ireland', 'politics', 'your-money', 'life-style', 'motors' or 'abroad'; other values return 400. Some listed articles are subscriber-only, and 'irishtimes-article' returns a permission error for those.

### `irishtimes_news`

Get Irish Times top stories. Returns up to 100 current Irish Times top stories from its Irish news listing, with no parameters. Each item has its title, URL, summary, author, publication time and image where available.

### `irishtimes_sections`

Get Irish Times sections. Lists the 16 Irish Times sections accepted by 'irishtimes-headlines': 'ireland', 'opinion', 'politics', 'business', 'your-money', 'world', 'sport', 'life-style', 'health', 'technology', 'culture', 'property', 'food', 'motors', 'history' and 'abroad'. Each entry has a 'slug', 'name' and 'url'.

### `japantimes_article`

Get a The Japan Times article. Returns public article metadata. If the page marks its body as blurred for anonymous visitors, paywalled is true and hidden subscriber text is omitted.

### `japantimes_author`

Get a The Japan Times author profile. Returns a The Japan Times author's name and the article cards linked from their profile page. 'url' is required and must be a canonical HTTPS profile link in the form '/author/<numeric-id>/<slug>/'. Each article has a title, URL, summary, author, image, 'type' and publication time. Paginated '/page/<n>/' URLs are not followed.

### `japantimes_headlines`

Get The Japan Times section headlines. Returns public article cards from one canonical section page. This site's section pages are HTML; only the top stories surface has a verified RSS feed.

### `japantimes_news`

Get The Japan Times top stories. Returns the current top stories from The Japan Times. It takes no parameters. Each item has its title, URL, publication time and a short publisher-written teaser in 'summary', not the article text, plus the author and image when the outlet provides them.

### `japantimes_sections`

Get The Japan Times sections. Lists the 60 sections linked from The Japan Times main navigation, which the headlines endpoint accepts, for example 'news-japan', 'business-markets', 'sports-sumo', 'culture-film' and 'community-voices'. Each entry has a 'slug', a display 'name' and a section 'url'.

### `jcrew_categories`

List J.Crew or J.Crew Factory categories. Lists every category and subcategory from the storefront's own header navigation, flattened into department/section/category triples -- resolves the category-discovery gap jcrew-category's own category parameter otherwise leaves as "find one from a storefront URL". Each entry's category value is exactly what jcrew-category's own category parameter accepts. Filter to one department with department (e.g. women, men); omit for every department. Departments vary slightly by site (jcrew.com has an extra "home" department factory.jcrew.com doesn't) -- see the response's own departments field for the live list.

### `jcrew_category`

Browse a J.Crew or J.Crew Factory category. Returns one page (up to 60 products) of a category/browse listing for a category path. category is the slash-separated path segment after the storefront's own /plp/ (e.g. womens/categories/clothing/sweaters) -- use jcrew-categories to discover every valid value instead of guessing from storefront URLs. site selects the storefront (default jcrew). page selects the SFCC-native page (default 1); result_count reports the upstream's true total regardless of page size. A hub-level (non-leaf) category path returns a well-formed empty result rather than an error.

### `jcrew_product`

Get a J.Crew or J.Crew Factory product. Returns full product detail for one style: name, brand, description, category, list price, aggregate rating, every purchasable color, and every color+size combination as a separate priced/stocked SKU. pid is a style id (e.g. CX415), as returned by jcrew-search's products[].id field. site must match the storefront the pid belongs to (default jcrew). A single call covers every color and size of the style -- no per-color lookup needed.

### `jcrew_product_reviews`

Get reviews for a J.Crew or J.Crew Factory product. Returns one page of a product's customer reviews (author, location, date, rating, headline, body, and verified-purchase flag), plus the product's overall rating summary (average rating, rating count, per-star histogram, and recommended ratio). pid is a style id (e.g. CX415), as returned by jcrew-search's products[].id field. site must match the storefront the pid belongs to (default jcrew). A product with no reviews yet, or a well-formed but unrecognized pid, returns a well-formed empty result, not an error.

### `jcrew_search`

Search J.Crew or J.Crew Factory products. Searches the product catalog for either storefront (select with site, default jcrew). Returns product summaries with USD pricing, gender, and a description, plus the search index's own facets (gender, fabric, category, size, color, price range, and others) with live per-option counts. sort selects relevance (default), price_asc, or price_desc. filter narrows results by one or more facet name:value pairs (comma-separated, e.g. productGender:Men,styleFabric:Cashmere) taken from a prior response's own facets[].name/facets[].options[].value fields -- not curated against a fixed list, since the facet set is large and can change. This is best-effort relevance, not a guaranteed keyword match: for an obscure alphanumeric keyword the search index falls back to its own semantically-related results instead of an empty list, and there is no reliable field in the response to distinguish a true keyword match from that fallback.

### `jcrew_size_chart`

Get the size chart for a J.Crew or J.Crew Factory product. Returns real body measurements per size (chest, waist, hip, sleeve, length, or a subset depending on the style/category), in both inches and centimeters. pid is a style id, as returned by jcrew-search's products[].id field. site must match the storefront the pid belongs to (default jcrew). A measurement value of 0 means that column doesn't apply to this style (e.g. hip on a top) -- the upstream itself doesn't distinguish that from a genuine zero, so this endpoint passes it through as-is.

### `jcrew_stores`

Find J.Crew or J.Crew Factory store locations. Returns one storefront's full open-store directory (address, phone, coordinates, services, weekly hours). site selects the storefront and accepts jcrew or factory; defaults to jcrew. Give lat and lng together to sort by distance from that point (each store's distance_miles is then populated); omit both for the upstream's own order.

### `jcrew_suggest`

Get J.Crew or J.Crew Factory search-box suggestions. Returns the storefront's own search-box suggestions (typeahead) for a partial query -- a flat list of suggested search phrases, each with its own live total result count on the search index. Select the storefront with site (default jcrew). Not product data.

### `jerusalempost_article`

Get Jerusalem Post article content. Returns public Jerusalem Post article metadata and free body paragraphs. If isAccessibleForFree is false, paywalled is true and body paragraphs are omitted; paid article text is not represented by feed snippets.

### `jerusalempost_author`

Get Jerusalem Post author profile. Returns a Jerusalem Post author or blogger profile by 'url', a canonical '/author/<slug>' or '/blogger/<slug>' link. The response has the profile 'type', name, 'description', 'image_url' and article cards with title, URL, summary and publication time.

### `jerusalempost_authors`

List Jerusalem Post author profiles. Returns the current author and blogger profile URLs discovered from the site's public Experts sitemap. This dynamic roster is intentionally exposed as a discovery endpoint.

### `jerusalempost_headlines`

Get Jerusalem Post section headlines. Returns current Jerusalem Post stories for one section. 'section' is required and takes one of 40 slugs such as 'israel-news', 'iran-news', 'middle-east', 'tech-and-startups' or 'torah-portion'. Each item has its title, URL, author, publication time and image, plus a summary except on premium items, which have none.

### `jerusalempost_news`

Get Jerusalem Post top stories. Returns recent Jerusalem Post front-page stories, with no parameters. Each item has its title, URL, author, publication time and image where available. Premium items keep their title and metadata but have no summary. Use 'jerusalempost-article' to read an article and check its paywall flag.

### `jerusalempost_sections`

Get Jerusalem Post section inventory. Lists the 40 English-language editorial sections accepted by 'jerusalempost-headlines', such as 'world-news', 'israel-politics', 'archaeology' and 'jewish-holidays'. Each entry has a 'slug', display 'name' and section 'url'. Takes no parameters.

### `jimmy_johns_menu`

Get one Jimmy John's restaurant's full menu. Returns one Jimmy John's restaurant's full menu as a category tree: every category and its products, with name, description, calorie range, base cost and image. restaurant_id comes from GET /jimmy-johns/nearby. Many sandwiches price entirely through a size selection rather than a base cost, so cost is commonly 0 for those items -- see GET /jimmy-johns/modifiers for the real per-size price.

### `jimmy_johns_modifiers`

Get one Jimmy John's menu product's customization options. Returns one menu product's full customization tree: size, bread, and per-ingredient choices (extra/regular/light/none), each with its real price and calorie delta. Groups nest -- picking a size choice can reveal a bread group, which can reveal one group per ingredient -- so a size step, a bread step, and every "Customize Sandwich" ingredient all live in one recursive tree. product_id comes from GET /jimmy-johns/menu.

### `jimmy_johns_nearby`

Find Jimmy John's restaurants near a coordinate. Returns Jimmy John's restaurants within a radius of a coordinate, nearest first, using Jimmy John's own Olo-backed ordering API (a separate host from the locator this family's sitemap and store endpoints read). Each result carries restaurant_id -- pass it to GET /jimmy-johns/menu for that restaurant's full menu. The upstream's own radius parameter does not narrow its result set, so distance filtering and sorting happen here.

### `jimmy_johns_sitemap`

Browse Jimmy John's store-URL index. Returns one page of Jimmy John's sitemap-declared store index -- 9,700+ URLs at time of writing. Jimmy John's publishes three page variants per store (sandwiches, delivery, catering) and all three appear in the sitemap, so each entry carries a kind and the store number they share; filter with the kind parameter to enumerate one variant per restaurant. 'sandwiches' is the canonical variant. A page past the end returns an empty list rather than an error, so a caller can walk to exhaustion.

### `jimmy_johns_store`

Get one Jimmy John's store's detail. Returns one Jimmy John's store: name, postal address, phone, coordinates, cuisine description and the published week of opening hours. Store paths come from GET /jimmy-johns/sitemap. Note Jimmy John's main site is behind a bot challenge that serves a page with HTTP 200, so this family reads the separate locator subdomain instead. For menu data, see GET /jimmy-johns/nearby and GET /jimmy-johns/menu, which read a separate ordering API.

### `jobs_ashby_board`

List an organization's Ashby job board. Lists an organization's public Ashby board postings with inline detail (description, compensation when include_compensation=true). The org is the Ashby slug from its careers URL. An unknown org returns an empty board (Ashby does not 404).

### `jobs_company_search`

Find which ATS a company uses by slug. Probes Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Workable, Recruitee, Rippling, Teamtailor, and Pinpoint in parallel for a slug and reports the providers where it resolves to a non-empty board (with the open-role count and board URL). Workday is excluded (its board needs tenant + datacenter + site).

### `jobs_eightfold_board`

List an Eightfold tenant's job board. Lists a company's public Eightfold AI job board, paged via limit/offset. tenant is the {tenant}.eightfold.ai subdomain from the careers URL; domain is the hiring organization's own domain (e.g. microsoft.com), also visible on the tenant's careers page.

### `jobs_eightfold_job`

Get a single Eightfold position. Returns a single Eightfold position with its full HTML/text description. id is the position id from a board listing; tenant/domain as in the board endpoint.

### `jobs_gem_board`

List a company's Gem job board. Lists a company's public Gem (gem.com) board postings with inline detail (full HTML description, and compensation when the company publishes a pay range). The company is the Gem vanity URL slug from its careers URL.

### `jobs_greenhouse_board`

List a company's Greenhouse job board. Lists a company's public Greenhouse board postings in the shared Job shape. Set content=true to include each job's full HTML description in one call. The token is the company's Greenhouse board slug from its careers URL.

### `jobs_greenhouse_job`

Get a single Greenhouse job. Returns one Greenhouse job, identified by the board 'token' and job 'id', both required. The response has the title, company, department, team, location and offices, workplace type, employment type, posting and apply URLs, posting date, compensation, and the description as HTML and plain text. An unknown token or id returns '404'.

### `jobs_hiring_signals`

Aggregate hiring signals for a company's board. Aggregates a company's ATS board into a hiring snapshot: total open roles, breakdowns by department/location/title, remote share, and how many roles are new in the last 7/30 days — a leading indicator of company growth. Supply provider plus that provider's slug params (token / company / org / tenant+datacenter+site / domain). Breakdowns are computed over the fetched postings.

### `jobs_icims_board`

List an iCIMS tenant's job board. Lists a company's public iCIMS job board (served through the tenant's white-labeled careers domain, e.g. careers.costco.com — not the bare {company}.icims.com subdomain, which is an OAuth-gated employee portal), paged via page/limit, with the full description inline per job. domain is the tenant's careers domain from its careers URL.

### `jobs_icims_job`

Get a single iCIMS job. Returns a single iCIMS job with its full HTML/text description, department, and benefits. id is the req_id/slug from a board listing; lang defaults to en-us.

### `jobs_lever_posting`

Get a single Lever posting. Returns one Lever posting, identified by the 'company' slug and posting 'id', both required. The response has the title, department, team, location, workplace type, employment type, posting and apply URLs, posting date, compensation, and the description as HTML and plain text. An unknown company or id returns '404'.

### `jobs_lever_postings`

List a company's Lever postings. Lists a company's public Lever postings (detail is inline), optionally filtered by department, location, or remote. The company is the Lever slug from its careers URL.

### `jobs_oracle_board`

List an Oracle Recruiting (ORC) tenant's job board. Lists an Oracle Recruiting Cloud tenant's public requisitions, paged via limit/offset. host and site both come from the careers URL https://{host}/hcmUI/CandidateExperience/en/sites/{site}/ (host must be an *.oraclecloud.com hostname; site looks like CX_1). The listing carries a short description; use the single-job endpoint for full detail.

### `jobs_oracle_job`

Get a single Oracle Recruiting (ORC) requisition. Returns a single Oracle Recruiting requisition with its full HTML/text description (description, responsibilities, qualifications). id is the requisition Id from a board listing; host/site as in the board endpoint.

### `jobs_personio_feed`

List a company's Personio job board. Lists a company's public Personio board feed in the shared Job shape with detail inline, optionally filtered by department, location, or remote. The company is the Personio subdomain from its careers URL https://{company}.jobs.personio.de/.

### `jobs_phenom_board`

Search a Phenom People tenant's job board. Searches a company's public Phenom People career site (a white-labeled domain such as careers.whataburger.com or jobs.cvshealth.com). domain is the tenant's careers domain from its careers URL. Paged via offset/limit; limit is a best-effort page-size hint some tenants ignore, so count always reflects what actually came back.

### `jobs_phenom_job`

Get a single Phenom People job. Returns a single Phenom People job with its full HTML/text description, category, and apply URL. domain is the tenant's careers domain (as in the board endpoint); id is the jobId/reqId from a board listing (e.g. JR10002958).

### `jobs_pinpoint_board`

List a tenant's Pinpoint job board. Lists a tenant's public Pinpoint (pinpointhq.com) board postings with inline detail (full HTML description, key responsibilities, skills, and benefits, plus structured compensation when the tenant publishes a pay range). The company is the tenant subdomain from its careers URL https://{company}.pinpointhq.com/.

### `jobs_recruitee_offer`

Get a single Recruitee offer. Returns a single Recruitee offer with its full HTML/text description and structured compensation when the board exposes it.

### `jobs_recruitee_offers`

List a company's Recruitee offers. Lists a company's public Recruitee offers (detail is inline), optionally filtered by department, location, or remote. The company is the Recruitee subdomain from its careers URL https://{company}.recruitee.com/.

### `jobs_rippling_board`

List a company's Rippling job board. Lists a company's public Rippling board postings (thin listing — title, department, work location). The company is the Rippling board slug from its careers URL https://ats.rippling.com/{company}/jobs. Detail (full description, employment type) is fetched per job via the single-job endpoint.

### `jobs_rippling_job`

Get a single Rippling job. Returns a single Rippling job with its full HTML/text description, employment type, and work locations. The id is the job uuid from a listing.

### `jobs_smartrecruiters_posting`

Get a single SmartRecruiters posting. Returns one SmartRecruiters posting, identified by the 'company' id and posting 'id', both required. The response has the title, department, location, employment type, posting and apply URLs, posting date, compensation, and the job ad description as HTML and text. Recruiter personal data is left out. An unknown company or id returns '404'.

### `jobs_smartrecruiters_postings`

List a company's SmartRecruiters postings. Lists a company's public SmartRecruiters postings, paged via limit/offset. The company is the SmartRecruiters identifier from its careers URL.

### `jobs_teamtailor_jobs`

List a company's Teamtailor job board. Lists a company's public Teamtailor board feed in the shared Job shape with detail inline, optionally filtered by department, location, or remote. The company is the Teamtailor subdomain from its careers URL https://{company}.teamtailor.com/.

### `jobs_ukg_board`

List a UKG Pro Recruiting tenant's job board. Lists a UKG Pro Recruiting (formerly UltiPro) tenant's public opportunities, paged via limit/offset. tenant and board both come from the careers URL https://recruiting.ultipro.com/{tenant}/JobBoard/{board}. Each posting carries a brief description inline.

### `jobs_workable_posting`

Get a single Workable posting. Returns a single Workable posting with its full HTML/text description. The id is the posting shortcode from a listing.

### `jobs_workable_postings`

List a company's Workable postings. Lists a company's public Workable postings in the shared Job shape, optionally filtered by department, location, or remote. The company is the Workable account slug from its careers URL https://apply.workable.com/{company}/. Detail (full description) is fetched per job via the single-posting endpoint.

### `jobs_workday_board`

List a Workday tenant's job board. Lists a company's public Workday (CXS) postings, paged via limit/offset. tenant, datacenter (wd1/wd3/wd5/...), and site all come from the careers URL https://{tenant}.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/{site}.

### `jobs_workday_job`

Get a single Workday job. Returns a single Workday posting's full detail (description, location, req id). path is the externalPath from a board listing. tenant/datacenter/site as in the board endpoint.

### `jumia_categories`

List Jumia categories. Lists the category slugs that jumia-category accepts. Without category it returns the storefront's top-level departments; with category it returns that category's direct sub-categories, each with its numeric id. Walk the tree by passing a returned slug back as category. country is required; see jumia-countries. Jumia sits behind an anti-bot challenge that clears on only some connections, so a call can take up to about 50 seconds and may return 503; retry it.

### `jumia_category`

Browse a Jumia category. Browses one Jumia category listing by slug and returns the same product cards as jumia-search, plus the category's upstream total_count and a has_next flag. Take the slug from jumia-categories (top-level departments, or a department's sub-categories). Jumia serves at most 50 pages. Jumia sits behind an anti-bot challenge that clears on only some connections, so a call can take up to about 50 seconds and may return 503; retry it. country is required; see jumia-countries.

### `jumia_countries`

List supported Jumia country storefronts. Returns the Jumia country storefronts accepted by the country parameter on jumia-search, jumia-category and jumia-categories, with each storefront's domain and currency. Static metadata.

### `jumia_product`

Get a Jumia product. Returns one Jumia product: name, brand, sku, images, price in the storefront's currency with original price and discount, availability, rating and rating count, category path, seller (name, id, score, followers, shipping speed), description, key features and the specification table. Pass the url returned by jumia-search or jumia-category; the storefront country is taken from the URL host. Jumia sits behind an anti-bot challenge that clears on only some connections, so a call can take up to about 50 seconds and may return 503; retry it. A product id Jumia no longer serves returns 404.

### `jumia_reviews`

Get the reviews of a Jumia product. Returns one page of a Jumia product's written, verified customer reviews (rating, title, text, date, first name of the author) with the rating summary: average rating, total ratings, total written reviews and the count of ratings per star. Reviews are 10 per page. A product with ratings but no written reviews returns an empty list with the summary. Pass the sku returned by jumia-search, jumia-category or jumia-product. Jumia sits behind an anti-bot challenge that clears on only some connections, so a call can take up to about 50 seconds and may return 503; retry it. country is required; see jumia-countries.

### `jumia_search`

Search Jumia products. Searches a Jumia country storefront by keyword and returns one page of product cards with price in the storefront's currency, original price and discount, rating, brand, categories and badges, plus the upstream total_count and a has_next flag. Jumia serves at most 50 pages. A search with no matches returns an empty products list. Jumia sits behind an anti-bot challenge that clears on only some connections, so a call can take up to about 50 seconds and may return 503; retry it. country is required (there is no default storefront); see jumia-countries.

### `jumia_sitemap_urls`

Read the URLs in a Jumia sitemap file. Returns one page of the URLs listed in a Jumia sitemap file, each with its last-modified date and first image, plus the total number of URLs in the file. A product file holds up to 16,000 product URLs; page through it with page and page_size (up to 5000). Take the file name from jumia-sitemaps. A page past the end returns an empty list. Jumia sits behind an anti-bot challenge that clears on only some connections, so a call can take up to about 50 seconds and may return 503; retry it. country is required; see jumia-countries.

### `jumia_sitemaps`

List the sitemap files of a Jumia storefront. Lists the sitemap files a Jumia storefront publishes: product, brand, category and curated-page (mlps) files, each with its name, type, language, last-modified date and URL. Pass a returned name to jumia-sitemap-urls to read the URLs in it. Optionally narrow to one type. Jumia sits behind an anti-bot challenge that clears on only some connections, so a call can take up to about 50 seconds and may return 503; retry it. country is required; see jumia-countries.

### `justeat_restaurant`

Get one Just Eat restaurant's detail. Returns one Just Eat restaurant by 'unique_name', the slug found in a search result. The response has the restaurant id, name, address, city, postal code, country, image, primary cuisine, rating and rating count, and 'is_active', which says whether it currently accepts orders. 'rating' can read '0' even when the site shows one. An unknown 'unique_name' returns '404'.

### `justeat_restaurant_menu`

Get one Just Eat restaurant's menu with prices. Returns one restaurant's full menu grouped into categories. Every item carries a name, description, image, price, and calorie/energy text when the upstream provides it. Items with customization options (e.g. "Dip 1/2") carry a modifier_groups list with each option's own price. Non-restaurant stores (groceries, alcohol, pharmacy, electronics, and similar) return every item under a single "All items" category rather than the site's own finer-grained grouping.

### `justeat_search`

Search Just Eat restaurants near a UK postcode. Returns Just Eat's full restaurant listing for a UK postcode -- every restaurant the site's own area page carries, ordered as Just Eat's default "best match" sort presents them (or by sort_by, if set), not a curated subset. Each restaurant carries its unique_name (the value the restaurant and menu endpoints take), name, image, rating, delivery time window, and open-now status. A postcode with no coverage returns an empty list rather than an error.

### `justeat_search_filters`

Get Just Eat's live filter slug catalog for a UK postcode. Returns the exact filter slugs Just Eat's own area page currently offers for a UK postcode -- star-rating thresholds, boolean toggles (open_now, new, free_delivery, halal, vegan, ...), cuisine tiles (pizza, chinese, italian, ...), and non-restaurant top-nav verticals (groceries, alcohol, pharmacy, electronics, flowers, gifts, and more) alike -- each with the live count of restaurants it currently narrows this postcode's listing to. Every filter value is the literal string /justeat/search's repeatable filter parameter accepts. The slug set is genuinely postcode-dependent: a rural postcode's own area page offers fewer cuisine tiles than central London's, because Just Eat's own frontend never advertises a filter with zero local coverage -- call this endpoint again for a different postcode rather than assume one location's slug set applies everywhere.

### `justwatch_age_certifications`

Get JustWatch age certifications. Lists the JustWatch age certification technical names for a country, such as 'PG-13' for the US. 'country' is a two-letter code and defaults to 'US'. An invalid country returns '400', and an unexpectedly empty result returns '503'.

### `justwatch_discover`

Discover JustWatch titles. Returns popular movies and shows filtered by optional genre short names, provider short names, production countries, monetization types, and release year bounds. Combine 'providers' with 'production_countries' to build charts such as most popular Korean or Japanese titles on a given service. Type accepts only 'all', 'movie', or 'show'; monetization_types accepts only 'FLATRATE', 'FREE', 'ADS', 'RENT', or 'BUY'.

### `justwatch_episode_by_id`

Get JustWatch episode by raw id. Looks up one JustWatch episode by its raw 'id' ('tse' followed by digits, such as 'tse5550494'), in the 'country' (default 'US') and 'language' (default 'en') you choose. Returns the title, year, episode number, description, poster, paths, and streaming offers with provider, monetization type, presentation type, price and currency. A valid id with no match returns '404'.

### `justwatch_episode_offers`

Get JustWatch episode offers. Returns the streaming offers for one JustWatch episode 'id' ('tse' followed by digits) across one to five comma-separated country codes in 'countries' (default 'US'), with 'language' defaulting to 'en'. Each country entry lists offers by provider, monetization type, presentation type, price and currency, with the episode details. An unknown id returns '404'.

### `justwatch_genre_titles`

Get JustWatch genre titles. Lists popular JustWatch titles for one genre short name in 'genre', such as 'act'. 'type' is 'all', 'movie' or 'show' (default 'all'), 'limit' defaults to 20 and is capped at 50, and 'country' and 'language' default to 'US' and 'en'. Each title has its id, year, path, poster, production countries and offers. Find genre names with the genres endpoint.

### `justwatch_genres`

Get JustWatch genres. Lists the JustWatch genres, each with its 'short_name' (such as 'act') and a translated name in the 'language' you choose (two-letter code, default 'en'). Use the short names as the 'genre' input of the genre titles endpoint. An invalid language returns '400'.

### `justwatch_monetization_titles`

Get JustWatch monetization titles. Returns popular titles for one monetization type. monetization_type accepts only 'FLATRATE', 'FREE', 'ADS', 'RENT', or 'BUY'; type accepts only 'all', 'movie', or 'show'.

### `justwatch_new`

Get new JustWatch titles. Returns newly available movies and shows. Type accepts only 'all', 'movie', or 'show'; limit defaults to 20 and clamps to 50.

### `justwatch_popular`

Get popular JustWatch titles. Returns popular movies and shows. Type accepts only 'all', 'movie', or 'show'; limit defaults to 20 and clamps to 50.

### `justwatch_provider_titles`

Get JustWatch provider titles. Returns popular movies and shows available on one streaming provider, by JustWatch provider short name such as 'nfx', for a country (default 'US') and language (default 'en'). Filter to movies or shows with 'type' and cap results with 'limit' (default 20, max 50). Each title has its name, year, type, poster, JustWatch URL and offers with price, currency and monetization type.

### `justwatch_providers`

Get JustWatch providers. Lists the streaming providers JustWatch tracks in a country. 'country' is a two-letter code and defaults to 'US'. Each provider has its id, clear name, short name, technical name and an absolute icon URL. An invalid country returns '400'.

### `justwatch_search`

Search JustWatch titles. Searches JustWatch titles. Country must be a two-letter ISO code such as 'US'; language must be a two-letter code such as 'en'.

### `justwatch_season_by_id`

Get JustWatch season by raw id. Looks up one JustWatch season by its raw 'id' ('tss' followed by digits, such as 'tss297253'), in the 'country' (default 'US') and 'language' (default 'en') you choose. Returns the season title, number, year, description, path, URL and poster. A valid id with no match returns '404'.

### `justwatch_season_episodes`

Get JustWatch season episodes. Lists the episodes of a JustWatch season given as 'season_id' ('tss' followed by digits), with 'country' defaulting to 'US' and 'language' to 'en'. Each episode has its number, title, description and streaming offers with provider, price and currency. Path, URL and poster appear only when JustWatch has them for that episode. An unknown season returns '404'.

### `justwatch_show_seasons`

Get JustWatch show seasons. Lists the seasons of a JustWatch show given as 'show_id' ('ts' followed by digits, such as 'ts287292'), with 'country' defaulting to 'US' and 'language' to 'en'. Each season has its number, title, year, description, path and poster. The show itself comes back with genres, scoring, runtime and offers. An unknown show returns '404'.

### `justwatch_title`

Get JustWatch title details. Returns the details of a JustWatch movie or show. Pass exactly one of 'path' (such as '/us/movie/inception') or 'url' (an absolute JustWatch address). The response has the title, year, genres, runtime, content rating, 'scoring' (IMDb and TMDB scores, tomato meter, JustWatch rating) and current offers. Titles with no offers still return metadata; a missing page returns '404'.

### `justwatch_title_analysis`

Analyze JustWatch title availability. Fetches a JustWatch title page and summarizes provider availability, monetization buckets, formats, price ranges, and best rent/buy/free/subscription options. Pass exactly one of 'path' or 'url'.

### `justwatch_title_by_id`

Get JustWatch title by raw id. Looks up a JustWatch movie or show by its raw 'id' ('tm' or 'ts' followed by digits, such as 'tm92641'), with 'country' defaulting to 'US' and 'language' to 'en'. Returns the title, year, genres, runtime, content rating, description, scoring, and offers with provider, monetization type, price and currency. A valid id with no match returns '404'.

### `justwatch_title_media`

Get JustWatch title media. Returns the media for a JustWatch movie or show 'id' ('tm' or 'ts' followed by digits): credits with role, name, character and person id, video clips with provider and URL, and backdrop image URLs. 'country' defaults to 'US' and 'language' to 'en'. YouTube clips carry a watch URL. An unknown id returns '404'.

### `justwatch_title_offers`

Get JustWatch title offers. Returns the streaming offers for a JustWatch movie or show 'id' across one to five comma-separated country codes in 'countries' (default 'US'), with 'language' defaulting to 'en'. Each country entry has its offers (provider, monetization type, presentation type, price, currency) and the title details. An unknown id returns '404'.

### `justwatch_title_similar`

Get similar JustWatch titles. Lists titles similar to a JustWatch movie or show 'id' ('tm' or 'ts' followed by digits). 'limit' defaults to 10 and is capped at 25; 'country' defaults to 'US' and 'language' to 'en'. Each result has its id, type, title, year, path, poster, production countries and offers. An unknown id returns '404'.

### `kalshi_event`

Kalshi event detail. Returns one Kalshi event by 'event_ticker' (such as 'KXELONMARS-99') together with its markets. The event has its series ticker, title, subtitle, category, strike period and mutually-exclusive flag; each market has prices, bid and ask, volume, open interest, status and rules. An unknown ticker returns a not-found error.

### `kalshi_event_history`

Kalshi event history. Returns candlesticks for the markets in a Kalshi event, grouped by market, for 'event_ticker'. 'start_ts' defaults to 7 days ago, 'end_ts' to now, 'period_interval' to 1440 minutes, and 'series_ticker' to the ticker prefix before the last dash. Each candle has price, yes bid and ask, volume and open interest. Ranges are capped at 366 days.

### `kalshi_event_metadata`

Kalshi event metadata. Returns the media and market metadata for one Kalshi event by 'event_ticker'. The response has the event image and featured image, a color code and image for each market, settlement sources with name and URL, and competition context when it applies. An unknown ticker returns a not-found error.

### `kalshi_events`

Kalshi events. Lists Kalshi events, up to 'limit' rows (default 25, max 200), continued with 'cursor'. Filter by 'series_ticker', 'category', 'status' ('open', 'closed' or 'settled'), 'min_close_ts' and 'min_updated_ts'. 'with_nested_markets' adds each event's markets. Each event has its ticker, title, category and strike period. A 'cursor' is returned when more rows exist.

### `kalshi_exchange_schedule`

Kalshi exchange schedule. Returns the Kalshi exchange schedule, with no inputs. 'standard_hours' are date-bounded blocks listing 'open_time' and 'close_time' for each weekday, and 'maintenance_windows' list start time, end time and reason. The maintenance list can be empty. Informational only.

### `kalshi_exchange_status`

Kalshi exchange status. Returns the current Kalshi exchange status, with no inputs: 'exchange_active' says whether the exchange is up, and 'trading_active' says whether trading is open at the time of the request. Informational only, not real-time trading data.

### `kalshi_historical_cutoff`

Kalshi historical data cutoff. Returns the three cutoff timestamps Kalshi uses to split live from historical data: 'market_settled_at', 'orders_updated_at' and 'trades_created_at'. Use them to decide when settled market data should be read from the historical endpoints. Takes no parameters.

### `kalshi_historical_market`

Kalshi historical market detail. Returns one settled Kalshi market from historical storage by 'ticker'. The response has the title, subtitle, event ticker, status, result, open, close and expiration times, last and previous price, yes and no bid and ask, volume, open interest, liquidity and primary rules text. Invalid tickers are rejected.

### `kalshi_historical_market_history`

Kalshi historical market history. Returns candlesticks for one settled Kalshi market by 'ticker'. 'start_ts' defaults to 7 days ago, 'end_ts' to now and 'period_interval' to 1440 minutes. Each candle has end time, price, yes bid and ask, volume and open interest. Ranges are capped at 366 days.

### `kalshi_historical_markets`

Kalshi historical markets. Returns settled Kalshi historical market rows. 'tickers', 'event_ticker', and 'series_ticker' are mutually exclusive. The 'mve_filter' enum accepts 'exclude'.

### `kalshi_historical_trades`

Kalshi historical trades. Lists older Kalshi trades that have moved into historical storage, up to 'limit' rows (default 25, max 200), continued with 'cursor'. Filter by market 'ticker' and by created time with 'min_ts' and 'max_ts' (Unix seconds). Each trade has its id, count, yes and no price, taker side and created time.

### `kalshi_market`

Kalshi market detail. Returns one Kalshi market by 'ticker' (such as 'KXELONMARS-99'). The response has the title, subtitle, event ticker, status, result, open, close and expiration times, last and previous price, yes and no bid and ask, volume, 24-hour volume, open interest, liquidity and rules text. An unknown ticker returns a not-found error.

### `kalshi_market_history`

Kalshi market history. Returns candlesticks for one Kalshi market by 'ticker'. 'series_ticker' defaults to the ticker prefix before the last dash, 'start_ts' to 7 days ago, 'end_ts' to now and 'period_interval' to 1440 minutes. 'include_latest_before_start' adds the last candle before the start. Ranges are capped at 366 days.

### `kalshi_market_orderbook`

Kalshi market orderbook. Returns the order book for one Kalshi market by 'ticker': bid levels for the 'yes' side and the 'no' side, each with 'price' and 'size'. Kalshi publishes bids only, so ask levels are not listed. The response also carries a 'raw_unit_hint' for the price unit.

### `kalshi_markets`

Kalshi markets. Lists Kalshi markets, up to 'limit' rows (default 25, max 200), continued with 'cursor'. Filter by 'event_ticker', 'series_ticker', 'ticker', or 'status' ('unopened', 'open', 'closed' or 'settled'). Each market has its title, status, prices, bid and ask, volume, open interest and rules text. A returned status can read 'active' even though the filter does not accept it.

### `kalshi_markets_history`

Kalshi batch market history. Returns candlesticks for up to 25 Kalshi markets in one call. 'market_tickers' is required, as a comma-separated list or repeated values. 'start_ts' defaults to 7 days ago, 'end_ts' to now and 'period_interval' to 1440 minutes. Results are grouped by market. Ranges are capped at 366 days.

### `kalshi_markets_orderbooks`

Kalshi batch market orderbooks. Returns order books for up to 25 Kalshi markets in one call. 'tickers' is required, as a comma-separated list or repeated values. Each book has the 'yes' and 'no' bid levels with 'price' and 'size'; ask levels are not listed. Books come back in the order requested.

### `kalshi_multivariate_events`

Kalshi multivariate events. Lists Kalshi multivariate events, which the regular events list leaves out, up to 'limit' rows (default 25, max 200), continued with 'cursor'. Each event has its ticker, series ticker, title, subtitle, category and markets. A 'cursor' is returned when more rows exist.

### `kalshi_series`

Kalshi series. Lists Kalshi series, up to 'limit' rows (default 25, max 200). Each series has its ticker, title, category, frequency, fee type and multiplier, settlement sources, and contract and contract-terms URLs. The catalogue comes back in one page, so 'cursor' has no effect on this endpoint.

### `kalshi_series_detail`

Kalshi series detail. Returns one Kalshi series by 'series_ticker' (such as 'KXELONMARS'). The response has the title, category, frequency, fee type and multiplier, settlement sources with name and URL, contract and contract-terms URLs, and last update time. An unknown ticker returns a not-found error.

### `kalshi_trades`

Kalshi trades. Lists recent Kalshi trades, up to 'limit' rows (default 25, max 200), continued with 'cursor'. Filter by market 'ticker' and by created time with 'min_ts' and 'max_ts' (Unix seconds, at most 366 days apart). Each trade has its id, count, yes and no price, taker side and created time.

### `kfc_delivery_estimate`

Check KFC delivery serviceability and estimated fee for one store and address. Checks whether a KFC restaurant's delivery integration can deliver to a given address and, when it can, the estimated delivery fee (broken down by fee line item) and pickup/dropoff time. This reads the same checkout-time estimate KFC's own site calls -- it does not add an item to a cart or place an order, and takes no payment or account information. serviceable is true only when the upstream returned a real estimate; a false value with reason populated covers every other case seen live: the delivery provider not enabled at this store, the address being outside the delivery zone, or the delivery marketplace itself reporting the store temporarily inactive. order_subtotal materially affects the fee estimate (KFC's own fee schedules can vary by order size), so it is required rather than defaulted. pickup_at defaults to 30 minutes from now (an "order now" style estimate) when omitted.

### `kfc_menu`

Get one KFC restaurant's full priced menu. Returns one restaurant's full menu grouped into categories (e.g. "Deals", "Combos", "Tenders"). Every entry is a product, a bundle (a combo or family meal), or a standalone priced variant -- type tells callers which -- and carries a price in USD cents plus a decimal dollar value, and an image when the upstream publishes one. Prices reflect this specific restaurant and order channel, not a national default. channel selects which order channel the menu is priced for (web ordering by default); prices can genuinely differ by channel (e.g. a delivery-marketplace channel vs. web).

### `kfc_nearby`

Find KFC restaurants near a location. Returns KFC restaurants near a latitude/longitude, nearest first. A coordinate with no nearby KFC returns an empty list rather than an error. Each restaurant carries its store number, full address with coordinates, phone, whether it currently accepts online orders, its timezone, and its distance from the search point in miles. occasion restricts results to restaurants that offer a given order channel (e.g. only drive-thru locations).

### `kfc_promotion`

Look up one KFC promotion by its redemption code or serialized code. Returns one promotion by its redemption code (the code a customer types in at checkout) or its serialized code (a unique per-print QR/serial code, e.g. from a printed coupon, that resolves to a shared redemption code and its promotion). Exactly one of code or serialized_code is required. A serialized-code lookup additionally returns that code's own usage metadata (redemption_code, times_used, code_status, group_status, effective_date, expiration_date) alongside the promotion. An unknown or expired code returns a 404 rather than a null success payload.

### `kfc_promotions`

Get one KFC restaurant's current public promotions. Returns one restaurant's current public promotions -- current deals and offers KFC's storefront marks as public, with each promotion's id, internal and display name, description, whether it applies automatically, and active redemption codes when KFC exposes them. The returned codes can be passed to kfc-promotion. A store with no active public promotions returns an empty list rather than an error.

### `kfc_store`

Get one KFC restaurant by its store number. Returns one KFC restaurant's detail by its exact store number, from /kfc/stores or /kfc/nearby, including its recurring open hours per order channel (carryout, delivery, dine-in, drive-thru, catering carryout). A channel this restaurant does not offer at all is omitted from hours rather than reported as always-closed.

### `kfc_stores`

Search KFC restaurants by city, state, postal code, name, franchise code, or store number. Returns KFC restaurants matching a city/state/postal code/name/franchise code/store number filter. At least one filter is required -- an unfiltered call would enumerate every US restaurant in one response, which this endpoint intentionally does not expose. Each restaurant carries its store number (the value /kfc/menu and /kfc/promotions take), full address with coordinates, phone, whether it currently accepts online orders, and its timezone. appear_in_store_results (default true) excludes internal/test records KFC's own storefront does not surface in customer-facing search -- a raw filter can otherwise return non-orderable administrative entries alongside real restaurants.

### `khaleejtimes_article`

Get Khaleej Times article content. Returns public Khaleej Times article metadata and body paragraphs from a canonical article URL. Live-blog pages are accepted and return their timestamped update headlines as paragraphs.

### `khaleejtimes_author`

Get a Khaleej Times author profile. Returns a Khaleej Times author's name, photo, biography, and most recent articles (first page) from a canonical author profile URL.

### `khaleejtimes_headlines`

Get Khaleej Times section headlines. Returns current Khaleej Times headlines for one section or sub-section. 'section' is required; its slug is the section's URL path with slashes turned into hyphens, so '/business/markets' is 'business-markets'. Top-level sections mix their sub-sections' stories. Each item has its title, URL and publication time, plus summary, author and image when the outlet provides them. Call 'khaleejtimes-sections' for the slugs.

### `khaleejtimes_news`

Get Khaleej Times top stories. Returns fresh Khaleej Times top stories from its public Google News sitemap (the site publishes no RSS feed). Video, partner-content, and section pages are left out.

### `khaleejtimes_sections`

Get Khaleej Times sections. Returns the public Khaleej Times section inventory used by the headlines endpoint. A section slug is its URL path with slashes turned into hyphens (for example business-markets for /business/markets).

### `kick_categories`

List Kick's top-level categories. Returns Kick's top-level categories (Games, IRL, Music, Gambling, Creative, Alternative, Chat Roulette) with id, name, slug and icon. These slugs are the exact values the category parameter of kick-subcategories takes. Kick's website and its mobile app each list one parent the other omits (Gambling and Chat Roulette), so this call reads both and returns their union; icon is empty for a category only the app lists. The lists are read live from Kick.

### `kick_category_clips`

List the newest clips in a Kick category. Returns one page of 20 clips made in a Kick (kick.com) game or activity category, newest first: id, title, kick.com link, thumbnail, views, likes, duration in seconds, creation time, mature flag, category, the channel it came from, with a cursor for the next page. slug is a category slug from kick-subcategories such as just-chatting; a top-level category such as games has no clip page and returns not found. Only public data is read and no playable media is returned.

### `kick_channel`

Get a Kick channel profile and live state. Returns a Kick (kick.com) channel's public profile and, when it is live, its current broadcast: username, bio, verification and affiliate flags, follower count, linked social handles, profile and banner images, recent categories, and a live object with title, viewers, start time, language, tags and categories (omitted when the channel is offline). slug is the channel slug from its kick.com address, case-insensitive; a full kick.com URL is also accepted. Playable stream URLs are never returned. An unknown channel returns not found.

### `kick_channel_chatroom`

Get a Kick channel's chat settings and rules. Returns a Kick (kick.com) channel's chat restrictions and rules: slow mode (delay between messages), subscribers-only, followers-only (minimum follow time), emotes-only and minimum account age, whether gifts are enabled, and the channel's chat rules text. slug is the channel slug from its kick.com address, case-insensitive; a full kick.com URL is also accepted. The pinned message is not returned. This call reads two Kick pages. An unknown channel returns not found.

### `kick_channel_clips`

List a Kick channel's clips. Returns one page of 20 clips from a Kick channel, newest first: id, title, kick.com link, thumbnail, views, likes, duration in seconds, creation time, mature flag, category, the viewer who made the clip and the channel. Page onward by passing the previous response's next_cursor as cursor; next_cursor is empty on the last page. Playable clip URLs are never returned. An unknown channel returns not found.

### `kick_channel_emotes`

List the chat emotes a Kick channel offers. Returns the chat emote sets available in a Kick (kick.com) channel: the channel's own custom emotes (id, name, whether subscribers only, image link), plus the Global and Emoji sets that every channel shares. slug is the channel slug from its kick.com address, case-insensitive; a full kick.com URL is also accepted. A channel with no custom emotes returns an empty channel set. Only public data is read and no playable media is returned. An unknown channel returns not found.

### `kick_channel_links`

List a Kick channel's link panels. Returns the panels a Kick (kick.com) channel shows under its stream, in the order Kick shows them: link panels (tip pages, merch, social profiles) with title, description, URL and image, and text panels (FAQ, rules, disclaimers) that are only a title and description. slug is the channel slug from its kick.com address, case-insensitive; a full kick.com URL is also accepted. Only public data is read and no playable media is returned. An unknown channel returns not found.

### `kick_channel_streams`

List a Kick channel's recent broadcast history. Returns a Kick (kick.com) channel's recent broadcast history, newest first: id, title, start time, duration in milliseconds, the viewer count Kick reports for the broadcast, language, mature flag, tags, categories, thumbnail, and for broadcasts with a recording its video uuid, video views and kick.com video link. slug is the channel slug from its kick.com address, case-insensitive; a full kick.com URL is also accepted. Kick keeps between none and about thirty broadcasts. Only public data is read and no playable media is returned. An unknown channel returns not found.

### `kick_channel_videos`

List a Kick channel's recent past broadcasts. Returns a Kick channel's recent past broadcasts (VODs), newest first: id, uuid, title, start time, duration in milliseconds, views, language, mature flag, tags, categories, thumbnail and the kick.com video link. Kick returns a fixed window of recent videos (26 at the time of writing) with no paging, so this call takes only the channel slug. Playable stream sources are never returned. An unknown channel returns not found.

### `kick_clip`

Get one Kick clip. Returns one Kick clip by id: title, kick.com link, thumbnail, views, duration, creation time, the moment it starts inside the source broadcast, mature flag, category and channel. id is a clip id such as clip_01M5SKVA6GGAAAT5YPJ7J43WE4, from the id field of kick-channel-clips or kick-clips. A malformed id returns a 400 and an unknown clip returns not found. Playable clip URLs are never returned.

### `kick_clips`

List Kick's site-wide clips. Returns one page of 20 clips from across all of Kick, either newest first (sort=date, the default) or ranked by views inside a time window (sort=views with time=day, week, month or all). Each clip has its id, title, kick.com link, thumbnail, views, duration, category and channel. Page onward by passing the previous response's next_cursor as cursor. Playable clip URLs are never returned. Use kick-channel-clips for one channel's clips.

### `kick_drops`

List Kick Drops campaigns. Returns Kick (kick.com) Drops campaigns, publisher-sponsored rewards that viewers earn by watching, newest first: id, name, status, start and end time, campaign page, the rule (for example Watch to redeem), the publisher with its logo, the game or activity category, every reward with the watch threshold that earns it and its image, and the channels taking part. status is active (the default), expired or all. Only public campaign information is read; no account or progress data.

### `kick_gifts`

List the gifts viewers can send on Kick. Returns the catalog of gifts viewers can send on Kick (kick.com) with Kicks, Kick's virtual currency: gift id, name, price in Kicks, tier (BASIC, MID or HIGHER), type (BASIC or LEVEL_UP), and for level-up gifts the message length they allow and how long they pin the message in chat. This call takes no parameters.

### `kick_languages`

List Kick stream languages. Returns the stream languages Kick shows in its own language picker, each with its code and display name (67 at the time of writing). These codes are all accepted by the language parameter of kick-livestreams, which also accepts further ISO-style codes the picker does not list. The list is read live from Kick, so it follows any language Kick adds.

### `kick_livestreams`

List live broadcasts on Kick. Returns one page of Kick's live-stream directory: title, viewer count, start time, language, mature flag, tags, category, thumbnail and the channel for each live broadcast. sort is viewer_count_desc (the default, most viewers first) or featured. language filters to one stream language by code (kick-languages lists the languages Kick shows in its own picker; the directory accepts a wider range of codes than that list, and an unrecognized code returns a 400), and category_id filters to one category by the numeric id from kick-subcategories or kick-search-categories. limit is 1 to 100 (default 24). Page onward by passing the previous response's next_cursor as after; next_cursor is empty on the last page.

### `kick_search_categories`

Search Kick categories. Searches Kick's game and activity categories by name and returns each match's id, name, slug, tags, mature flag, current viewers, thumbnail and kick.com link. query is required and at most 100 characters; limit is 1 to 100 (default 10). Use this to find categories outside the first pages that kick-subcategories can reach. A search with no matches returns an empty list.

### `kick_search_channels`

Search Kick channels. Searches Kick channels by name and returns each match's id, slug, username, follower count, live flag, verification and kick.com link, most relevant first. query is required and at most 100 characters. live=true restricts to channels that are broadcasting now. limit is 1 to 100 (default 10). A search with no matches returns an empty list.

### `kick_subcategories`

List Kick's game and activity categories. Returns one page of Kick's game and activity categories (Just Chatting, Grand Theft Auto V, ...) ordered by current viewers: id, name, slug, parent category, tags, viewers, mature flag, banner and kick.com link. category restricts to one top-level category by slug from kick-categories (a parent Kick adds later is accepted too). page is 1 to 20 and limit is 1 to 32 (default 24) because Kick silently caps both; total is the size of the whole catalog (over 18,000) while reachable is how many entries these limits can reach, so use kick-search-categories to find a category outside the first pages.

### `kick_subcategory`

Get one Kick category. Returns one Kick game or activity category by slug: id, name, parent category, tags, description, current viewers, follower count, mature flag, banner and kick.com link. slug comes from kick-subcategories or kick-search-categories. An unknown slug returns not found.

### `kick_top_channels`

List Kick's top channels. Returns Kick's top-channels list (30 at the time of writing) ranked by followers: id, slug, username, follower count, live flag, verification, profile picture and kick.com link. The list takes no parameters.

### `kick_video`

Get a Kick video by its uuid.
