Pass a suggestion straight through to prada-search's own q parameter for product results. A query with no genuine matches returns a well-formed empty result rather than an error.

### `pricecharting_big_movers`

Get PriceCharting's Big Movers report. Returns PriceCharting's Big Movers report for one category: the 100 products whose price changed most since the previous reading (the page says it is usually refreshed within the last week), with product id, name, console or set, address, current loose or ungraded price and the signed change. Choose the category (video-games, coins, comic-books, funko-pops, pokemon-cards, dragon-ball-cards, lorcana-cards, magic-cards, marvel-cards, one-piece-cards, star-wars-cards, yugioh-cards, garbage-pail-cards, other-tcg-cards, other-cards or lego-sets), the order (dollar-increase, dollar-decrease, percent-increase or percent-decrease) and, for video games, the region (all, japan, ntsc or pal). Price data is PriceCharting's; cite it with a link when you display it.

### `pricecharting_categories`

List PriceCharting categories and their consoles or sets. Lists PriceCharting's categories (Pokemon Cards, Magic Cards, Video Games, Comics, Coins, Funko Pops and more) with their slugs, or, given a category, lists that category's consoles or sets with the slugs pricecharting-console takes.

### `pricecharting_console`

List the products of a PriceCharting console or set. Lists the products of one PriceCharting console or set (for example a Pokemon set or a game console), 150 per page: id, name, product address, image and the loose/ungraded, complete/Grade 9 and new/PSA 10 prices. Sort by popularity, highest price, lowest price or name, and page with the returned cursor. Price data is PriceCharting's; cite it with a link when you display it.

### `pricecharting_price_history`

Get a PriceCharting product's monthly price history. Returns the monthly price history behind a PriceCharting product page's price chart: one series per price column (for a trading card Ungraded, Grade 7, Grade 8, Grade 9, Grade 9.5 and PSA 10; for a video game Loose, Complete, New, Graded, Box and Manual), each a list of dated prices, oldest first, starting wherever PriceCharting's chart starts for that product. Trading cards also carry the PSA and CGC population counts by grade 1 to 10. Look a product up by id, by its pricecharting.com address, or by console and slug. Price data is PriceCharting's; cite it with a link when you display it.

### `pricecharting_product`

Get a PriceCharting product's prices and recent sales. Returns one PriceCharting product page: current prices by condition or grade with their latest change, the full price guide, attributes (publisher, release date, card number and similar) and the most recent completed eBay and TCGplayer sales per grade. Look a product up by id, by its pricecharting.com address, or by console and slug. Price data is PriceCharting's; cite it with a link when you display it.

### `pricecharting_search`

Search PriceCharting products. Searches PriceCharting's price guide (trading cards, video games, comics, coins, Funko Pops, LEGO and more) and returns up to 100 matches: product id, name, console or set, category, image and the loose/ungraded, complete/Grade 9 and new/PSA 10 prices. Narrow by console_uid, drop variants, and sort by popularity, highest price or name. Price data is PriceCharting's; cite it with a link when you display it.

### `pristine_auction_categories`

Discover Pristine Auction's search enum values. Returns the whole value space for pristine-auction-search's category, auction_type, sort, and status params. categories[] is fetched live (with a current listing count per category, refreshed on every call); auction_types[], sort[], and statuses[] are pristineauction.com's own fixed, small search-form value sets.

### `pristine_auction_lot`

Get a Pristine Auction lot's full detail. Returns one pristineauction.com lot's full detail: title, description, image gallery, price (current high bid, or realized/sold price once the auction has ended), auction end time, sport/collectible category, auction type, no-reserve flag, and view/watch/bid counts. lot_number comes from pristine-auction-search's results[].lot_number.

### `pristine_auction_search`

Search Pristine Auction's live auction inventory. Browses or searches pristineauction.com's current sports card and memorabilia auction lots. term or category is required, matching pristineauction.com's own search form. All enum values (category, auction_type, sort, status) come from pristine-auction-categories. status=completed browses ended/sold lots (a prices-realized view); the default (all statuses) mirrors the site's own default. Every filter is optional and combines with AND semantics.

### `pristine_marketplace_collection_products`

List Pristine Marketplace collection products. Returns products from one Pristine Marketplace (https://www.pristinemarketplace.com) collection. The storefront URL is fixed server-side; 'handle' is the collection's URL slug (typically a player, team, or memorabilia-type collection, e.g. 'pop-culture').

### `pristine_marketplace_collections`

List Pristine Marketplace collections. Returns collections from Pristine Marketplace (https://www.pristinemarketplace.com). The storefront URL is fixed server-side. Valid empty result pages return '200' with an empty collections array.

### `pristine_marketplace_page`

Get a Pristine Marketplace static page. Returns static page detail for one Pristine Marketplace (https://www.pristinemarketplace.com) page handle. The storefront URL is fixed server-side. The "Shop by Sport" nav landing pages are reachable here as handles 'nfl', 'mlb', 'nba', 'nhl', and 'nascar'.

### `pristine_marketplace_pages`

List Pristine Marketplace static pages. Returns static pages from Pristine Marketplace (https://www.pristinemarketplace.com). The storefront URL is fixed server-side. The storefront's "Shop by Sport" navigation (NFL, MLB, NBA, NHL, NASCAR) resolves to pages here (handles 'nfl', 'mlb', 'nba', 'nhl', 'nascar'), not to a separate collections-style resource -- each is a landing page linking into many player/team collections.

### `pristine_marketplace_product`

Get a Pristine Marketplace product. Returns product detail for one Pristine Marketplace (https://www.pristinemarketplace.com) product handle. The storefront URL is fixed server-side; 'handle' is the product's URL slug.

### `pristine_marketplace_product_recommendations`

List Pristine Marketplace product recommendations. Returns recommended products for one Pristine Marketplace (https://www.pristinemarketplace.com) product handle. The storefront URL is fixed server-side.

### `pristine_marketplace_products`

List Pristine Marketplace products. Returns products from Pristine Marketplace's (https://www.pristinemarketplace.com) public product catalog. The storefront URL is fixed server-side. Valid empty result pages return '200' with an empty products array.

### `pristine_marketplace_reviews`

List Pristine Marketplace store reviews. Returns one page of Pristine Marketplace's (https://www.pristinemarketplace.com) public Judge.me store review feed. This is a store-wide, most-recent-first feed, not a per-product one: confirmed live, the storefront's own on-page review widget draws from and displays this same feed (labeled "Reviews for other products" on an individual product page), and no product/handle filter parameter narrows it. The storefront URL is fixed server-side. Judge.me fixes 5 reviews per upstream page regardless of any requested size, so this endpoint has no 'limit' parameter -- 'page' maps 1:1 onto Judge.me's own pagination.

### `pristine_marketplace_search`

Search Pristine Marketplace products. Returns products from Pristine Marketplace's (https://www.pristinemarketplace.com) own full-text search, distinct from '/pristine-marketplace/search/suggest''s predictive suggestions. The storefront URL is fixed server-side. Per-page size is fixed (16 products per page) and is not adjustable; 'limit' is honored only as an upper bound on the returned page.

### `pristine_marketplace_search_suggest`

Get Pristine Marketplace search suggestions. Returns products, collections, and query suggestions from Pristine Marketplace's (https://www.pristinemarketplace.com) predictive search. The storefront URL is fixed server-side.

### `pristine_marketplace_sitemap_urls`

List Pristine Marketplace sitemap URLs. Returns capped URL entries from Pristine Marketplace's (https://www.pristinemarketplace.com) child sitemaps matching the requested type. The storefront URL is fixed server-side.

### `pristine_marketplace_sitemaps`

List Pristine Marketplace sitemaps. Returns child sitemap URLs from Pristine Marketplace's (https://www.pristinemarketplace.com) '/sitemap.xml' index with inferred sitemap types. The storefront URL is fixed server-side.

### `pristine_marketplace_store`

Get Pristine Marketplace store metadata. Returns storefront metadata for Pristine Marketplace (https://www.pristinemarketplace.com). The storefront URL is fixed server-side, so no 'url' parameter is accepted.

### `producthunt_about`

Retrieve Product Hunt product about page. Returns the about-page data for a Product Hunt product, looked up by its slug in 'id'. It covers the product's launch details with badges, ranks, comment count and detailed reviews with alternative products, along with the product's ad, forum and media information.

### `producthunt_alternatives`

Retrieve Product Hunt product alternatives. Lists alternatives to a Product Hunt product, looked up by its slug in 'id'. 'first' sets the page size (default 10), 'order' defaults to 'most_relevant', and 'tags' takes comma-separated tag slugs. Returns alternative items with ratings, badges and scores, alternative tags with counts, and related discussions. Use 'end_cursor' as 'cursor' for the next page.

### `producthunt_category`

Retrieve Product Hunt category details. Returns a Product Hunt category by its 'slug', such as 'vibe-coding': name, description, meta title, last update time, parent category and its sub-categories, hero products, questions with top answers, and related discussions.

### `producthunt_category_products`

Retrieve Product Hunt category products. Returns the products in a Product Hunt category (now backed by Product Hunt topics), cursor-paginated. Pass the 'cursor' from a previous response's 'end_cursor' to page; 'page_size' controls the batch size. 'page', 'featured_only', 'order' and 'tags' are accepted for compatibility but no longer affect the result.

### `producthunt_customers`

Retrieve Product Hunt product customers. Lists the customer products of a Product Hunt product, looked up by its slug in 'id'. 'order' is 'customers' (default) or 'latest_launch', 'page' defaults to 1 and 'page_size' to 10. Each item has its name, categories, badges, review and follower counts, and founder shoutouts. An unknown slug returns 404.

### `producthunt_launches`

Retrieve Product Hunt product launches. Lists the launch posts of a Product Hunt product, looked up by its slug in 'id'. 'order' defaults to 'DATE'; pass the returned 'end_cursor' as 'cursor' for the next page. Each launch has its name, tagline, ranks, scores, comment count, badges and dates. An unknown slug returns 404.

### `producthunt_leaderboard`

Retrieve Product Hunt leaderboard. Returns the Product Hunt leaderboard for a 'scope' of 'daily' (default), 'weekly', 'monthly' or 'yearly', positioned with 'date' (YYYY-MM-DD) or 'year', 'month', 'day' and 'week'. Only the first page is served, so a non-empty 'cursor' returns an error. 'featured' and 'order' are accepted but do not change the default view.

### `producthunt_makers`

Retrieve Product Hunt product makers. Lists the makers of a Product Hunt product, looked up by its slug in 'id'. Each maker has a name, username, headline, avatar, follower count and the posts they made. The response includes 'total_count' and claim status, and the returned 'end_cursor' can be passed as 'cursor' for the next page.

### `producthunt_product`

Retrieve Product Hunt product details. Returns the core Product Hunt product details. The path takes an exact Product Hunt slug; if you only know the product name, look the slug up first with '/producthunt/search' (live) or '/datasets/producthunt-products/search' (indexed). Unknown slugs return 404, and that 404 is cached for one hour.

### `producthunt_reviews`

Retrieve Product Hunt product detailed reviews. Lists the detailed reviews of a Product Hunt product, looked up by its slug in 'id'. Each review has its ratings, such as ease of use and customization, comment count, creation time, the launch it came from and any alternative products named. The response also gives the review counts and an 'end_cursor'.

### `producthunt_search`

Search for products, users, or launches on Product Hunt. Searches Product Hunt for the required 'query'. 'type' is 'product' (default), 'user' or 'launch', and 'page' starts at 1. 'featured' and 'topics' apply to launch search only. Results come as 'edges' with 'pageInfo' and 'pagesCount'; launch search also returns topic aggregations.

### `propublica_article`

Get ProPublica article content. Returns a ProPublica article by canonical 'url' ('propublica.org/article/<slug>'): title, authors, publication and update dates, the dek as 'description', lead image where available, section, a 'paywalled' flag and the body 'paragraphs'.

### `propublica_author`

Get a ProPublica staff profile. Returns one ProPublica staff/contributor's public profile: name, bio, contact email and social accounts where published, and one page of their recent bylined stories.

### `propublica_headlines`

Get ProPublica topic headlines. Returns the latest ProPublica stories for one topic. 'section' is required and takes one of 33 topic slugs, such as 'politics', 'health-care', 'immigration', 'courts', 'environment' or 'trump-administration'. Each item has its title, URL, publication time and author.

### `propublica_news`

Get ProPublica top stories. Returns the latest ProPublica top stories across topics. Takes no parameters. Each item has its title, URL, summary, publication time and image, plus the author byline, which can name more than one reporter.

### `propublica_sections`

Get ProPublica topics. Lists the 33 topics from ProPublica's Browse Topics menu that 'propublica-headlines' accepts. Each entry has a stable 'slug', a display 'name' and the topic's feed 'url'. Takes no parameters.

### `psa_autographfacts_categories`

List PSA AutographFacts categories. PSA AutographFacts' full subject-category list -- the discovery endpoint for the category_id parameter used to browse subjects. Categories span far beyond sports: Baseball, Basketball, Football, Boxing, Golf, Hockey, Soccer, Tennis, MMA, Miscellaneous Sports, Cycling, Olympics, Motorsports, Entertainment, Music, Writers/Authors/Artists, Space Exploration, U.S. Presidents, and Historical & Political Figures.

### `psa_autographfacts_gallery`

Get a PSA AutographFacts subject's exemplar image gallery. One autograph subject's full exemplar image gallery: real, captioned examples of authenticated signed items PSA keeps on file for this subject (signed photos, cards, baseballs, letters, contracts, and more), used as authentication reference material. subject_id is the numeric id from a psa-autographfacts-subjects result.

### `psa_autographfacts_subject`

Get a PSA AutographFacts subject's profile and price guide. One autograph subject's full public reference page: PSA's own authentication notes (signing habits, forgery risk, signature evolution), a general biography, and a per-item-type price guide (e.g. 3x5/AP card, photo, check, letter, single-signed ball -- item types vary by subject). subject_id is the numeric id from a psa-autographfacts-subjects result.

### `psa_autographfacts_subjects`

List PSA AutographFacts subjects in a category. Every autograph subject PSA AutographFacts lists for one category, each with the numeric subject_id to pass to psa-autographfacts-subject for that subject's full profile and price guide.

### `psa_cardfacts_categories`

List PSA CardFacts categories. PSA CardFacts' full category list -- the discovery endpoint for the category_id parameter used to browse sets. Nine categories: Baseball, Basketball, Boxing, Football, Golf, Hockey, Misc Sports, Multi-Sport, and Non-Sports/TCG.

### `psa_cardfacts_checklist`

Get a PSA CardFacts set's card checklist. One set's full card checklist: every card's name and printed number (number is empty for sets PSA lists without one, e.g. many autograph/player-only card sets). set_id is the numeric id from a psa-cardfacts-sets result.

### `psa_cardfacts_sets`

List PSA CardFacts sets in a category. Every card set PSA CardFacts lists for one category, each with the numeric set_id to pass to psa-cardfacts-checklist for that set's full card checklist.

### `psa_cert_lookup`

Verify a PSA certification number. Looks up PSA's own public Cert Verification record for one PSA-graded card by its certification number: item title, grade, label type, reverse cert/barcode flag, year, brand/title, subject, card number, category, PSA's own price estimate, and this-cert's-own population figures (population for this exact card+grade, and pop-higher). Scoped to PSA's trading-card department; a cert number issued under a different PSA division (autographs, tickets) returns a not-found error. PSA's full Population Report and Auction Prices Realized both require a PSA/Collectors account login and are not available through this endpoint.

### `psa_price_guide_categories`

List PSA Price Guide categories. PSA Price Guide's full category list -- the discovery endpoint for the category_path parameter used to browse or fetch a set's price table. Every category is a distinct collectible type (Baseball Cards, Basketball Cards, Boxing Cards, Football Cards, Golf Cards, Hockey Cards, Soccer Cards, Non-Sports/TCG Cards, Racing Cards, Sports Tickets, Tennis, Unopened Packs, Presidential Autographs, Sports Autographs, Professional Model/Game-Used Bats, Graded Baseballs).

### `psa_price_guide_search`

Search PSA Price Guide. Searches PSA Price Guide by free text (a player/subject name or set name), matching PSA's own site search box. Each result is a matching set with the query's matching cards/items inside it; use a result's category_path, set_path and set_id as the input to psa-price-guide-set to fetch that set's full price table.

### `psa_price_guide_set`

Get a PSA Price Guide set's price table. Fetches one PSA Price Guide set's full grade-by-grade price table: every card in the set with PSA's own formatted price per grade column (the set's own grade columns vary -- a vintage set may carry more/lower grade tiers than a modern one). category_path, set_path and set_id together identify the set; use the matching fields from a psa-price-guide-search result, or category_path from psa-price-guide-categories combined with a set_path/set_id found by browsing PSA's own category page.

### `psa_price_guide_sets`

Search PSA Price Guide set names. Searches PSA Price Guide by set name (for example "1974 topps" or "super bowl") using PSA's own browse-by-category pages. It matches set names only: it does not search card or player names, and results carry no card items. Use psa-price-guide-search for card and player search while PSA's own search is available. Every word of the query must start a word of the set name; exact and leading matches rank first. Each result's category_path, set_path and set_id are the inputs to psa-price-guide-set. Set lists are cached for 12 hours, so a first call after a cold start can take longer. If a category's set list cannot be loaded, the other categories still answer and unavailable_categories names the missing ones.

### `psa_probatfacts_categories`

List PSA ProBatFacts categories. PSA ProBatFacts' full player-category list -- the discovery endpoint for the category_id parameter used to browse players. Baseball-bat authentication only, split by Hall of Fame status: Hall of Fame Players, Star Players.

### `psa_probatfacts_gallery`

Get a PSA ProBatFacts player's exemplar image gallery. One player's full exemplar image gallery: real, captioned examples of authenticated bats PSA keeps on file for this player, used as authentication reference material. subject_id is the numeric id from a psa-probatfacts-subjects result.

### `psa_probatfacts_subject`

Get a PSA ProBatFacts player's bat-authentication reference page. One player's full public reference page: PSA's own bat-authentication notes (professional models used, signature placement) and a general player biography. Unlike psa-autographfacts-subject, this carries no price guide. subject_id is the numeric id from a psa-probatfacts-subjects result.

### `psa_probatfacts_subjects`

List PSA ProBatFacts subjects in a category. Every player PSA ProBatFacts lists for one category, each with the numeric subject_id to pass to psa-probatfacts-subject for that player's full bat-authentication reference page.

### `psa_ticketfacts_categories`

List PSA TicketFacts categories. PSA TicketFacts' full event-category list -- the discovery endpoint for the category_id parameter used to browse events. Spans NFL, MLB and NBA historic events: Super Bowl, World Series, MLB All Star Game, Historic Baseball Events, and Historic Basketball Events.

### `psa_ticketfacts_gallery`

Get a PSA TicketFacts event's exemplar image gallery. One event's full exemplar image gallery: real, captioned examples of authenticated tickets from this event PSA keeps on file, used as authentication reference material. subject_id is the numeric id from a psa-ticketfacts-subjects result.

### `psa_ticketfacts_subject`

Get a PSA TicketFacts event's ticket reference page. One event's full public ticket reference page: PSA's own historical writeup of the event and the ticket(s) involved. Unlike psa-autographfacts-subject, this carries no price guide. subject_id is the numeric id from a psa-ticketfacts-subjects result.

### `psa_ticketfacts_subjects`

List PSA TicketFacts subjects in a category. Every event PSA TicketFacts lists for one category, each with the numeric subject_id to pass to psa-ticketfacts-subject for that event's full ticket reference page.

### `psastore_collection_products`

List PSA Store collection products. Returns products from one PSA Team Store (https://store.psacard.com) collection. The storefront URL is fixed server-side; 'handle' is the collection's URL slug.

### `psastore_collections`

List PSA Store collections. Returns collections from the PSA Team Store (https://store.psacard.com). The storefront URL is fixed server-side. Valid empty result pages return '200' with an empty collections array.

### `psastore_page`

Get a PSA Store static page. Returns one PSA Team Store static page by its 'handle': title, URL, plain-text 'content' (HTML is stripped), and created, published and updated times. An unknown handle returns 404. When the store's standard page data is unavailable, 'transport_mode' is 'ssr_embedded' and 'id' is omitted.

### `psastore_pages`

List PSA Store static pages. Lists static pages from the PSA Team Store, 50 per page by default ('limit' up to 250, 'page' starts at 1). Each page has its 'handle', 'title', 'url', plain-text 'content' and timestamps. When 'transport_mode' is 'ssr_embedded', items carry only 'handle', 'url' and 'updated_at'.

### `psastore_product`

Get a PSA Store product. Returns product detail for one PSA Team Store (https://store.psacard.com) product handle. The storefront URL is fixed server-side; 'handle' is the product's URL slug.

### `psastore_product_recommendations`

List PSA Store product recommendations. Returns recommended products for one PSA Team Store (https://store.psacard.com) product handle. The storefront URL is fixed server-side.

### `psastore_products`

List PSA Store products. Returns products from the PSA Team Store's (https://store.psacard.com) public product catalog. The storefront URL is fixed server-side. Valid empty result pages return '200' with an empty products array.

### `psastore_search_suggest`

Get PSA Store search suggestions. Returns products, collections, and query suggestions from the PSA Team Store's (https://store.psacard.com) predictive search. The storefront URL is fixed server-side.

### `psastore_sitemap_urls`

List PSA Store sitemap URLs. Returns capped URL entries from the PSA Team Store's (https://store.psacard.com) child sitemaps matching the requested type. The storefront URL is fixed server-side.

### `psastore_sitemaps`

List PSA Store sitemaps. Returns child sitemap URLs from the PSA Team Store's (https://store.psacard.com) '/sitemap.xml' index with inferred sitemap types. The storefront URL is fixed server-side.

### `psastore_store`

Get PSA Store store metadata. Returns storefront metadata for the PSA Team Store (https://store.psacard.com). The storefront URL is fixed server-side, so no 'url' parameter is accepted.

### `punch_article`

Get Punch article content. Returns a Punch article by canonical 'url' ('https://punchng.com/<slug>/'): title, description, publication and update times, section, authors, image and the body 'paragraphs'. Punch articles are free to read, so 'paywalled' is never set. Video-led stories may have only a short text summary.

### `punch_author`

Get a Punch author archive. Returns a Punch author's name and their most recent articles (the first archive page, about 30) from a canonical 'url' ('https://punchng.com/author/<slug>/'). 'total_pages' is the number of archive pages. Punch author pages have no biography, photo or social links, so none are returned. An unknown author returns not-found.

### `punch_headlines`

Get Punch section headlines. Returns the current stories, about 30, from one Punch topic page. 'section' is required and takes a topic slug such as 'news', 'politics', 'business', 'sports', 'metro-plus' or 'top-stories'; any other value is an invalid-parameter error. Each item has a title and article URL, plus summary, publication time and image URL when the page shows them.

### `punch_news`

Get Punch top stories. Returns the latest Punch stories from punchng.com: title, article URL, summary, author and publication time. Takes no parameters. Punch labels its times as UTC but publishes them in West Africa Time (UTC+1), and 'published_at' is corrected for that one-hour skew.

### `punch_sections`

Get Punch sections. Lists the Punch topic slugs that 'punch-headlines' accepts, such as 'news', 'politics', 'business' and 'sports'. Each entry has a 'slug', a display 'name' and the topic page 'url'. The list covers top-level topics linked from Punch's navigation or active in the 90 days before 2026-09-25.

### `quince_categories`

List Quince's product facet taxonomy. Returns Quince's full product facet taxonomy: every business department (Women, Men, Kids & Baby, Home, CPG, Emerging), department, category, material, primary color, and size value Quince currently has products for, each with its own live product count. The returned business_departments[].value/categories[].value/materials[].value/colors[].value/sizes[].value values are exactly what quince-search accepts as its own department/category/material/color/size parameters. sizes spans every product type Quince sells (apparel letter sizes, shoe sizes, rug/furniture dimensions, bedding sizes, and more) since it is one catalog-wide facet.

### `quince_navigation`

Get Quince's header navigation menu. Returns Quince's full header navigation mega-menu: top-level tabs (Women, Men, Home, Baby & Kids, Travel, Bags & Accessories, Jewelry, Beauty & Wellness, Gifts, plus promotional tabs like New Arrivals/Best Sellers/$50 Cashmere), each broken into the same named subcategory groups (for example Apparel, Jewelry, Shoes) shown in Quince's own nav dropdown, with a directly browsable slug on every category and link. This is a distinct taxonomy from quince-categories' facets: navigation is Quince's own curated site structure, while quince-categories reports live per-value product counts for quince-search's own filter parameters.

### `quince_product`

Get a Quince product. Returns product-detail data for one Quince product: title, description, review summary, every selectable option (color swatches with hex codes, sizes), and every color/size variant with its own price, original ("traditional retail") price, stock status, and SKU. handle is the product's URL path on quince.com (for example women/cashmere/cashmere-crewneck-sweater), returned by quince-search's own products[].handle field.

### `quince_product_faq`

Get a Quince product's FAQ content. Returns a Quince product's own question/answer content (e.g. sizing, care, fit), from the same structured product data quince-product-reviews uses. handle is the same value quince-product accepts. Not every product carries FAQ content -- a product with none returns a well-formed empty result.

### `quince_product_reviews`

Get Quince product reviews. Returns a sample of a Quince product's customer reviews (author, date, rating, review body), plus the product's overall aggregate rating and review count. handle is the same value quince-product accepts. The reviews returned are a sample (25 reviews on every product sampled), not a paginated feed of the full review history. A product with no reviews yet returns a well-formed empty result.

### `quince_search`

Search or browse Quince products. Searches or browses Quince's (quince.com) product catalog. q, department, category, material, color, size, min_price, and max_price are all optional and combine as an AND -- unlike some other families' search/category-browse split, a free-text q can be combined with any of the facet filters in the same request, or every field can be omitted to browse the full catalog by Quince's own relevance/popularity ranking. department accepts one of the values quince-categories' own business_departments[].value field returns (for example Women, Men, Kids & Baby, Home, CPG, Emerging); category, material, color, and size similarly accept values from quince-categories' own categories[].value/materials[].value/colors[].value/sizes[].value fields (or quince-navigation's own browsable category/subcategory slugs for a curated, hierarchical alternative to the flat category facet). Keyword search uses typo-tolerant relevance ranking, not a guaranteed exact match. A query with genuinely zero matches (for example a nonsense string) returns a well-formed empty result rather than an error.

### `quince_sitemap_urls`

List Quince sitemap URLs. Returns capped URL entries from Quince's own sitemaps matching the requested type. Each entry's handle is populated from the URL's own path (tracking/variant query parameters stripped) -- for type products, this is directly the value quince-product's own handle parameter expects.

### `quince_sitemaps`

List Quince sitemaps. Returns Quince's US-region child sitemaps (products, collections, subcollections, and static pages) with an inferred type, from quince.com's own public sitemap index.

### `quince_suggest`

Get Quince search suggestions. Returns Quince's own search-box typeahead suggestions for a partial query: a flat list of suggested search phrases, no product data. Pass a suggestion straight through to quince-search's own q parameter for product results. A query with no genuine matches returns a well-formed empty result rather than an error.

### `qwant_suggest`

Suggest Qwant search queries. Returns Qwant search-box autocomplete completions for a query prefix, in Qwant's own ranking order. 'locale' selects the Qwant market (en_US, fr_FR, de_DE, en_GB, ...); Qwant ignores locale codes it does not support and uses its default market.

### `raisingcanes_directory`

Browse the Raising Cane's store directory. Returns one level of Raising Cane's store directory tree. Omit path for the root, which lists the US states Raising Cane's operates in; pass a child's path to descend (state to cities, city to stores). Each child carries its name, path, URL and how many stores sit under that branch. A child with is_store true is a store record rather than another directory level -- pass its path to GET /raisingcanes/store. This is a directory browse, not a proximity search: use GET /raisingcanes/nearby for a radius lookup.

### `raisingcanes_menu`

Get Raising Cane's full published menu. Returns Raising Cane's full published menu: every section (Combos, Tailgates, Extras, Drinks) and every item, each with its name, Raising Cane's own item description (commonly ending in a calorie count or range), and image. This is a single fixed national menu page, not a per-store or per-region menu -- it takes no parameters. Raising Cane's does not publish price on this page; pricing lives behind the separate order.raisingcanes.com ordering flow, which needs a selected store and is out of scope here.

### `raisingcanes_nearby`

Find Raising Cane's stores near a coordinate, nearest first. Returns Raising Cane's restaurants within a radius of a latitude/longitude, ordered nearest first, each with its distance in miles and kilometres, address, coordinates, timezone, price tier and which pickup/delivery services it offers. This proximity result carries less detail than GET /raisingcanes/store (Raising Cane's own nearby-search key is not configured with hours or phone) -- each result's 'path' chains straight into GET /raisingcanes/store for the full record. 'total_in_radius' reports how many stores fall inside the radius overall, which is usually far more than one page; use 'offset' to walk it. A coordinate with no Raising Cane's nearby returns an empty list rather than an error.

### `raisingcanes_promotion`

Get one Raising Cane's promotion's terms. Returns one Raising Cane's promotion's published official terms: title and official-rules text (eligibility, prize details, effective date), exactly as the promotion's own page publishes them, as separate paragraphs in publication order. Promotion paths come from GET /raisingcanes/promotions entries. A path with no promotion at it (expired, mistyped, or the empty path some index entries carry) returns a 404.

### `raisingcanes_promotions`

Browse Raising Cane's promotions index. Returns Raising Cane's full promotions index: every current and past sweepstakes, giveaway, and other promotion the site links to, grouped under Raising Cane's own category headings (e.g. "Sweepstakes & Giveaways", "Lucky Promotions", "First Promotions"). Each entry's path chains into GET /raisingcanes/promotion for that promotion's full official-rules text. Some entries carry an empty path -- Raising Cane's own index links a since-expired promotion back to the homepage rather than removing the entry; treat an empty path as no longer resolvable rather than a bug.

### `raisingcanes_store`

Get one Raising Cane's store's detail. Returns one Raising Cane's store: name, full postal address, phone, coordinates, its general weekly hours plus separately published dine-in and drive-thru hours, Raising Cane's own per-store amenity labels (e.g. DRIVE_THRU, CURBSIDE_PICKUP), which pickup/delivery services it offers, and its Google Place id. Store paths come from GET /raisingcanes/directory entries whose is_store is true. Passing a directory path here returns a 404 rather than a hollow record.

### `rappler_article`

Get Rappler article content. Returns public Rappler article metadata and body paragraphs from a canonical article URL. Rappler+ member-tier stories are flagged with paywalled.

### `rappler_author`

Get a Rappler author profile. Returns a Rappler author's profile, looked up by 'slug' (for example 'delfin-dioquino') or by canonical 'url'; exactly one is required. The response has the name, 'bio', 'social_links' and the 10 most recent articles, each with title, URL, section and publication time. There is no further paging. 'bio' and 'social_links' are omitted when empty; an unknown author returns not-found.

### `rappler_headlines`

Get Rappler section headlines. Returns the latest Rappler stories for one section. 'section' is required and takes one of the site's category slugs, such as 'business', 'nation', 'entertainment', 'fact-check', 'investigative' or 'climate-change'. Each item has its title, URL, summary, publication time and author, plus an image when the outlet provides one.

### `rappler_news`

Get Rappler top stories. Returns the newest Rappler stories across all sections. Takes no parameters. Each item has its title, canonical article URL, a short summary, publication time, author byline and lead image.

### `rappler_sections`

Get Rappler sections. Lists the 175 Rappler categories that have a live feed and are accepted by 'rappler-headlines', such as 'news-updates', 'business', 'nation', 'fact-check' and 'climate-change'. Each entry has a 'slug', a display 'name' and the category 'url'.

### `rawstory_article`

Get Raw Story article content. Returns a Raw Story article by canonical 'url' on 'rawstory.com', for example 'https://www.rawstory.com/trump-media-ban-2677933730/': title, description, publication and update times, section, authors, image and body 'paragraphs' (embedded videos excluded). 'section' is omitted for slug-only URLs. Hub, tag and author URLs return an invalid-params error; a missing story returns not-found.

### `rawstory_author`

Get a Raw Story author profile. Returns a Raw Story author's profile, looked up by 'slug' (for example 'bennitokelty') or canonical 'url'; exactly one is required. The response has the name, 'bio', avatar, social links and the 15 most recent stories, each with title, URL and a 'YYYY-MM-DD' date. Older stories are not reachable, and an unknown author returns not-found.

### `rawstory_headlines`

Get Raw Story section headlines. Returns the latest Raw Story stories, up to 30, for one section hub. 'section' is required and takes one of 15 slugs such as 'us-news', 'trump-news', 'world', 'commentary' or 'supreme-court'. Each item has its title, URL, lead-paragraph summary, publication time, author and image when given. The dormant 'presidential-campaign-issues' hub returns 9 stories.

### `rawstory_news`

Get Raw Story top stories. Returns the 30 newest Raw Story stories across all sections. Takes no parameters. Each item has its title, story URL, a lead-paragraph summary capped at 500 characters, publication time, author byline and lead image.

### `rawstory_sections`

Get Raw Story sections. Lists the 15 section and topic hubs that 'rawstory-headlines' accepts. Each entry has a 'slug', a display 'name' such as 'U.S. News' or 'Raw Exclusives', and the hub page 'url'. Hubs overlap: 'us-news', 'trump-news' and 'smartnews' share most recent stories, and 'presidential-campaign-issues' is dormant.

### `rebag_collection_products`

List Rebag collection products. Returns products from one Rebag (https://shop.rebag.com) collection. The storefront URL is fixed server-side; 'handle' is the collection's URL slug.

### `rebag_collections`

List Rebag collections. Returns collections from Rebag (https://shop.rebag.com). The storefront URL is fixed server-side. Valid empty result pages return '200' with an empty collections array.

### `rebag_page`

Get a Rebag static page. Looks up a single Rebag static page by 'handle', for example 'welcome-trendlee'. The response has the page's id, title, URL, publication and update times, and its 'content' as plain text. Unknown handles return 404. If 'transport_mode' is 'ssr_embedded', 'id' is left out.

### `rebag_pages`

List Rebag static pages. Lists the static pages on Rebag's storefront, paged with 'page' (from 1) and 'limit' (default 50, max 250). Each entry has 'handle', 'title', 'url', plain-text 'content' and its dates. An empty page of results returns an empty 'pages' array. In 'ssr_embedded' mode only 'handle', 'url' and 'updated_at' are filled.

### `rebag_product`

Get a Rebag product. Returns product detail for one Rebag (https://shop.rebag.com) product handle. The storefront URL is fixed server-side; 'handle' is the product's URL slug.

### `rebag_product_recommendations`

List Rebag product recommendations. Returns recommended products for one Rebag (https://shop.rebag.com) product handle. The storefront URL is fixed server-side.

### `rebag_products`

List Rebag products. Returns products from Rebag's (https://shop.rebag.com) public product catalog. The storefront URL is fixed server-side. Valid empty result pages return '200' with an empty products array.

### `rebag_search`

Search Rebag products. Returns ranked products from Rebag's (https://shop.rebag.com) own full-text product search, including a best-effort condition grade and colour derived from the product's own catalog tags -- attributes not available from the other catalog endpoints in this family. The storefront URL is fixed server-side.

### `rebag_search_suggest`

Get Rebag search suggestions. Returns products, collections, and query suggestions from Rebag's (https://shop.rebag.com) predictive search. The storefront URL is fixed server-side.

### `rebag_sitemap_urls`

List Rebag sitemap URLs. Lists URL entries from Rebag's sitemaps, filtered by 'type' ('all', 'products', 'collections', 'pages', 'blogs', 'agentic_discovery' or 'other'; default 'all'). Collection stops at 'limit' entries (default 50, max 250). Each entry has 'loc', 'type', 'handle', 'lastmod', 'changefreq' and, where present, 'images' with caption, title and URL.

### `rebag_sitemaps`

List Rebag sitemaps. Lists the child sitemaps in Rebag's sitemap index. Each entry has its 'loc' and a 'type' of 'products', 'collections', 'pages', 'blogs', 'agentic_discovery' or 'other', worked out from the sitemap URL. The endpoint takes no parameters.

### `rebag_store`

Get Rebag store metadata. Returns storefront metadata for Rebag (https://shop.rebag.com). The storefront URL is fixed server-side, so no 'url' parameter is accepted.

### `reddit_archive_comments_ids`

Look up archived Reddit comments by ids. Looks up known Reddit comment ids in Arctic Shift's historical archive. Supply 1 to 1,000 comma-separated ids; duplicates are removed, results follow input order, and missing ids are listed separately. The service sends at most two upstream requests of up to 500 ids each. Archived scores are snapshots, and removed_by_category is included when available.

### `reddit_archive_comments_search`

Search archived Reddit comments. Searches Arctic Shift's public historical comment archive. Supply at least one of query, author, subreddit, link_id, or parent_id; date bounds can further narrow that search. query searches comment body text and must be combined with author, subreddit, link_id, or parent_id; it maps to Arctic Shift's body parameter. Arctic Shift may time out or throttle broad searches, which return 503 with Retry-After. created_after/created_before are time boundaries, not Reddit listing cursors. Each comment includes created_utc and retrieved_on; archived scores can lag changes for roughly 36 hours. A valid query with no matches returns an empty comments array.

### `reddit_archive_comments_tree`

Get an archived Reddit comment tree. Returns a bounded nested comment tree from Arctic Shift's public archive. 't1' entries contain comments and their replies; 'more' entries mark collapsed branches and include child ids/counts. Omitted parent_id requests the whole tree, while an explicitly empty parent_id requests top-level comments only. Empty archived trees return 200 with an empty comments array. Archived scores can lag changes for roughly 36 hours; slow or throttled upstream requests return 503 with Retry-After.

### `reddit_archive_posts_ids`

Look up archived Reddit posts by ids. Looks up known Reddit post ids in Arctic Shift's historical archive. Supply 1 to 1,000 comma-separated ids; duplicates are removed, results follow input order, and missing ids are listed separately. The service sends at most two upstream requests of up to 500 ids each. Archived scores and comment counts are snapshots, and removed_by_category is included when available.

### `reddit_archive_posts_search`

Search archived Reddit posts. Searches Arctic Shift's public historical post archive. Supply at least one of query, author, subreddit, or url; date bounds can further narrow that search. This is separate from the live Reddit search endpoint. created_after/created_before are time boundaries, not Reddit listing cursors; posts include created_utc and retrieved_on so callers can see when the archive captured each record. Archived scores and comment counts can lag changes for roughly 36 hours. A valid query with no matches returns an empty posts array. Slow or throttled upstream searches return 503 with Retry-After.

### `reddit_archive_subreddits_search`

Search Reddit's archived subreddit directory. Searches Arctic Shift's native subreddit directory by name prefix. Directory metadata is updated infrequently; subscriber counts are archived snapshots and retrieved_on indicates when the source captured the entry. The selectable fields are limited to the verified public directory fields.

### `reddit_archive_time_series`

Get historical Reddit archive time series. Returns Arctic Shift's native time-series values. Supply an absolute creation-time range and a precision; ranges that could exceed 1,000 points are rejected. Counts, score sums, and retrieval-delay sums are archive metrics, not current Reddit totals. Arctic Shift says time-series data may be approximate and take hours or days to update.

### `reddit_comments`

Get Reddit post comments. Returns a Reddit post with its public comments. The default mode is 1 credit. Set 'include_metrics=true' to return the comments with public net score and award count plus post engagement metrics for 3 credits. Large threads may expose only an initial comment subset. Reddit does not expose per-comment upvote ratios or exact upvote/downvote totals anonymously. A post that exists but has no comments yet returns a 200 response with an empty comments list; a post that does not exist returns 404, and a temporary block or upstream failure returns 503 (retryable) rather than 404. If source.type is redlib, public fields and credit weights are preserved.

### `reddit_domain_posts`

List Reddit domain posts. Returns public posts submitted from a linked domain. A '503' with a 'Retry-After' header means Reddit is temporarily throttling the request; wait that many seconds and retry. If source.type is redlib, public fields and credit weights are preserved.

### `reddit_leads`

Find Reddit buying-intent leads. Scans a Reddit search page for people actively asking for a product or service, scores each post 0-10 for buying intent, and returns them ranked highest-first with the signals that fired. Self-promotion, hiring posts, freelancer service adverts, revenue-milestone posts, duplicate reposts, and Title Case article headlines are filtered out before scoring. A deterministic prefilter always runs; when 'classifier' resolves to 'llm' the surviving candidates are additionally refined in one batched model call. A '503' with a 'Retry-After' header means Reddit is temporarily throttling the request; wait that many seconds and retry. The lead-response fields and credit weights are preserved regardless of the underlying Reddit data source.

### `reddit_post`

Get Reddit post. Returns a public Reddit post. The default mode is 1 credit. Set 'include_metrics=true' to return public net score, upvote ratio, comment count, award count, and estimated upvote/downvote totals for 3 credits. Reddit fuzzes voting data, so estimates are approximate; share, repost/crosspost, and view counts are not exposed anonymously. If source.type is redlib, public fields and credit weights are preserved.

### `reddit_search`

Search Reddit posts. Searches public Reddit content and returns public post entries. A '503' with a 'Retry-After' header means Reddit is temporarily throttling the request; wait that many seconds and retry. If source.type is redlib, public fields and credit weights are preserved.

### `reddit_subreddit_about`

Get Reddit subreddit metadata. Returns public metadata and sample posts for a subreddit. Subscriber counts, icons, and banners are omitted because they are not available on anonymous Reddit pages. A '503' with a 'Retry-After' header means Reddit is temporarily throttling the request; wait that many seconds and retry. If source.type is redlib, public fields and credit weights are preserved.

### `reddit_subreddit_comments`

List Reddit subreddit comments. Returns flat public comment entries from a subreddit latest-comments feed. A '503' with a 'Retry-After' header means Reddit is temporarily throttling the request; wait that many seconds and retry. If source.type is redlib, public fields and credit weights are preserved.

### `reddit_subreddit_posts`

List Reddit subreddit posts. Returns public posts from a subreddit. A '503' with a 'Retry-After' header means Reddit is temporarily throttling the request; wait that many seconds and retry. If source.type is redlib, public fields and credit weights are preserved.

### `reddit_subreddits_posts`

List Reddit multi-subreddit posts. Returns public posts from a combined multi-subreddit feed. A '503' with a 'Retry-After' header means Reddit is temporarily throttling the request; wait that many seconds and retry. If source.type is redlib, public fields and credit weights are preserved.

### `reddit_trends`

List Reddit trends. Returns public posts from broad Reddit hot, new, rising, or top feeds. For subreddit-specific trends, use '/reddit/subreddit/{subreddit}/posts' with 'sort=hot', 'sort=new', 'sort=rising', or 'sort=top'. A '503' with a 'Retry-After' header means Reddit is temporarily throttling the request; wait that many seconds and retry. If source.type is redlib, public fields and credit weights are preserved.

### `reddit_user_comments`

List Reddit user comments. Returns flat public comment entries from a public Reddit user's comments feed. A '503' with a 'Retry-After' header means Reddit is temporarily throttling the request; wait that many seconds and retry. If source.type is redlib, public fields and credit weights are preserved.

### `reddit_user_posts`

List Reddit user posts. Returns public posts from a public Reddit user's submitted feed. A '503' with a 'Retry-After' header means Reddit is temporarily throttling the request; wait that many seconds and retry. If source.type is redlib, public fields and credit weights are preserved.

### `redfin_estimate`

Get Redfin Estimate. Returns the Redfin Estimate for a property, including the current estimate, property facts, and the monthly estimate history with city/county/postal comparatives. Faithful pass-through of Redfin's public avm + avmHistoricalData resources.

### `redfin_property`

Get Redfin property. Returns Redfin public property details. Provide a listing url, or a property_id (optionally with listing_id).

### `redfin_region_trends`

Get Redfin region market trends. Returns Redfin's aggregate market trends for a region (median list/sale price, sale-to-list, offers, days on market, inventory, year-over-year). Faithful pass-through of Redfin's public aggregate-trends resource.

### `redfin_search`

Search Redfin listings. Returns Redfin public listing search results. Pass region_id/region_type from autocomplete to skip location resolution.

### `redfin_similar`

Get Redfin comparable listings. Returns the comparable listings Redfin shows for a property, identified by the required 'property_id'. Each row has the address, city, state, zip, price, beds, baths, 'sqft', 'price_per_sqft', days on market, MLS number, 'hoa_monthly', lot size, year built, status, image and URL, plus coordinates when present.

### `reelshort_fandom_categories`

List ReelShort Fandom's article categories. Returns the categories of ReelShort's (reelshort.com) editorial site, Fandom (cast profiles, plot write-ups, streaming guides): id, slug, name, description, number of articles and link, read live from ReelShort. Pass a category slug to reelshort-fandom-posts. Only public editorial text is read.

### `reelshort_fandom_post`

Get a ReelShort Fandom article. Returns one article from ReelShort's (reelshort.com) editorial site, Fandom: title, excerpt, link, image, publish and modify times, category names, the full article text as plain text, and the ids of the ReelShort titles it links to (pass them to reelshort-movie). id is the article id, its slug, or its reelshort.com/fandom URL. Only public editorial text is read. An unknown article returns not found.

### `reelshort_fandom_posts`

List ReelShort Fandom articles. Lists articles from ReelShort's (reelshort.com) editorial site, Fandom, newest first: id, slug, title, excerpt, link, image, publish and modify times and category names, with the total and page count. Filter by search text and by category slug (general-topic, movie-cast-list, top-movie-stories, where-to-watch or where-to-watch-2). Pass an article id to reelshort-fandom-post for its text. Only public editorial text is read.

### `reelshort_home`

List ReelShort's home page shelves. Returns ReelShort's (reelshort.com) home page as ranked shelves of short dramas (New Release, TOP, Reel Original, Hidden Identity, and so on): shelf id and name, and for each title its id, title, description, cover, ReelShort link, episode count, tags, plays, favorites and the episode from which viewing is paid. Pass a shelf id to reelshort-shelf for the whole list. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

### `reelshort_movie`

Get a ReelShort short drama and its episodes. Returns one ReelShort short drama: title, description, cover, link, language, episode count, plays, favorites, badge, dubbed and AI-generated flags, release times, tags with their kind (genre, style, mood, trope and more), cast with IMDb links, and the full episode list with each episode's id, number, link, likes, release time and whether it is free. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

### `reelshort_new_releases`

List ReelShort's curated New Release titles. Returns ReelShort's (reelshort.com) curated "New Release" list from its website's signed JSON API: up to 18 titles with id, name, description, cover, reelshort.com link, episode count, plays, favorites and the first paid episode. book_id is a 24-character title id required by ReelShort's own API; on 2026-10-26 four different values, including an unknown id, returned the same list, so it is not known to change the result. Only public catalogue data is read and no playable media is returned.

### `reelshort_search`

Search ReelShort short dramas by title. Searches ReelShort (reelshort.com) short dramas by keyword and returns 12 titles per page: id, title, description, cover, link, episode count, tags, plays and favorites, with the page, page count and an approximate total. The search is fuzzy and the total varies between calls. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

### `reelshort_shelf`

Get a whole ReelShort shelf. Returns one whole ReelShort shelf, such as TOP (up to 200 titles) or New Release: shelf id, name and every title with its id, title, description, cover, link, episode count, tags, plays and favorites. Shelf ids come from reelshort-home. Only public catalog metadata is read; no playable video is returned.

### `reelshort_tag_books`

List the ReelShort titles carrying a tag. Returns a ReelShort (reelshort.com) tag and one page of the titles that carry it: the tag's id, kind and name, its top titles, related tags, and for each title its id, name, description, cover, reelshort.com link, plays and favorites. tag_id is a 24-character tag id from reelshort-tags, reelshort-tag-search or reelshort-movie. Pages hold up to 100 titles and ReelShort lists over a thousand titles for the biggest tags. Only public catalogue data is read and no playable media is returned. An unknown tag returns not found.

### `reelshort_tag_search`

Search ReelShort tags by text. Searches ReelShort's (reelshort.com) tags by text: an actor or actress name, an identity or a trope. Returns one page of up to 50 matches, each with its tag id, name, kind, the number of titles ReelShort's search lists for it and an image. A search with no match returns an empty list. Pass a tag id to reelshort-tag-books for the titles carrying it. Only public catalogue data is read and no playable media is returned.

### `reelshort_tags`

List ReelShort's featured tags in one category. Returns ReelShort's (reelshort.com) featured tags for one category: actor, actress, identity (Billionaire, CEO, Werewolf...) or trope (Flash Marriage, Revenge...), about 48 per category, each with its tag id, kind and name. Pass a tag id to reelshort-tag-books for the titles carrying it. category is one of actor, actress, identity or trope; language is a site language and defaults to en. Only public catalogue data is read and no playable media is returned.

### `research_cancel`

Cancel a research job. Requests cancellation of the caller's own research job, given by 'job_id'. Returns the job's current state (such as 'cancelling'), 'cancel_requested', 'partial', progress counts, research progress and usage. Results already retained stay readable and are marked partial where appropriate.

### `research_events`

Read research job events. Reads a page of events for one of the caller's research jobs, by 'job_id'. 'limit' is 1 to 100 (default 50); pass 'next_cursor' back as 'cursor' to continue, with 'has_more' showing whether more remain. Each event has 'sequence', 'type' (such as 'source_fetched' or 'round_completed'), 'timestamp', 'message' and 'source_id'.

### `research_inspect_paper`

Inspect paper metadata. Return paper records including titles, abstracts when available, authors, publication dates and verified identifier aliases. Europe PMC resolution is limited to MED-backed PMID, PMCID and DOI records; no full-text body is fetched.

### `research_read_paper`

Read a research paper. Return licensed Europe PMC body prose, question-ranked passages, byte locators, license and content provenance. Restricted or unavailable bodies return metadata-only availability; arXiv does not fetch PDFs. Full text costs 5 credits, metadata-only reads 1.

### `research_related_papers`

Get paper references or citing papers. Return one-hop Europe PMC citation edges, canonical seed IDs, source provenance and a frozen owner-bound cursor. Modes are references and citers; intent is unsupported. Partial results explicitly report indexed-source and candidate-window limits.

### `research_results`

Read all retained research results. Returns the complete owner-scoped retained result prefix up to a consistent manifest sequence. Before a valid report or structured result exists, returns 'ready=false' with 'partial=true' and any retained evidence.

### `research_search_papers`

Search research papers. Search arXiv papers with an owner-bound frozen result window and cursor-only continuation. When arXiv is rate limited or unavailable, an undated search is answered from OpenAlex's index of arXiv papers and the response says so in coverage and warnings.

### `research_sources`

List paper sources. Return the stable authenticated paper source registry, including arXiv search and MED-backed Europe PMC metadata, licensed text and citation operations.

### `research_start`

Start a durable cross-corpus research job. Submits bounded research over the selected web, arXiv paper, and developer-document sources. Repeated owner-scoped idempotency requests return the original job.

### `research_status`

Read a research job status. Returns the state of a research job by 'job_id': queued, running, cancelling, succeeded, failed or cancelled. The response carries 'progress' counts, 'research' progress (round, searches completed, sources read, questions answered), usage, warnings, 'partial', 'deadline_at' and any error. A job not started within 30 minutes fails with 'timeout'.

### `resy_availability`

Get a Resy restaurant's bookable reservation timeslots. Returns the bookable reservation timeslots Resy currently shows for a restaurant, date, and party size -- the same read-only availability an anonymous visitor sees before signing in. The date is optional and defaults to the current date in UTC; the response echoes the date used. This is discovery only; it does not create, hold, modify, or cancel a reservation.

### `resy_cuisines`

Get the cuisines present in a Resy location. Returns the cuisines present among restaurants in a Resy location. Location is a short city code or numeric location id -- both already returned inline as location_code on resy-search and resy-restaurant results; there is no separate closed list of every valid location on Resy's own API, so this value always comes from a prior search/restaurant response rather than a guessed input.

### `resy_event_detail`

Get a Resy ticketed dining event's full description and ticket packages. Returns a ticketed dining event's full description, event-day instructions, and per-ticket-tier package breakdown (price, what's included, live ticket availability). All three identifiers come from a prior resy-events result: event_url_slug is that result's url_slug, restaurant_url_slug is its restaurant_url_slug, and location is the same city identifier resy-events was called with. Read-only discovery -- does not purchase a ticket.

### `resy_events`

Get ticketed dining events in a Resy location. Returns ticketed dining events (fixed-price, fixed-capacity experiences a restaurant hosts and sells tickets for, distinct from a regular reservation) in a Resy location. Read-only discovery -- does not create, hold, or purchase a ticket.

### `resy_locations`

List Resy's operating locations (cities). Returns Resy's full list of operating locations (cities), optionally filtered by a free-text substring and/or country. This is the discovery source for the location value used throughout the rest of this family (resy-search's/resy-restaurant's location_code, resy-cuisines'/resy-events'/resy-event-detail's location).

### `resy_restaurant`

Get a Resy restaurant's profile. Returns a Resy restaurant's profile by the required 'restaurant_id': name, cuisine, 'price_range' (1 to 4), rating, review count, address, neighborhood, coordinates, phone, website, menu URL, party size limits, description, 'why_we_like_it', 'need_to_know' and images. 'location_code' is a short city identifier.

### `resy_search`

Search Resy restaurants near a location. Searches restaurants by free-text term (name, cuisine, or neighborhood) near a latitude/longitude, optionally including live bookable-timeslot availability for a given date and party size.

### `retailmenot_autocomplete`

Get RetailMeNot search suggestions. Returns RetailMeNot's search-box suggestions for a free-text term: matching stores (with domains usable with /retailmenot/store) and cash-back offers. Group names are returned as data.

### `retailmenot_blog_categories`

List RetailMeNot blog categories. Returns every category of RetailMeNot's shopping and savings blog with its slug, post count, description, and URL. Use a slug as the category filter of /retailmenot/blog-posts.

### `retailmenot_blog_post`

Get a RetailMeNot blog post. Returns one RetailMeNot blog post: metadata (title, author, dates, description, image, categories, tags), the article text as headed sections of paragraphs and lists, and the RetailMeNot stores and coupon categories the article links to (usable with /retailmenot/store and /retailmenot/category).

### `retailmenot_blog_posts`

List RetailMeNot blog posts. Returns one page of RetailMeNot blog posts (title, slug, URL, excerpt, description, author, published and modified dates, image, categories, and tags) with total and total pages, newest first by default. Filter by category slug, tag slug, and/or a search query; order by date, modified, title, or relevance (relevance requires query). A page past the end returns an empty list.

### `retailmenot_blog_tags`

List RetailMeNot blog tags. Returns one page of RetailMeNot blog tags ordered by post count, with slug, name, post count, and URL, plus total and total pages; optionally only tags matching a query. Use a slug as the tag filter of /retailmenot/blog-posts.

### `retailmenot_cashback`

List RetailMeNot cash-back offers. Lists the offers on RetailMeNot's cash-back page, grouped into sections such as Today's Featured Cash Back, Top Cash Back and All Cash Back Offers. Each offer has its position, store name, domain and RetailMeNot URL, the cash-back rate in 'discount', and a title. It takes no parameters.

### `retailmenot_categories`

List RetailMeNot coupon categories. Lists RetailMeNot's coupon category tree as a flat list with no parameters. Each entry has 'name', 'slug', 'url' and 'level' (1 parent, 2 child, 3 grandchild); levels 2 and 3 also carry 'parent_slug'. The 'slug' is what RetailMeNot's category endpoint takes.

### `retailmenot_category`

Get a RetailMeNot category's offers. Returns one page of a RetailMeNot category landing page: the featured offers across stores (24 per page, with page and total_pages), offer counts, and similar stores. Use a slug from /retailmenot/categories; a page past the end returns an empty offer list.

### `retailmenot_deal_event`

Get a RetailMeNot deal event's offers. Returns one seasonal deal event page's offers grouped into the page's sections (top deals and per-category sections). Use a slug from /retailmenot/deal-events.

### `retailmenot_deal_events`

List RetailMeNot seasonal deal events. Lists the seasonal and holiday deal events linked from RetailMeNot's deals hub, such as Black Friday or Back-to-School, each with 'name', 'slug' and 'url'. The 'slug' feeds the deal-event endpoint. Out-of-season events may list fewer offers. It takes no parameters.

### `retailmenot_home`

Get RetailMeNot's homepage offers. Returns RetailMeNot's homepage: featured offer sections (cash-back stores with rates, seasonal savings deals with store, offer type, discount, and title), today's top product deals (title, discount, image, and retailer product URL), and the help FAQ.

### `retailmenot_store`

Get a RetailMeNot store's coupons and offers. Returns a store's RetailMeNot page: store details, shopper rating, category, offer counts, every listed coupon, sale, cash-back, and in-store offer (including the offers behind the page's "show more" button), similar stores, and FAQs. Coupon codes are only revealed on RetailMeNot after a click and are not returned. Set market=ca for a RetailMeNot Canada store page.

### `retailmenot_stores`

List RetailMeNot stores by letter. Returns every store in one letter of RetailMeNot's A-Z store directory, or of RetailMeNot Canada's store list with market=ca, with the domain to pass to /retailmenot/store (with the same market).

### `reuters_article`

Get a Reuters article's content. Returns one normal Reuters article's public metadata and body paragraphs from a canonical article URL. Live blogs, video and podcast pages, and subscriber-only or bot-challenged responses are not supported.

### `reuters_articles`

Get recent Reuters articles. Returns a page of recent Reuters articles: canonical URL, update time, and the lead image URL when available, plus the title when Reuters publishes one in this index (currently it does not). The index covers the most recent 10,000 articles. Use /reuters/news for a title-bearing feed of fresh stories, or /reuters/article for one article's title and text.

### `reuters_author`

Get a Reuters author profile. Returns a Reuters author's profile by canonical 'url' ('https://www.reuters.com/authors/<slug>/'): name, company, editorial email, social accounts, profile image, 'total_articles' and the first 20 recent articles, each with title, URL, summary, publication time and an image when the story card has one. Accounts the page does not list are absent.

### `reuters_news`

Get fresh Reuters headlines. Returns fresh Reuters headlines with title, canonical URL, publication and update times, and the lead image when Reuters publishes one. Covers the most recent stories from Reuters' public news feed.

### `reuters_section`

Get recent articles in a Reuters section. Returns a page of one top-level Reuters section's recent articles: canonical URL, update time, lead image URL, and image caption. This feed does not publish titles; use /reuters/news for a title-bearing feed of fresh stories.

### `reuters_sections`

List Reuters sections. Lists the top-level Reuters sections accepted by the 'section' parameter of '/reuters/section', returned under 'items'. Each entry has a 'slug', a display 'name' and the landing-page 'url'. Takes no parameters.

### `reverb_categories`

List Reverb's category/product-type taxonomy. Returns Reverb's full category/product-type taxonomy -- the value space reverb-search's own category/product_type parameters accept. product_types is a fixed, exhaustive 14-value closed set; categories is the full, exhaustive leaf-category value space as of the request (306 values as of 2026-10-15). A leaf category's slug is NOT always globally unique across product types -- always pass a category's own product_type field alongside its slug to reverb-search, not category alone, when disambiguation matters.

### `reverb_listing`

Get a Reverb listing. Returns full listing-detail data for one Reverb listing: description, every photo, shipping/payment/return policies, and the seller's shop reputation -- richer than the flattened summary reverb-search returns per listing. id is the listing's numeric id, from a search result's own listings[].id field.

### `reverb_makes`

List Reverb's manufacturer/make list. Returns Reverb's full manufacturer/make list -- the value space reverb-search's own make parameter accepts (2,795 values as of 2026-10-15). Does not include a model list -- Reverb's own /api/listings silently ignores a model filter value, so reverb-search has no Model parameter and a model list would have no corresponding filter to use it with.

### `reverb_price_guide`

Get a gear model's Reverb Price Guide detail. Returns one gear model's Reverb Price Guide detail: its specific finish/year variants, monthly average sale-price history, and a page of individual recent sales. slug is the model's slug, from reverb-price-guide-search's own models[].slug field. canonical_product_id optionally scopes to one specific variant from this model's own canonical_products[].id field (from a prior call without it); omitting it aggregates price history and recent sales across every variant, a broader, more heavily-sampled view. condition optionally scopes by Reverb's own Price Guide condition scale (listed below) -- a separate, 6-value enum from reverb-search's own listing condition field. range selects how far back the price history/recent-sales window looks. An unknown slug returns a typed not-found error.

### `reverb_price_guide_search`

Search Reverb's Price Guide model catalog. Searches Reverb's Price Guide (reverb.com/price-guide) for gear models by free-text brand/model query (e.g. "fender stratocaster"). Each result's slug is the value reverb-price-guide's own slug parameter accepts. query is full-text relevance search, not an exact match -- unlike reverb-search's own query, a nonsensical query is not guaranteed to return an empty result; the upstream can fall back to loosely related or generically popular models instead, so a low result count should be treated cautiously rather than read as "no real matches.".

### `reverb_search`

Search or browse Reverb musical-instrument listings. Searches or browses Reverb's (reverb.com) marketplace for new and used musical instruments and gear. query, category, product_type, make, min_price, and max_price are all optional and combine as an AND -- a free-text query can be combined with category/product_type/make/price filters in the same request, or every field can be omitted to browse the full active catalog. category accepts a leaf slug from reverb-categories' own categories[].slug field; product_type is a fixed, closed 14-value enum (listed below) that should be passed together with category from the SAME reverb-categories entry, since a category slug alone is not always globally unique (e.g. "cables" exists under both Accessories and Home Audio). An unrecognized category value is silently ignored by the upstream (returns the unfiltered catalog, not zero results or an error) -- a known upstream quirk. make accepts a manufacturer name from reverb-makes' own makes[] field and is a confirmed, real filter. A query with genuinely zero matches returns a well-formed empty result rather than an error.

### `reverb_shop`

Get a Reverb shop's profile and active listings. Returns a Reverb shop's public profile plus a page of its current active listings (Reverb's own "shop" view of a seller). slug is the shop's slug, from a listing's own shop link or reverb.com/shop/{slug}. query is an optional free-text filter scoping the listings sub-page to a keyword within that shop. An unknown slug returns a typed not-found error.

### `reverb_shop_feedback`

Get a Reverb shop's buyer feedback. Returns a page of a Reverb shop's individual buyer feedback entries (rating, message, and the order each review was left for) -- reputation detail reverb-shop does not carry (reverb-shop only exposes the aggregate feedback_count/rating_percentage). slug is the shop's slug, from a listing's own shop link or reverb.com/shop/{slug}. An unknown slug returns a typed not-found error.

### `rightmove_agent_branch`

Get Rightmove estate agent branch details. Returns one estate-agent branch profile from Rightmove, including address, telephones, service flags, industry affiliations, and the branch's own sales and lettings listing previews. The slug segments in Rightmove agent URLs are cosmetic; the branch resolves by numeric id alone.

### `rightmove_agents`

List Rightmove estate agents for a location. Lists estate-agent branches from Rightmove's estate-agents directory for a location, with branch display name, brand, address, telephones, sales/lettings flags, logo, and a link to the branch profile. Pagination follows Rightmove's current directory pages, whose result counts can vary.

### `rightmove_autocomplete`

Get Rightmove location autocomplete suggestions. Returns Rightmove location suggestions for the required 'query' (up to 200 characters). 'limit' defaults to 10 and is capped at 20. Each result has an 'id' such as 'REGION^87490', a 'name', a 'full_name' when Rightmove gives one, and an 'entity_type' such as 'REGION' or 'POSTCODE'. Use the 'id' as 'location' in Rightmove search.

### `rightmove_commercial_search`

Search Rightmove commercial property. Search Rightmove's commercial property listings for sale or to let, with price, floor-area (sq ft), and commercial-property-type filters. For to-let listings the price amount follows the listing's own frequency (monthly or yearly).

### `rightmove_new_homes_search`

Search Rightmove new homes for sale. Search Rightmove's new-homes-for-sale listings for a location, with price, bedroom, bathroom, and property-type filters. Results are individual new-build homes and plots (with development flags), not development-level cards.

### `rightmove_property`

Get Rightmove property details. Returns one Rightmove listing by 'id': title, address, price and 'price_text', bedrooms, bathrooms, receptions, property type, status, description, features, floor plan, EPC rating, council tax band, tenure, agent reviews and nearby schools with Ofsted ratings. Removed or invalid ids return 404.

### `rightmove_search`

Search Rightmove properties. Searches Rightmove listings for a required 'location' id, for sale (default) or 'to_let', 1-indexed by 'page'. Filter by price, bedrooms, bathrooms, 'property_type', 'radius', 'must_have', 'dont_show' and 'tenure_types'; 'sort' defaults to 'newest_listed'. Returns 'total' and results with price, address, beds, baths, size and tenure.

### `rightmove_student_search`

Search Rightmove student accommodation. Search Rightmove's student-accommodation listings for a location, with monthly-rent, bedroom, and furnishing filters. Prices are monthly rents in whole GBP units.

### `rnz_article`

Get RNZ article content. Returns public RNZ news article metadata and body paragraphs from a canonical rnz.co.nz/news/<section>/<id>/<slug> article URL. RNZ has no paywall, so the full body is returned.

### `rnz_author`

Get an RNZ author profile. Returns one RNZ reporter's public profile: name, role, bio, email, X/Twitter handle, photo, total story count, and the first page of their news stories.

### `rnz_headlines`

Get RNZ section headlines. Returns the latest RNZ (Radio New Zealand) stories for one section. 'section' is required and takes one of 19 slugs such as 'news', 'national', 'political', 'business', 'pacific', 'te-manu-korihi' or 'weather'; others return a 400. Each item has its title, URL, summary and publication time. Smaller sections can carry items from earlier weeks, so check 'published_at'.

### `rnz_news`

Get RNZ top stories. Returns RNZ (Radio New Zealand) top stories from its all-news feed: title, article URL, summary and publication time in UTC. Takes no parameters. Lifestyle guides, audio programme pages and section hubs are left out, and article URLs use RNZ's current section names.

### `rnz_sections`

Get RNZ sections. Lists the 19 RNZ news sections that 'rnz-headlines' accepts, such as 'news', 'national', 'political', 'pacific' and 'te-manu-korihi'. Each entry has a 'slug', a display 'name' and the section's feed 'url'. RNZ's programme-schedule and recipe feeds are not included.

### `roblox_badges`

List Roblox experience badges. Returns one cursor-paginated page of public badge metadata for a Roblox experience. Pass next_cursor back unchanged as cursor. No user-awarded badge data is returned.

### `roblox_game`

Get a Roblox experience. Returns public catalog detail for one Roblox experience, including aggregate votes and its public icon. This endpoint does not return player, account, purchase, or server data.

### `roblox_rankings`

List Roblox game rankings. Returns one Roblox game ranking shelf, chosen by 'sort_id': 'top-trending' (default), 'up-and-coming', 'top-playing-now', 'fun-with-friends' or 'top-revisited'. Each experience has its name, creator, genre, player count, up and down votes, maturity label, minimum age and URL. Shelves are global, not personalised.

### `roblox_search`

Search Roblox experiences. Searches Roblox experiences for 'q' (1 to 256 characters). Each result has its universe and place ids, name, creator, genre, 'player_count', up and down votes, maturity and URL. Pass 'next_page' back unchanged as 'page_token' for the next page. No account, friend, purchase or inventory data is included.

### `rollingstone_article`

Get Rolling Stone article content. Returns a Rolling Stone article by canonical 'url', a 'rollingstone.com' address ending in a numeric article id: title, description, section, authors, publication and update times, image, body 'paragraphs' and a 'paywalled' flag.

### `rollingstone_author`

Get a Rolling Stone author profile. Returns a Rolling Stone author's byline metadata, biography, and recent articles (sourced from the author's own public RSS feed) from a canonical author URL.

### `rollingstone_headlines`

Get Rolling Stone section headlines. Returns the latest Rolling Stone stories for one section.
