Hashtag suggestions for a keyword (hashtag typeahead). Returns the hashtag suggestions the app shows while typing in the search box, keyed by 'keyword'. The upstream is '/aweme/v1/search/challengesug/'; each 'sug_list' row carries 'cha_name' (hashtag name), 'view_count', 'use_count' and 'cid' (the numeric hashtag id), so this is the discovery step for the hashtag endpoints ('hashtag info' is name-keyed). Measured 2026-10-21 with the pure-Go (device-free) signer: 'keyword=lofi' returned 10 rows ('lofi' 18.2B views / 1.9M uses, then 'lofiasmr', 'lofihiphop', ...), 'coffee' and 'ラーメン' also returned 10 rows, and a keyword with no suggestions is a valid empty page ('sug_list: []'). 'count' is accepted for shape parity but the server was measured to ignore it (5/20/100 all returned 10 rows), and the route has no paging. The route is not signature-gated, so it does not need the device-backed signer.

### `tiktok_mobile_search_music`

Search TikTok sounds on the mobile API. Keyword search over sounds, returning 'music_info_list' of full sound objects unmodified with 'cursor', 'has_more' and 'total'.

### `tiktok_mobile_search_place`

Search TikTok places. Returns TikTok's place (POI) search results for a keyword, unmodified: each row carries 'poi_name', 'poi_id', 'poi_type', 'video_count', 'poi_rating', 'poi_distance', 'poi_location', 'lat'/'lng', 'img_url', 'opening_time', 'price_level' and 'parent_poi'. Useful for mapping a location or category to the places TikTok knows about, and for seeing how many videos each place carries. 'keyword' is required. The page holds up to 30 rows ('count' 1-30 measured; a larger count makes the upstream answer an empty page, so the service rejects it) and the route is first-page-only — the returned 'cursor' is not a reusable page token.

### `tiktok_mobile_search_pre_info`

Pre-search info token for a search session. Returns the 'pre_info_id' token the app attaches to a search session (with its TTL). The token is short-lived; the app requests one before the search stream and reuses it for the following calls.

### `tiktok_mobile_search_suggestions`

Retrieve TikTok search suggestions. Returns the mobile app's search typeahead for a seed keyword: 'sug_list' of suggestions, each with 'content', 'sug_type', 'word_record' ('group_id', 'words_position', 'words_content', 'words_source') and positional fields, unmodified. Useful for query expansion and for seeing the phrases the app itself associates with a seed term. 'keyword' is required; without it the upstream answers a well-formed but empty envelope.

### `tiktok_mobile_search_tabs`

Search tabs available for a keyword. Returns the tab keys the mobile search screen offers for a keyword ('general', 'video', 'photos', 'user', 'music', 'live', 'place', 'hashtag'), plus the gateway's 'is_failed' flag. Measured on the mobile search edge with a form POST.

### `tiktok_mobile_search_user`

Search TikTok users on the mobile API. Keyword search over users, returning 'user_list' unmodified. Each 'user_info' carries the populated creator statistics (follower_count, following_count, total_favorited, aweme_count, custom_verify). Requires the device-backed signing service; without it the endpoint returns a generic service-unavailable error instead of an empty page.

### `tiktok_mobile_trending_categories`

Retrieve TikTok trending categories. Returns the discover-category feed unmodified: each 'category_list' entry is '{aweme_list, category_type, challenge_info, click_track_url_list, desc, track_url_list}', with 'cursor' and 'has_more' for paging.

### `tiktok_mobile_trending_effects`

Retrieve TikTok trending effects. Returns the effect/sticker discovery feed unmodified: 'aweme_list' of full video objects, each additionally carrying 'stickers' and 'sticker_detail', plus 'feed_session_id', 'cursor' and 'has_more'.

### `tiktok_mobile_user_recommendations`

Recommended creators on the mobile app's Following page. Returns the app's suggested creators for the Following page unmodified: 'user_list' entries are '{user, aweme_list}' where 'user' is the full creator projection (uid, sec_uid, nickname, signature, avatars, follower/following counts, verification and privacy flags) and 'aweme_list' holds up to three recent videos, so this is a creator-discovery surface rather than a bare id list. The route has no paging fields and returns one page of 13-17 creators (fresh recommendations differ per call). 'count' is accepted for parity but the gateway was measured to ignore it. The route is not signature-value gated, so unlike the profile/posts routes it does not need the device-backed signer.

### `tiktok_mobile_video_subtitles`

Video captions translated into a target language. Returns one video's own captions translated into the requested language, as TikTok's caption/language ('cla') service serves them. The response carries the track twice: 'webvtt' is the upstream WebVTT text verbatim, and 'cues' is the same track parsed into '{start_ms, end_ms, start, end, text}' records so a caller does not have to implement WebVTT. 'video_id' is the aweme id returned by the feed, search, profile-posts and hashtag endpoints. Measured 2026-10-21 with the pure-Go (device-free) signer: the Korean-caption video 7696141388324293918 answered 11 English cues for 'language=en', and the same video answered Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Arabic, Hindi, Indonesian, Thai, Vietnamese, Turkish and Italian tracks; a Portuguese-lyrics video answered an 18,494-character English track (240 cues). Track size is a snapshot rather than a contract (the upstream re-translates from a cache), so assert a non-empty track in the requested language, not a byte count. The route is not signature-gated, so it does not need the device-backed signer. A video with no captions answers 400 (upstream status 5); a nonexistent video answers 500 (upstream status 4).

### `tiktok_popular_trend_country_industry_meta`

Retrieve TikTok popular-trend country and industry metadata. Lists the country and industry filter values used by the TikTok Creative Center popular-trend endpoints. Countries have an 'id' such as 'AR' and a name; industries have a numeric 'id' and a name such as Apparel & Accessories. A maintained fallback list is returned if TikTok's own metadata is unavailable.

### `tiktok_post`

Retrieve TikTok video details. Returns TikTok's detail record for one video by video id. 'itemInfo.itemStruct' holds the video's description, the author's profile and the author's statistics (such as followers, following and hearts) along with the rest of TikTok's video object; 'shareMeta' holds the share title and description.

### `tiktok_posts`

Retrieve posts from a TikTok profile. Lists posts from a TikTok profile identified by 'secUid'. 'sort_type' is '0' latest (default), '1' popular or '2' oldest. 'cursor' defaults to 0. The response has 'itemList', 'hasMore' and a 'cursor' to pass back to fetch the next page.

### `tiktok_profile`

Retrieve a TikTok profile. Returns a public TikTok profile by 'handler', the username without the leading '@'. The 'user' object has the id, 'uniqueId', nickname, signature, verified and private flags, region, language, avatar, bio link and 'secUid'; 'stats' has follower, following, heart, video and friend counts. A missing, deleted or banned handle returns 404.

### `tiktok_search`

Search TikTok videos. Searches TikTok videos for 'keyword'. 'cursor' defaults to 0 and 'count' defaults to 20, capped at 50. The response has the matching video items, a 'cursor' and 'has_more' for paging. An empty, blocked or malformed result from TikTok returns an upstream error.

### `tiktok_search_hashtag`

Search TikTok hashtags. Searches TikTok hashtags (challenges) for 'keyword'. 'cursor' defaults to 0 and 'count' defaults to 20, capped at 50. The response has 'challenge_list' with each hashtag's name and id, plus a 'cursor' and 'has_more' for paging. An empty, blocked or malformed result returns an upstream error.

### `tiktok_search_user`

Search TikTok users. Searches TikTok users for 'keyword', with 'cursor' (default 0) for paging. The response has 'user_list' with the matching accounts, plus a 'cursor' and 'has_more' to continue. Pass the returned 'cursor' back to fetch the next page.

### `tiktok_top_ads_analysis`

Retrieve TikTok Top Ads interactive time analysis. Returns the detail-page interactive time analysis chart and percentile for a Top Ads material. Metric values are 'retain_ctr' (CTR), 'retain_cvr' (CVR), 'click_cnt' (Clicks), 'convert_cnt' (Conversion), and 'play_retain_cnt' (Remain).

### `tiktok_top_ads_detail`

Retrieve TikTok Top Ads detail. Returns detail for one TikTok Creative Center Top Ads material. Use 'material_id'; the upstream does not accept 'id' or 'materialId'.

### `tiktok_top_ads_filters`

Retrieve TikTok Top Ads filters. Returns filter metadata for TikTok Creative Center Top Ads. Dynamic values come from TikTok; static UI enums are included for 'order_by', 'duration', 'like', and 'ad_format'.

### `tiktok_top_ads_list`

Retrieve TikTok Top Ads. Returns high-performing auction ads from TikTok Creative Center. The service defaults 'period' to 30, 'page' to 1, 'limit' to 20, and 'order_by' to 'for_you'. Use '/tiktok/top-ads/filters' for dynamic enum values and static enums for order, duration, likes, and ad format.

### `tiktok_top_ads_location_info`

Retrieve TikTok Top Ads location info. Returns TikTok's inferred initial country and industry targeting context for Top Ads. Use it when you need starting targeting values; use the locations, filters, and list endpoints to choose criteria and retrieve ads.

### `tiktok_top_ads_locations`

Retrieve TikTok Top Ads locations. Lists the country filters offered by TikTok Creative Center Top Ads. Each country has an 'id' such as 'US', a 'value' (the country name), a 'label' and a 'has_conversion' flag. Takes no parameters.

### `tiktok_top_ads_recommend`

Retrieve TikTok Top Ads recommendations. Lists Top Ads materials that TikTok Creative Center recommends as related to the ad with 'material_id'. 'page' starts at 1; 'limit' defaults to 20 and is capped at 100. Each ad has its title, brand, likes, comments, shares, CTR, objectives and video info. The list can be empty for a valid id.

### `tiktok_top_ads_safety`

Retrieve TikTok Top Ads safety configuration. Returns the Creative Center safety configuration flags for search: 'top_ads_search', 'keyword_search', 'hashtag_search', 'creator_search', 'sound_search' and 'cc_banner_key'. It carries feature flags only, not ad materials. Takes no parameters.

### `tiktok_top_ads_spotlight`

Retrieve TikTok Top Ads Spotlight. Lists the Top Ads Spotlight materials that TikTok Creative Center hand-picks. 'page' starts at 1; 'limit' defaults to 20 and is capped at 100. Each ad has its title, brand, likes, comments, shares, CTR, objectives and video info. 'data.pagination' gives the page, size, total and 'has_more'.

### `tiktok_top_ads_suggestions`

Retrieve TikTok Top Ads suggestions. Returns Top Ads search suggestions from TikTok Creative Center. 'count' is the maximum number of suggestions (default 50) and 'scenario' picks the suggestion scenario id (default 1). The 'query' list can be empty for the default scenario.

### `tiktok_trending`

Retrieve TikTok trending posts. Returns the current TikTok trending feed: 'itemList' holds the videos, and 'hasMore' and 'cursor' describe paging. The response also has a 'trendingTopics' field. Takes no parameters.

### `time_article`

Get TIME article content. Returns one TIME article by 'url', which must be a canonical HTTPS dated 'time.com' article link. The response has the title, description, section, authors, publication and update times, lead image URL, body 'paragraphs' and a 'paywalled' flag.

### `time_author`

Get a TIME author profile. Returns a TIME author's profile by 'url', a canonical 'time.com/author/<slug>/' link: name, job title, bio, image URL, social account links and recent articles with title, URL, excerpt, section, section URL and ISO-8601 'published_at'. Not every author lists a social account.

### `time_headlines`

Get TIME section headlines. Returns the current headlines for one TIME section. 'section' is required and takes one of 'news', 'politics', 'world', 'business', 'technology', 'health', 'entertainment', 'sports', 'ideas' or 'climate'. Each item has its title and URL.

### `time_news`

Get TIME top stories. Returns the current top stories from TIME. It takes no parameters. Each item has its title, URL and, where available, a summary, author, publication time, image URL and 'type'. Use the headlines endpoint to read one section.

### `time_sections`

Get TIME RSS sections. Lists the 10 TIME section slugs that the headlines endpoint accepts: 'news', 'politics', 'world', 'business', 'technology', 'health', 'entertainment', 'sports', 'ideas' and 'climate'. Each entry has a 'slug', a display 'name' and a 'url'.

### `timeslive_article`

Get TimesLIVE article content. Returns article metadata and body paragraphs for a canonical TimesLIVE editorial article URL. Some stories may have a publisher access gate; paywalled is set when the page's first-party access flags indicate restricted content.

### `timeslive_headlines`

Get TimesLIVE section headlines. Returns current TimesLIVE stories for a section. Pass a slug from timeslive_sections; results are the first 15 items in the live section order.

### `timeslive_news`

Get TimesLIVE top stories. Returns current TimesLIVE stories, including section-specific headlines. Article access can vary by story.

### `timeslive_sections`

Get TimesLIVE sections. Returns the complete public editorial navigation set accepted by the TimesLIVE headlines endpoint. External Sunday Times, partner, podcast, account, and link-only surfaces are excluded.

### `timesofindia_article`

Get The Times of India article content. Returns public Times of India article metadata (title, author(s), published/updated dates, section, lead image) and body paragraphs from a canonical article URL. A story gated behind a subscription returns a permission error instead of a truncated or fabricated body.

### `timesofindia_author`

Get a Times of India author profile. Returns a Times of India reporter's profile by 'url', a canonical 'timesofindia.indiatimes.com/toireporter/author-<name>-<id>.cms' link: name, job title, organization, location, email, biography, headshot and recent articles with title and URL. Fields the profile page does not publish may be empty.

### `timesofindia_headlines`

Get The Times of India section headlines. Returns the current headlines for one Times of India section or city edition. 'section' is required, for example 'top-stories', 'india', 'world', 'business', 'cricket', 'mumbai', 'delhi' or 'bangalore'. Items carry the title and URL, plus summary, author, publication time and image when the outlet provides them.

### `timesofindia_news`

Get The Times of India top stories. Returns the current Times of India top stories. It takes no parameters. Each item has its title, URL, summary, publication time with its UTC offset, author and image URL. Use the headlines endpoint for a section or city edition.

### `timesofindia_sections`

Get The Times of India sections. Lists the 55 Times of India sections that the headlines endpoint accepts, covering national and international topics such as 'india', 'world', 'business' and 'cricket', and India city editions such as 'mumbai', 'delhi' and 'bangalore'. Each entry has a 'slug', a display 'name' and the section feed 'url'.

### `timesofisrael_article`

Get Times of Israel article content. Returns public Times of Israel article metadata and body paragraphs from a canonical article URL. Both regular story pages and individual liveblog-update pages (/liveblog_entry/<slug>/) are accepted.

### `timesofisrael_author`

Get a Times of Israel author profile. Returns a Times of Israel writer's byline metadata, biography, social links, and recent articles from a canonical writer profile URL.

### `timesofisrael_headlines`

Get Times of Israel section headlines. Returns the current headlines for one Times of Israel section. 'section' is required and takes one of 'israel-and-the-region', 'israel-inside', 'jewish-times', 'real-estate-israel' or 'tech-israel'. Each item has its title and URL.

### `timesofisrael_news`

Get Times of Israel top stories. Returns the latest Times of Israel stories. It takes no parameters. Each item has a title, URL and publication time. The list includes both regular story pages and individual liveblog-update pages, so expect some entries to be short updates.

### `timesofisrael_sections`

Get Times of Israel sections. Lists the five Times of Israel sections that the headlines endpoint accepts: 'israel-and-the-region', 'israel-inside', 'jewish-times', 'real-estate-israel' and 'tech-israel'. Each entry has a 'slug', a display 'name' and a section 'url'.

### `tmdb_collection`

Get a TMDB collection. Returns a TMDB collection (a movie franchise grouping) by 'id', which can be the collection id or an id-slug. The response has the collection title, overview, 'uri' and 'source_url', plus its member movies, each with id, title, overview, poster URL, release date and 'uri'.

### `tmdb_genres`

List TMDB browse genres. Returns every genre ID for TMDB movie and TV browse pages. Use movie values only with movie list filters and TV values only with TV list filters.

### `tmdb_movie`

Get a TMDB movie. Returns a TMDB movie: overview, tagline, genres, countries, runtime, budget/revenue, top-billed cast, top crew (director/writer), and aggregate rating.

### `tmdb_movie_list`

Get a TMDB movie chart. Returns a page of TMDB movies from the 'category' chart ('popular' by default, or 'top_rated', 'now_playing', 'upcoming'), optionally refined by 'sort_by', 'with_genres', 'original_language', release dates, rating, votes and runtime. 'limit' defaults to 10 (max 20). Each movie has id, title, overview, poster, release date and 'uri'; 'has_next_page' signals more pages.

### `tmdb_person`

Get a TMDB person. Returns a TMDB person by 'id': name, biography, birth date, photo URL and a filmography of movie and TV credits, most prominent first. 'limit' caps the credits (default 10, max 20). Each credit has its 'type' ('movie' or 'tv'), id, title and 'uri'. The biography may include a Wikipedia CC-BY-SA attribution note.

### `tmdb_person_list`

List popular people on TMDB. Returns one page from TMDB's Popular People directory, including each person's id, name, known-for titles, profile image, and detail URL.

### `tmdb_search`

Search TMDB. Searches TMDB movies, TV shows, people, and collections. An unscoped query interleaves results across all four types rather than returning whichever type happens to rank first.

### `tmdb_tv`

Get a TMDB TV show. Returns a TMDB TV show: overview, tagline, genres, countries, episode count, first/last air year, top-billed cast, top crew (creator), and aggregate rating.

### `tmdb_tv_list`

Get a TMDB TV chart. Returns a page of TMDB TV shows from the 'category' chart ('popular' by default, or 'top_rated', 'airing_today', 'on_the_air'), optionally refined by 'sort_by', 'with_genres', 'original_language', first-air-date bounds 'date_from' and 'date_to', rating, votes and runtime. 'limit' defaults to 10 (max 20). A filtered page with no matches returns an empty 'shows' array.

### `tmz_article`

Get TMZ article content. Returns one TMZ article by 'url', a canonical HTTPS 'tmz.com' link of the form '/<year>/<month>/<day>/<slug>/'. The response has the title, description, section, authors, publication and update times, image URL, body 'paragraphs' and a 'paywalled' flag.

### `tmz_author`

Get a TMZ person profile. Returns a named person's TMZ profile hub: their name and their most recent TMZ coverage, from a canonical person-hub URL or slug. TMZ credits virtually all of its editorial content to a single "TMZ Staff" byline with no individual journalist profile pages, so this endpoint surfaces TMZ's own public per-person coverage hub (used for both celebrities and other newsmakers TMZ covers) as the closest available "profile + recent articles" surface.

### `tmz_headlines`

Get TMZ section headlines. Returns the current headlines for one TMZ section. 'section' is required and must be 'news' or 'sports'. Each item has its title, URL and, where available, a summary, author, publication time, image and 'type', and the response echoes the 'section'.

### `tmz_news`

Get TMZ top stories. Returns the current TMZ celebrity news top stories. It takes no parameters. Each item has its title, URL and, where available, an author such as TMZ Staff, a summary, publication time and image URL. Use the headlines endpoint with 'sports' for sports stories.

### `tmz_sections`

Get TMZ sections. Returns the TMZ section inventory accepted by tmz-headlines: News (the home feed) and Sports. TMZ's public site has no broader stable editorial-category taxonomy beyond its own small main navigation -- see tmz-headlines for details.

### `tokopedia_autocomplete`

Autocomplete Tokopedia product searches. Returns current public Tokopedia search suggestions for a partial keyword. Suggestions include canonical product-search URLs and are not product-search results.

### `tokopedia_category`

Browse a Tokopedia category. Returns public product cards from a canonical Tokopedia category path. 'path' must begin with '/p/'; use the category page path, not a product or search URL.

### `tokopedia_home`

Get Tokopedia home recommendations. Returns public product-card recommendations for a current Tokopedia home tab. Omit 'tab_id' for the first available tab; discover other tabs through '/tokopedia/home/tabs'.

### `tokopedia_home_tabs`

List Tokopedia home recommendation tabs. Lists the current Tokopedia home recommendation tabs, each with its 'id', 'name' and an optional image URL, plus a 'fetched_at' timestamp. It takes no parameters. Pass a returned 'id' as 'tab_id' to '/tokopedia/home' to load that tab.

### `tokopedia_product`

Get a Tokopedia product's public detail. Returns public product detail from a canonical Tokopedia shop domain and product key. This endpoint does not accept arbitrary URLs; numeric product IDs are returned when the product page exposes them but cannot be used as lookup input.

### `tokopedia_product_review_filters`

Get Tokopedia product review-filter metadata. Returns which public review media, rating, and topic filters are available for a numeric product ID. It does not return review text, review media, or a review archive.

### `tokopedia_search`

Search Tokopedia products. Returns public Tokopedia product cards for a keyword from Tokopedia's public product-search operation. 'sort' accepts '3' (lowest price), '4' (highest price), '5' (most reviewed), '9' (newest), or '23' (most relevant). Repeat 'filter' as 'key:value' using values from '/tokopedia/search/filters'.

### `tokopedia_search_filters`

Get Tokopedia search filters and sorts. Returns the live filter tree and supported sort choices for a Tokopedia product search. The response includes categories when the current query exposes them, store type, delivery location, price, rating, offer, condition, recency, shipping, and stock options as applicable.

### `tomsguide_article`

Get Tom's Guide article content. Returns one Tom's Guide article by 'url', a canonical HTTPS 'tomsguide.com' link such as 'tomsguide.com/<section>/<slug>'. The response has the title, description, section, authors, publication and update times, image URL, body 'paragraphs' and a 'paywalled' flag. On some product reviews 'authors' may be empty.

### `tomsguide_author`

Get a Tom's Guide author profile. Returns a Tom's Guide author's name, job title, biography, social links and one page of recent articles. Give exactly one of 'slug' or 'url'; 'page' is 1-based, defaults to 1 and overrides any page in 'url'. The response also has 'page' and 'has_next_page'.

### `tomsguide_headlines`

Get Tom's Guide section headlines. Returns the current headlines for one Tom's Guide section. 'section' is required and takes one of 22 slugs, such as 'ai', 'audio', 'deals', 'how-to', 'news', 'reviews', 'tvs' or 'phones'. Each item has its title, URL, summary, author, publication time and image.

### `tomsguide_news`

Get Tom's Guide top stories. Returns the current top stories from Tom's Guide. It takes no parameters. Each item has its title, URL and, where available, a summary, author, publication time, image URL and 'type'. Use the headlines endpoint to read one section.

### `tomsguide_sections`

Get Tom's Guide sections. Lists the 22 top-level Tom's Guide content verticals that the headlines endpoint accepts, such as 'ai', 'best-picks', 'how-to', 'mattresses', 'reviews', 'vehicle-tech' and 'phones'. Each entry has a 'slug', a display 'name' and a 'url'.

### `tomshardware_article`

Get Tom's Hardware article content. Returns one Tom's Hardware article by its canonical 'url', either the current 'tomshardware.com/<section>/<subsection>/<slug>' form or the legacy '/reviews/<slug>,<id>.html' form. The response has the title, description, authors, section, published and updated times, lead image, the body 'paragraphs' and a 'paywalled' flag.

### `tomshardware_author`

Get a Tom's Hardware author profile. Returns a Tom's Hardware author profile with name, job title, biography, social links and one page of recent articles. Identify the author with 'slug' (such as 'christian-eberle') or an author 'url'; 'page' (default 1) overrides any page in the URL. 'has_next_page' tells you whether more articles exist.

### `tomshardware_headlines`

Get Tom's Hardware section headlines. Lists the current headlines for one Tom's Hardware section. 'section' is required and takes a slug such as 'gpus', 'cpus', 'laptops', 'deals', 'reviews' or 'news'; use 'tomshardware-sections' for the full set. Each item has its title, URL, author, publication time and lead image, plus a summary when the section's listing provides one.

### `tomshardware_news`

Get Tom's Hardware top stories. Returns the latest Tom's Hardware top stories with no parameters. Each item has its title, URL, summary, author, publication time and lead image. Use the item URLs with 'tomshardware-article' to read the body.

### `tomshardware_sections`

Get Tom's Hardware sections. Lists the 20 Tom's Hardware top-level sections that 'tomshardware-headlines' accepts, including '3d-printing', 'cpus', 'gpus', 'monitors', 'news' and 'reviews'. Each section carries its 'slug', display 'name' and page 'url'. Takes no parameters.

### `torontostar_article`

Get Toronto Star article content. Returns public Toronto Star article metadata and the body paragraphs shown to an anonymous reader from a canonical article URL. The Star meters its articles, so paywalled is true and paragraphs holds only the public teaser (typically the first two paragraphs) whenever the page hides the rest from non-subscribers.

### `torontostar_author`

Get a Toronto Star author profile. Returns one Toronto Star author's public profile: name, job title, biography, location and topic focus, avatar, and their recent articles.

### `torontostar_headlines`

Get Toronto Star section headlines. Returns fresh Toronto Star headlines from one public section page, with summary, publish time and image when the page shows them.

### `torontostar_news`

Get Toronto Star top stories. Returns the newest Toronto Star editorial stories (up to 50, newest first) from the public news sitemap. Press-release and sponsored pages are excluded.

### `torontostar_sections`

Get Toronto Star sections. Lists the 69 Toronto Star sections accepted by the headlines endpoint, taken from thestar.com's main navigation. Each has a 'slug', a display 'name' and a 'url'. Nested sections use slash paths such as 'news/gta', 'sports/hockey/pwhl' and 'business/technology'. Takes no parameters.

### `townhall_article`

Get Townhall article content. Returns public Townhall article metadata and body paragraphs from a canonical news or column URL. VIP stories are flagged with paywalled and return only the free lead paragraphs.

### `townhall_author`

Get a Townhall author profile. Returns a Townhall author profile by 'slug' (such as 'amy-curtis') or by an author 'url'; exactly one is required. The response has the name, photo, bio, X profile link and the first page of the author's archive, about 50 stories, each with its section label and a 'vip' flag. Unknown authors return a not-found error.

### `townhall_headlines`

Get Townhall section headlines. Lists headlines for one Townhall section. 'section' is required: 'news' and 'columnists' return the 20 most recent stories, while the topic sections (such as 'congress', 'economy' or 'iran') return up to 30 stories mixing news and columns. Items carry title, URL, image and, when available, author, time and summary.

### `townhall_news`

Get Townhall top stories. Returns the latest Townhall stories, news and opinion columns mixed, newest first, about 50 items. Each has its title, URL, short summary, publication time, author byline and lead image. Video pages are left out. Takes no parameters.

### `townhall_sections`

Get Townhall sections. Returns the public Townhall section inventory: the site-wide news and column feeds plus the editorial topic hubs the site promotes.

### `tripadvisor_autocomplete`

Autocomplete TripAdvisor locations and places. Returns TripAdvisor typeahead suggestions for the required query 'q', optionally narrowed by 'limit', 'locale', 'scope_geo_id' and a 'type' hint. Each result has its id, title, type, URL, image, parent location and coordinates, and may carry nested search shortcuts. Results can be locations, hotels, restaurants or attractions.

### `tripadvisor_enums`

Get TripAdvisor enum metadata. Returns the values TripAdvisor place and listing filters accept: 'locales', 'currencies', 'languages', 'listing_types', 'sorts', 'pricing_modes', 'hotel_classes', 'hotel_amenities', 'restaurant_types', 'restaurant_options', attraction categories with their ids, and 'filter_ids'. It also lists 'unsupported_entity_types'. Takes no parameters.

### `tripadvisor_hotels`

Search TripAdvisor hotels. Searches TripAdvisor hotels in the area given by the required 'geo_id'. Filter with 'class', 'amenities', 'price_min', 'price_max', 'pricing_mode', 'travelers_choice' and 'currency'; page with 'offset' and 'limit'; order with 'sort'. Each hotel has its title, URL, image, rating, review count, star rating, rank, price, provider, location and a review snippet when TripAdvisor supplies them.

### `tripadvisor_place`

Get TripAdvisor place. Returns a rich TripAdvisor place profile.

### `tripadvisor_reviews`

Get TripAdvisor reviews. Returns reviews for a TripAdvisor place identified by 'id' (location id) or 'url'. 'limit' defaults to 20 (max 50); 'page' is 1-based; 'language', 'ratings' (1 to 5) and 'sort_by' refine the list. Each review has author, title, text, dates, rating, language, helpful votes, photos and URL. A page beyond 'total' returns an empty 'reviews' array.

### `tripadvisor_search`

Search TripAdvisor places. Searches TripAdvisor places in the area given by the required 'geo_id', for the required 'type': 'hotel', 'restaurant', 'attraction', 'all', or an attraction category type from '/tripadvisor/enums'. Hotel and restaurant filters, 'offset', 'limit', 'locale', 'currency' and 'sort' are optional. Each result has title, URL, rating, review count, rank, price and location. Unsupported entity-only types return a validation error.

### `tripcom_hotel_detail`

Get Trip.com hotel detail. Returns a Trip.com hotel-detail page: identity (name, local name, star rating, city/province/country), location (address, zone, latitude/longitude, nearby-transport description), guest rating (overall score plus cleanliness/amenities/location/service breakdown), images, description, check-in/check-out and child policy summaries, and popular facilities. Pricing is not included: Trip.com's detail page only returns per-night rates alongside check-in/check-out dates, which this endpoint does not take as input -- use the search endpoint for a city's current display prices.

### `tripcom_hotels_search`

Search Trip.com hotels by city. Returns Trip.com's own top-hotels page for a city: hotel summaries (name, location, star rating, guest rating, review count, image, display price) for the hotels Trip.com features on that city's hotel-list page. Trip.com does not expose a free-text city search, so callers supply the exact city_slug and city_id pair from a known Trip.com hotel-list URL of the form https://www.trip.com/hotels/{city_slug}-hotels-list-{city_id}/.

### `trustmrr_acquire`

Get TrustMRR acquisition listings. Returns the for-sale startups rendered on the public TrustMRR /acquire marketplace page, with deal metrics (asking price, revenue, multiple, growth). Verified revenue figures come from supported payment providers.

### `trustmrr_categories`

Get TrustMRR categories. Lists the TrustMRR startup categories, with the total 'count'. Each category has its 'slug', 'label', short label, icon name, description, keywords and TrustMRR URL. Pass a category 'slug' to '/trustmrr/category/{slug}' to list the startups in it.

### `trustmrr_category`

Get TrustMRR category detail. Returns one TrustMRR category by 'slug' (lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, for example 'saas') with the startups listed in it. Each startup has its name, slug, URL, description, current MRR, total revenue and last-30-days revenue, all in USD, plus the 'on_sale' flag for startups listed for sale. Valid slugs come from '/trustmrr/categories'.

### `trustmrr_leaderboard`

Get TrustMRR revenue leaderboard. Returns the top 100 startups ranked by the selected metric from the public TrustMRR leaderboard. Revenue and MRR figures are verified through supported payment providers.

### `trustmrr_marketplace`

Get TrustMRR marketplace snapshot. Returns the public TrustMRR marketplace snapshot: the 25 most recently listed startups for sale and the current 25 best deals ranked by TrustMRR's recency-aware deal score. Revenue figures are verified through supported payment providers.

### `trustmrr_startup`

Get TrustMRR startup detail. Returns the full verified profile for a single TrustMRR startup by slug: revenue and MRR, growth, asking price and marketplace status, tech stack, marketing channels, and TrustMRR's AI-generated business summary.

### `trustmrr_startups`

List all TrustMRR startups. Returns a paginated list of every startup in the TrustMRR directory. Each entry is a slug you can pass to /trustmrr/startup/{slug} for the full verified profile — together these two endpoints let you enumerate the entire directory.

### `trustpilot_business`

Get Trustpilot business profile. Returns a Trustpilot business profile by 'slug', such as 'openai.com'. The profile has the name, 'trust_score', 'review_count', rating histogram, review summary and topics, categories, claimed status, website URL, reply metrics, company activity and verification flags, and an about section with description and contact details.

### `trustpilot_business_related`

Get Trustpilot related businesses. Returns the businesses Trustpilot shows as related to a given business slug such as 'openai.com'. Each related business has its display name, identifying name, logo, star rating, TrustScore, review count and Trustpilot URL; the response also includes a summary of the business you asked about.

### `trustpilot_business_reviews`

Get Trustpilot business reviews. Returns one page of Trustpilot reviews for a business slug such as 'openai.com', with filters for star rating, verified reviews, reviews with a company reply, language and text search. Each review has its rating, title, body, author name, country and review count, dates, and any company reply; the response also carries the business summary and pagination totals.

### `trustpilot_business_search`

Search Trustpilot business units. Searches Trustpilot for businesses matching a query, for a country (default 'US'), with 'page' and 'page_size' (default 20, max 100). Each result has the display name, identifying name, TrustScore, star rating, review count, categories, website, email, phone, address and Trustpilot URL; 'total_hits' gives the full match count.

### `trustpilot_categories`

Get Trustpilot categories. Lists the Trustpilot category index grouped by top-level category. Each group has its name, slug and URL, and an 'items' list of subcategories with their own name, slug and URL. It takes no parameters.

### `trustpilot_category`

Get Trustpilot category detail. Returns a Trustpilot category by 'slug' (for example 'software_company'), with the companies listed on one page; 'page' is 1-based and defaults to 1. Each company has its display name, 'identifying_name', 'trust_score', 'stars', 'review_count', location, contact details, categories and Trustpilot URL. Also returns breadcrumbs, newest companies and 'pagination.has_next_page'.

### `trustpilot_category_search`

Search Trustpilot categories. Searches Trustpilot categories for the required 'q'. 'size' sets the maximum number of categories (default 20, from 1 to 100), 'country' is a two-letter code (default US) and 'locale' uses 'll-CC' format (default 'en-US'). Each category has its 'category_id', 'display_name' and 'top_level_category_id'.

### `twitch_channel`

Get a Twitch channel's profile and live status. Returns a Twitch channel's profile (partner status, team, last broadcast title) plus its current live status (started time and game/category, when live).

### `twitch_clips`

Get a Twitch channel's clips. Returns a Twitch channel's clips (last 7 days), most-viewed first: title, view count, duration, curator, and the game it was recorded under.

### `twitch_schedule`

Get a Twitch channel's broadcast schedule. Returns a Twitch channel's upcoming broadcast schedule -- planned segments with title, start/end time, and game/category -- starting today. A channel with no schedule configured returns an empty segments list, not an error.

### `twitch_search`

Search Twitch channels and games/categories. Returns mixed category and channel matches for a query -- live channels include current viewer count and stream title. Sourced from Twitch's own search-typeahead surface (a capped suggestion list, not a fully paginated results page).

### `twitch_streams`

Get the top live streams for a Twitch game/category. Returns the top currently-live streams for a Twitch game/category, ranked by viewer count: title, viewer count, broadcaster, and tags.

### `twitch_team`

Get a Twitch team's roster. Returns a Twitch team's full member roster, with live status and viewer count for whoever is currently live, plus team-level metadata (banner, logo, description, owner).

### `twitch_top_games`

Get Twitch's top games/categories. Returns the top games/categories site-wide, ranked by total current viewers across all live streams under each one.

### `twitch_videos`

Get a Twitch channel's videos (VODs). Returns a Twitch channel's past-broadcast videos (VODs), ranked by view count: title, view count, length, publish date, and the game it was recorded under.

### `twitch_vod_comments`

Get a Twitch VOD's chat replay. Returns one page of a Twitch VOD's chat replay (past-broadcast chat messages), starting at a given point in the video's timeline. Paginate forward by re-requesting with the last returned comment's offset_seconds.

### `ubereats_feed`

Browse UberEats location feed. Returns restaurants delivering to a specific location: name, rating, review count, delivery estimate, cuisine tags, and cover image.

### `ubereats_search`

Search UberEats restaurants. Returns restaurants delivering to a location: name, rating, review count, delivery estimate, cuisine tags, and image. Pass a keyword to search by name/cuisine/dish, or omit it to browse the general feed for that location.

### `ubereats_store`

Get an UberEats store. Returns an UberEats store: address, phone, rating, cuisine tags, hours tagline, and the full menu (sections with items, descriptions, and prices).

### `ubereats_store_menu`

Get an UberEats store menu. Returns the full menu for an UberEats store: section titles, items, item descriptions, prices, and availability status.

### `ubereats_store_reviews`

Get UberEats store reviews. Returns the reviews snapshot embedded in an UberEats store page: aggregate rating, review count, and a sample of recent reviews (reviewer name, text, and relative/absolute date). This is a single on-page snapshot, not a full paginated feed. A store with no written reviews returns an empty reviews list.

### `ulta_categories`

List Ulta Beauty storefront categories. Lists Ulta Beauty's own storefront category navigation: department, group, name, and a URL usable directly as GET /ulta/category's own category parameter. Closes the discovery gap of not already knowing a category path. department, if set, filters to just that department's entries. group is empty for a department's own top-level link or a group's own heading link, and set to that group's name for the leaf categories nested under it. The exact same real category can legitimately appear more than once under a different department/group when the site's own navigation cross-lists it.

### `ulta_category`

Browse an Ulta Beauty category page. Browses an Ulta Beauty category page's product grid, with real page-based pagination and the category's own guided-navigation refinement options. category accepts a category path or full URL copied from Ulta's own site navigation (e.g. shop/makeup/eyes/mascara). filter narrows results using Ulta's own guided-navigation facet-code shape (e.g. BENEFIT--WATERPROOF, or a comma-joined combination of codes) -- discover valid codes for a category from that category's own response facets field, whose value is ready to use directly as this parameter. An unrecognized category returns 404.

### `ulta_product`

Get an Ulta Beauty product's full detail. Returns one Ulta Beauty product's full detail: name, brand, description, category, pricing, rating, review count, images, and every purchasable color/shade variant. productId is taken from a search result's product_id field or a product page's URL (e.g. pimprod2020260). sku is optional and selects a specific color/shade variant; an omitted or invalid sku still resolves the base product using its own default variant. An unrecognized productId returns 404.

### `ulta_product_questions`

Get an Ulta Beauty product's customer questions and answers. Returns one page of an Ulta Beauty product's customer questions, each with every answer it received. product_id is taken from a search result's product_id field or a product page's URL. A product with zero questions, or a well-formed but unrecognized product_id, returns a normal, empty result rather than an error.

### `ulta_product_reviews`

Get an Ulta Beauty product's customer reviews. Returns one page of an Ulta Beauty product's customer reviews, plus the retailer's own site-wide rating summary (rating count, average rating, recommended ratio, rating histogram) for the product. product_id is taken from a search result's product_id field or a product page's URL. A product with zero reviews, or a well-formed but unrecognized product_id, returns a normal, empty result rather than an error.

### `ulta_search`

Search Ulta Beauty products. Searches Ulta Beauty's product catalog by keyword, with real page-based pagination. Returns products with brand, pricing, rating, and review count. An unrecognized/nonsense keyword returns a genuine empty result rather than a fallback set. Requesting a page beyond the available results returns a normal, empty result rather than an error.

### `ulta_stores`

Find nearby Ulta Beauty physical stores. Returns Ulta Beauty physical retail store locations near a point: name, phone, full address, hours, services, and coordinates. Either search, or both lat and lng, is required. search is a free-text zip code, city, or address that is first resolved to coordinates; if it does not resolve to any location, a well-formed empty result is returned rather than an error. lat and lng, when given directly, skip that resolution step. radius_meters is optional (1000 to 50000, defaults to 25000). A location with no stores within the radius returns a well-formed empty result rather than an error.

### `ulta_suggest`

Get Ulta Beauty search suggestions. Returns Ulta Beauty's own search-suggestion (typeahead) result for a partial search term: suggested search terms, each with its own top product matches, plus a featured top result matching what a real user sees at the top of the dropdown. A partial term with no matches returns a normal, empty result rather than an error.

### `upwork_freelancer`

Get Upwork freelancer profile. Returns an Upwork freelancer profile: name, title, verification badge, overview, hourly rate, rating and review count, Job Success Score, location and local time, total jobs/hours worked, and recent client feedback (title, comment, date, client name, rating).

### `upwork_job`

Get Upwork job posting detail. Returns an Upwork job posting: title, full description, employment type, budget (hourly range or fixed amount), location/remote type, experience level, duration, project type, proposal count, allowed applicant countries, and a summary of the posting client (member since, location, total spend, hires, hours, industry, company size).

### `upwork_search`

Search Upwork job postings. Searches Upwork's public job listings by free-text keyword, returning job summaries (title, budget, experience level, duration, posted date, description snippet, skill tags).

### `usage_endpoints`

Get current user's endpoint usage breakdown. Returns the signed-in user's usage broken down by endpoint, ordered by request volume. 'range' is 'period' (the current billing period, default), 'day', 'week', 'month' or 'custom', which takes RFC3339 'from' and 'to'. 'limit' defaults to 20 (max 100). Each item has 'requests', 'charged_requests', 'failed_requests', 'non_billable_requests', 'credits' and 'overage'. Authenticated with a dashboard JWT.

### `usage_overview`

Get current user's usage overview. Returns a JWT-authenticated user's current billing snapshot plus recent request and credit consumption metrics for the selected UTC time range. The 'requests' summary is limited to product API traffic and excludes console, billing, usage, and user-management endpoints.

### `usage_platform_adjacency`

Get cross-user platform reach and co-usage. Returns, per platform, how many real users have used it (lifetime, successful requests only), its request volume, top entry endpoints, and which other platforms those users also use. Aggregated across all customers with non-customer, static, and console traffic excluded; recomputed at most once per 24 hours and served from cache. Powers the console dashboard's "Explore more" recommendation.

### `usage_recent_ips`

Get current user's recent API client IPs. Returns recent client IP addresses observed for the JWT-authenticated user's product API traffic, ordered by last seen time. Console, billing, usage, and user-management endpoints are excluded.

### `usage_timeseries`

Get current user's usage timeseries. Returns the signed-in user's request usage as UTC time buckets for charts. 'range' is 'period' (default), 'day', 'week', 'month' or 'custom' (with RFC3339 'from' and 'to'); 'bucket' is 'hour' or 'day'; 'endpoint' filters to one endpoint such as 'google/search'. Each bucket has start, end, 'requests', 'charged_requests', 'credits' and 'overage'. Empty buckets are filled with zeros.

### `usatoday_article`

Get a USA Today article's content. Returns one normal USA Today article's public metadata and body paragraphs from a canonical article URL. Video, gallery, and other non-article routes are not supported.

### `usatoday_author`

Get a USA Today staff/author profile. Returns one USA Today staff writer's public profile: name, bio, social accounts, and their recent articles, from a canonical staff page URL.

### `usatoday_headlines`

Get USA Today section headlines. Returns the newest USA Today items for one top-level section, up to 100. 'section' is required and takes 'news', 'sports', 'entertainment', 'life', 'money', 'tech', 'travel', 'opinion', 'cars', 'shopping', 'weather', 'politics' or 'grocery'. Each item has its title, URL, published and updated times, and lead image when there is one.

### `usatoday_news`

Get fresh USA Today headlines. Returns the newest window of USA Today's public news feed: title, canonical URL, publication and update times, and the lead image when USA Today publishes one.

### `usatoday_sections`

List USA Today sections. Lists the 13 top-level USA Today sections accepted by 'usatoday-headlines', from 'news' and 'sports' to 'politics' and 'grocery'. Each has a 'slug', a display 'name' and a landing-page 'url'. Takes no parameters.

### `usmagazine_article`

Get Us Weekly article content. Returns one Us Weekly article by its canonical 'url', in the form '/<section>/news/<slug>/'. The response has the title, description, published and updated times, section, authors, lead image and the body 'paragraphs', without sub-headings or embeds. Photo-gallery URLs and non-article pages return a 400 error.

### `usmagazine_author`

Get a Us Weekly author profile. Returns a Us Weekly author's profile from their canonical 'url' ('/author/<slug>/', required): name, biography, contact links and the newest articles, about 20. Staff and desk bylines may have no biography or links. Photo galleries are skipped and 'published_at' is not set on the articles.

### `usmagazine_headlines`

Get Us Weekly section headlines. Lists recent Us Weekly headlines for one section. 'section' is required and takes 'celebrity-news', 'entertainment', 'sports', 'shopping', 'crime-news', 'stylish', 'celebrity-moms', 'celebrity-body', 'food', 'reviews', 'reality-tv' or 'royal-family'. Returns up to about 20 items, with photo galleries excluded; 'reviews' holds only a few.

### `usmagazine_news`

Get Us Weekly top stories. Returns the latest Us Weekly top stories with no parameters. Each item has its title and URL, plus summary, publication time, author and image when the outlet provides them. Only article URLs of the form '/<section>/news/<slug>/' appear; photo galleries are left out.

### `usmagazine_sections`

Get Us Weekly RSS sections. Lists the 12 Us Weekly sections accepted by 'usmagazine-headlines', from 'celebrity-news' and 'entertainment' to 'reality-tv' and 'royal-family'. Each entry has a 'slug', display 'name' and section feed 'url'. Takes no parameters.

### `usptoppubs_detail`

Fetch a document's full bibliographic data, abstract, description, and claims. Fetches a single USPTO Patent Public Search record's full text -- bibliographic data, abstract, description, and claims -- by GUID and source database. guid and source normally come straight from a prior /usptoppubs/search result's guid and database fields. Public data, sourced from USPTO's own official search tool.

### `usptoppubs_search`

Search USPTO's own patent full-text search index. Searches USPTO Patent Public Search's full-text index of granted patents and published applications, returning bibliographic results (title, applicant/assignee, inventors, filing and publication dates, application number, IPC/CPC classifications, page count). q accepts USPTO's full Advanced Search query syntax -- field-specific search (e.g. battery.ti., Microsoft.as.), date ranges (@pd>=20200101<=20241231), boolean and proximity operators, and wildcards -- see the markdown doc for the full field-code table and syntax reference.

### `vanguardng_article`

Get Vanguard article content. Returns one Vanguard (Nigeria) story by its 'url', a vanguardngr.com link in the '/YYYY/MM/<slug>/' form; section pages and feeds are rejected. The response has the title, description, times, section, authors, lead image and body 'paragraphs'. Vanguard has no paywall, so 'paywalled' is never set.

### `vanguardng_author`

Find recent Vanguard articles by byline. Vanguard publishes no author profile pages, so this returns the recent articles in one public feed (site-wide by default, or one section) credited to a byline, matched on the on-page "By <Name>" line or the site's creator field.

### `vanguardng_headlines`

Get Vanguard section headlines. Lists up to 20 recent Vanguard stories from one category. 'section' is required and takes one of 42 slugs such as 'national-news', 'politics', 'business', 'sports', 'business/energy' or 'more/metro'. Items carry title, URL, summary, author and publication time. An unknown section returns an invalid-params error.

### `vanguardng_news`

Get Vanguard top stories. Returns the latest 20 Vanguard (Nigeria) stories with no parameters. Each has a title, URL, summary, publication time and image where available. 'author' is the site's account name, often a desk account such as 'Nwafor'; use 'vanguardng-article' for the on-page byline.

### `vanguardng_sections`

Get Vanguard sections. Lists the 42 Vanguard sections accepted by 'vanguardng-headlines'. Each has a 'slug' (nested categories contain a '/', as in 'business/energy'), a display 'name' and a feed 'url'. 'national-news' is the site's News category and 'promoted' is sponsored content. Takes no parameters.

### `vanityfair_article`

Get Vanity Fair article content. Returns public Vanity Fair article metadata and body paragraphs from a canonical article URL. A story Vanity Fair marks as subscriber-only in its own page metadata is reported as a permission error instead of a partial or fabricated body.

### `vanityfair_author`

Get a Vanity Fair contributor profile. Returns a Vanity Fair contributor profile from their canonical 'url' ('www.vanityfair.com/contributor/<slug>', required). The response has the name, job title when present, biography, headshot, social links and recent articles with title, URL and publication time.

### `vanityfair_headlines`

Get Vanity Fair section headlines. Lists the current headlines for one Vanity Fair section. 'section' is required and takes 'hollywood', 'movies', 'television', 'award-season', 'what-is-cinema', 'culture', 'politics', 'business', 'style', 'beauty', 'fashion' or 'royals'. Each item has its title and URL.

### `vanityfair_news`

Get Vanity Fair top stories. Returns the latest Vanity Fair top stories and takes no parameters. Each item has its title, canonical URL, summary, author, publication time and lead image.

### `vanityfair_sections`

Get Vanity Fair sections. Returns the Vanity Fair section inventory: Hollywood (plus its Movies, Television, and Award Season sub-verticals), Arts & Culture, Politics, Business, and Style (plus its Beauty, Fashion, and Royals sub-verticals), each linking to its public listing page.

### `variety_article`

Get Variety article content. Returns one Variety article by its canonical 'variety.com' 'url', in the form '/<year>/<vertical>/<subcategory>/<slug>-<id>/'. The response has the title, description, authors, section, published and updated times, lead image, body 'paragraphs' and a 'paywalled' flag.

### `variety_author`

Get a Variety author profile. Returns a Variety author profile with name, biography, photo, social links and one page of recent articles. Give either 'slug' (such as 'ellise-shafer') or an author 'url', which may include a '/page/<n>/' segment; 'page' (default 1) overrides it. 'has_next_page' shows whether another page exists.

### `variety_headlines`

Get Variety section headlines. Lists fresh Variety headlines for one vertical. 'section' is required and takes a slug such as 'film', 'music', 'tv', 'biz', 'awards', 'gaming', 'global', 'legit' or 'vip'; 'variety-sections' lists all 24. Each item has its title and URL, plus summary, author, publication time and image when the outlet provides them.

### `variety_news`

Get Variety top stories. Returns the latest Variety top stories with no parameters. Each item has its title, URL, summary, author, publication time and image. Item URLs can be passed to 'variety-article' for the body.

### `variety_sections`

Get Variety sections. Lists the 24 Variety verticals accepted by 'variety-headlines', such as 'film', 'tv', 'music', 'biz', 'awards', 'legit' and 'voices'. Each has a 'slug', a display 'name' and a 'url'. Takes no parameters.

### `vestiaire_brands`

Vestiaire Collective's full brand directory. Returns Vestiaire Collective's full brand directory (id, name, url), not just brands with active listings for a given search -- resolves search's otherwise-opaque brand_id filter, and a search response's facets.brands, to the complete set of valid ids. Public data, sourced from Vestiaire Collective's own brand-directory page.

### `vestiaire_categories`

Vestiaire Collective category taxonomy. Returns the full Vestiaire Collective category taxonomy: universes (Women, Men, Kids) at the root, with up to three nested category levels beneath each. Every id returned here is accepted by /vestiaire/search's category_id filter.

### `vestiaire_conditions`

Vestiaire Collective condition values. Returns the fixed set of condition ids accepted by /vestiaire/search's condition_id filter, with each id's display name and current listing count.

### `vestiaire_product`

Vestiaire Collective listing detail. Returns a single Vestiaire Collective listing's public detail: price, brand, category, condition, material, color, size, seller summary, and photos. 'path' is the listing's URL or site-relative path, as returned by /vestiaire/search's 'url' field -- the numeric id alone cannot be resolved to a page. Public data, sourced from Vestiaire Collective's own listing page.

### `vestiaire_search`

Vestiaire Collective listing search. Searches Vestiaire Collective's public pre-owned luxury resale catalog by keyword, category, brand, and condition, with sort and pagination. 'sort' values: 'relevance', 'price_asc', 'price_desc', 'recency'. 'category_id' and 'condition_id' come from /vestiaire/categories and /vestiaire/conditions. 'page' * 'per_page' cannot exceed an offset of 1000 (the upstream service's own pagination limit) -- narrow the query instead of paging deeper. Public data, sourced from Vestiaire Collective's own search service.

### `vestiaire_search_sellers`

Search Vestiaire Collective sellers by name. Finds Vestiaire Collective sellers by username or first name. A matched result's id can be passed directly to GET /vestiaire/seller for that seller's full public storefront profile. Public data, sourced from Vestiaire Collective's own member-search service.

### `vestiaire_seller`

Vestiaire Collective seller profile. Returns a Vestiaire Collective seller's public storefront profile: username, country, segment, aggregate sold/listed/bought counts, and follower/following counts. 'id' is the numeric seller id, as returned by /vestiaire/search's 'seller_id' field or /vestiaire/product's 'seller.id'. Public data, sourced from Vestiaire Collective's own seller profile page.

### `vestiaire_suggest`

Vestiaire Collective search-box autocomplete. Returns Vestiaire Collective's own search-box autocomplete suggestions for a partial query: matching brands plus completed search phrases. Public data, sourced from Vestiaire Collective's own search-suggestions service.

### `vice_article`

Get VICE article content. Returns one VICE article by its canonical 'url', in the form 'www.vice.com/en/article/<slug>'. The response has the title, description, authors, section, published and updated times, lead image and body 'paragraphs', plus a 'paywalled' flag.

### `vice_author`

Get a VICE contributor profile. Returns a VICE contributor profile from their canonical 'url' ('www.vice.com/en/contributor/<slug>', required). The response has the name and headshot when present, the biography paragraphs and recent articles with title, URL, summary, author, publication time and image.

### `vice_headlines`

Get VICE section headlines. Returns fresh headlines from one VICE section, either its public RSS feed (News, Life, Tech, Music) or its public listing page for the remaining sections.

### `vice_news`

Get VICE top stories. Returns the latest VICE stories with no parameters. Each item has its title and URL, plus summary, author, publication time and lead image when the outlet provides them. Pass an item URL to 'vice-article' to read the story.

### `vice_sections`

Get VICE sections. Returns the VICE section inventory: the site's own 12 curated sections (News, Life, Tech, Music, and others), each linking to its public listing page.

### `vinted_brand`

Vinted listings for a brand. Returns Vinted listings for a specific brand, with optional price filtering and sort order. 'order' values: 'relevance', 'newest_first', 'price_high_to_low', 'price_low_to_high'. Public data, sourced from Vinted's own server-rendered brand page.

### `vinted_brands`

Vinted popular-brands directory. Returns Vinted's "Popular brands" directory. This is Vinted's own curated list, not an exhaustive list of every brand in its catalog. Each entry's 'id' is usable directly as the 'id' query parameter to /vinted/brand. Public data, sourced from Vinted's own server-rendered brands page.

### `vinted_catalog`

Vinted listing search. Returns Vinted resale listings matching a text search, with optional price filtering and sort order. 'order' values: 'relevance', 'newest_first', 'price_high_to_low', 'price_low_to_high'. Public data, sourced from Vinted's own server-rendered catalog page.

### `vinted_categories`

Vinted top-level catalog categories. Returns Vinted's top-level catalog categories (e.g. Women, Men, Kids, Home, Electronics, Sports, Entertainment, Hobbies & collectibles). This is the root level only -- Vinted's full category tree goes several levels deeper on the live site, but deeper levels aren't server-rendered so aren't covered here. Each entry's 'id' is usable directly as the 'id' query parameter to /vinted/category. Public data, sourced from Vinted's own server-rendered catalog navigation.

### `vinted_category`

Vinted listings for a category. Returns Vinted listings for a specific category, with optional price filtering and sort order. 'order' values: 'relevance', 'newest_first', 'price_high_to_low', 'price_low_to_high'. Public data, sourced from Vinted's own server-rendered category page.

### `vinted_item`

A single Vinted listing's detail. Returns a single Vinted listing's detail: title, description, brand, size, condition, material, color, price, category breadcrumb, and photos. Public data, sourced from Vinted's own server-rendered item page.

### `vinted_member`

A Vinted seller's public storefront profile. Returns a Vinted seller's public storefront profile: username, self-disclosed coarse location, rating, and follower/following counts. Deliberately excludes online-presence and activity data (last-seen timestamps, upload-frequency badges) present on the live page. Public data, sourced from Vinted's own server-rendered member page.

### `vox_article`

Get Vox article content. Returns one Vox article by its canonical 'url': title, description, authors, section, published and updated times, lead image and the body 'paragraphs'. Only public content is returned; a subscriber-only or blocked article comes back as an upstream error rather than a partial body.

### `vox_author`

Get a Vox author profile. Returns a Vox author profile from their canonical 'url' ('www.vox.com/authors/<slug>', required). The response has the name, 'job_title' from the masthead (such as Senior Politics Correspondent), 'bio' and recent articles, each with title, URL, excerpt, category and an ISO-8601 'published_at'.

### `vox_headlines`

Get Vox section headlines. Lists the current Vox headlines for one section. 'section' is required and takes 'politics', 'culture', 'policy', 'world', 'money', 'technology', 'science-and-health', 'climate', 'future-perfect' or 'explainers'. Each item has its title, URL, summary, author and publication time.

### `vox_news`

Get Vox top stories. Returns the latest Vox top stories with no parameters. Each item has its title, URL, summary, author and publication time. Item URLs can be passed to 'vox-article' for the body.

### `vox_sections`

Get Vox sections. Lists the Vox editorial sections accepted by 'vox-headlines', each with a stable 'slug', a display 'name' and the section 'url'. Use the slugs as the 'section' value. Takes no parameters.

### `vrbo_locations_search`

Suggest Vrbo destinations. Returns public destination suggestions, including region IDs and location types when Vrbo provides them. The verified search term is sent with Vrbo's observed lodging, destination, and entry-page criteria.

### `vrbo_properties_rate_calendar`

Get a Vrbo property rate calendar. Returns public calendar dates, nightly display prices when provided, availability, check-in/out validity, and stay constraints.

### `vrbo_properties_reviews`

Get Vrbo property reviews. Returns one page of public traveler reviews, aggregate count, and current sort choices. Pagination and sort values follow the public reviews query.

### `vrbo_property`

Get Vrbo property details. Reads public traveler-facing property details, grouped amenities, photos, content sections, FAQs, and aggregate rating.

### `vrbo_search`

Search Vrbo vacation rentals. Searches public Vrbo rental listings for a selected destination and dates. Obtain destination, region_id, and lat_long from Vrbo's destination suggestion UI. Supports date flexibility, per-room adult and child-age inputs, current filter selections and ranges, and observed sort values. Copy filter IDs and option values from the returned filters.

### `vrbo_travel_page_detail`

Get a Vrbo travel page. Returns public editorial sections, visible rental cards, and related travel-page links for a /travel/{slug} page. Date-scoped prices are omitted; page slugs are not search-filter values.

### `vrbo_travel_pages`

List Vrbo travel pages. Lists the public stay-type and travel-theme pages linked from Vrbo's vacation-rental index. These are editorial browse pages, not a complete search-filter enumeration.

### `walesonline_article`

Get WalesOnline article content. Returns public WalesOnline article metadata (including the section) and body paragraphs from a canonical article URL, including live blogs. Photo-gallery URLs are rejected.

### `walesonline_author`

Get a WalesOnline author profile. Returns one WalesOnline author's public profile (name, plus job title, bio, email and X/Twitter handle when the author lists them) and one page of their recent articles.

### `walesonline_headlines`

Get WalesOnline section headlines. Lists recent WalesOnline headlines for one section, up to about 25 items. 'section' is required and takes a slug such as 'news/wales-news', 'news/politics', 'sport/rugby', 'sport/football' or 'whats-on'; 'walesonline-sections' lists all 37. Photo galleries are omitted, and an invalid value returns a 400 error.

### `walesonline_news`

Get WalesOnline top stories. Returns fresh WalesOnline top stories from the public home RSS feed. Photo galleries are omitted because they have no readable article body.

### `walesonline_sections`

Get WalesOnline sections. Lists the 37 WalesOnline sections accepted by 'walesonline-headlines', with nested slugs such as 'news/wales-news', 'sport/rugby' and 'whats-on/food-drink-news'. Each has a 'slug', a display 'name' and a feed 'url'. Takes no parameters.

### `walgreens_stores`

Find nearby Walgreens stores. Returns Walgreens stores near a latitude/longitude or a zip code, nearest first: name, address, phone, hours, and in-store services (pharmacy, clinic, photo, and more) for each. Public data sourced from Walgreens' own store locator.

### `wallapop_categories`

Discover Wallapop search categories. Returns the complete live search taxonomy as a flat parent-linked list, including all descendant IDs used by /wallapop/search. Only IDs from this search taxonomy are accepted; legacy navigation-only IDs are excluded. Re-fetch periodically because the upstream taxonomy changes.

### `wallapop_filter_options`

Discover Wallapop remote filter values. Returns one page from a remote option list advertised by /wallapop/filters. Use its exact filter_id and category_id. brand/model lists use a root category ID; category-specific lists use the selected category ID. Model discovery requires brand. Multi-select options such as size map to the live search parameter fashion_size. q and sort provide listing context; options_query narrows the option list. Follow next_cursor while repeating the same context; an empty terminal page has no next_cursor. Option IDs are accepted by /wallapop/search's filter parameter.

### `wallapop_filters`

Discover Wallapop search filters. Returns Wallapop's live search filter schema for a query and optional category. Each filter includes its current type, the upstream search-enabled flag when provided, accepted parameter names, inline option values or slider bounds, and a category-scoped /wallapop/filter-options link for remote value lists.

### `wallapop_item_detail`

Fetch a public Wallapop listing detail page. Returns public listing details parsed from the anonymous server-rendered item page: description, price, taxonomy, condition, images, coarse location, shipping, category attributes, hashtags, and related-search links. Pass a clean https item URL returned by /wallapop/search, using es.wallapop.com, it.wallapop.com, or pt.wallapop.com. Seller/profile/contact data, exact coordinates, postal codes, favorites, and view-tracking state are omitted. The upstream may rate-limit or block requests; this endpoint uses the measured browser_android_native@fresh profile and retries up to three times.

### `wallapop_search`

Search Wallapop public listings. Returns one page of public Wallapop listing cards with title, price, currency, images, coarse location, taxonomy, shipping state, and a public item URL. q is a free-text search. latitude and longitude are required caller-provided coordinates because Wallapop otherwise resolves location from the request egress. category_id accepts any ID returned by /wallapop/categories, including descendants. sort is one of closest, most_relevance, newest, price_low_to_high, or price_high_to_low. When category_id is supplied, discover condition values from /wallapop/filters; categories can add values beyond the base set. Use /wallapop/filter-options for remote filter values. Pass next_cursor back as cursor by itself to fetch the next page.

### `walmart_product`

Get a Walmart product. Returns a Walmart product: price, availability, brand, images, rating, seller, description, highlights, specifications, and variants.

### `walmart_product_reviews`

Get Walmart product reviews. Returns the reviews snapshot embedded in a Walmart product page: average rating, total review count, the per-star rating breakdown, the recommended percentage, the top positive and top negative review, and a sample of recent reviews. This is a single on-page snapshot, not a full paginated feed. A product that exists but has no reviews returns zero counts and an empty reviews list.

### `walmart_search`

Search Walmart products. Returns Walmart search results: item id, title, brand, price, image, availability, seller, and rating per product.

### `wapo_article`

Get a Washington Post article's content. Returns one public Washington Post article's metadata and body paragraphs from a canonical article URL. Metered articles that the site truncates are not available.

### `wapo_author`

Get a Washington Post staff author profile. Returns one Washington Post staff author's public profile: byline metadata, bio, contact/social links, and one page of their recent articles.

### `wapo_headlines`

Get the latest stories in a Washington Post section. Returns the first page of a Washington Post section front: each story's title, canonical URL, description, section, publication time, and lead image. Section must be a path returned by /wapo/sections.

### `wapo_news`

Get the latest Washington Post stories. Returns the current Washington Post news list with no parameters. Each item has its 'title', canonical 'url', 'published_at' and 'last_modified', the last when the publisher supplies it. Items do not include summaries or authors.

### `wapo_sections`

List Washington Post sections. Lists the Washington Post sections accepted by 'wapo-headlines'. Each has a path 'slug' such as 'politics' or 'business/technology', a display 'name' and a landing-page 'url'. Use it to find valid 'section' values. Takes no parameters.

### `wattpad_categories`

List Wattpad story categories. Returns Wattpad's story categories (Romance, Fantasy, Fanfiction, Werewolf, ...) with id, name and English name. These ids are the values the category parameter of wattpad-search takes and the values in every story's category_ids. The list is read live from Wattpad.

### `wattpad_languages`

List Wattpad story languages. Returns the story languages Wattpad's search can filter by, each with its numeric id and native-script name (50 at the time of writing). These ids are the values the language parameter of wattpad-search takes.

### `wattpad_part`

Get a Wattpad chapter. Returns one Wattpad chapter's metadata: id, title, link, word count, reads, votes, comments, length, dates and the story it belongs to (id and title). part_id is the numeric chapter id from wattpad-story-parts. A chapter that does not exist returns not found. Chapter text is never returned.

### `wattpad_part_comments`

List reader comments on a Wattpad chapter. Returns one page of the public reader comments on a Wattpad chapter, newest first: id, text, commenter username and avatar, reply count, whether it is a reply, parent id, link and creation time. part_id is the numeric chapter id from wattpad-story-parts. limit is 1 to 100 (default 20) and offset pages the list; next_offset is absent on the last page. A chapter with no comments, or an unknown chapter, returns an empty list.

### `wattpad_search`

Search and browse Wattpad stories. Searches Wattpad's story catalog by text or browses it by ranking, category and language, and returns one page of stories: id, title, description, cover, link, author, votes, reads, comments, chapter count, completed and mature flags, language, category ids, tags and dates. Give at least one of query, filter, category or language. filter is hot, new or featured; category is an id from wattpad-categories; language is an id from wattpad-languages. limit is 1 to 100 (default 20) and offset pages the results: a text search reaches offset 9999, while browsing without a query is capped at 1500 results. Browse pages can hold fewer stories than limit (or none) because Wattpad filters after paging, so advance with next_offset rather than the item count.

### `wattpad_search_users`

Search Wattpad authors by name. Searches Wattpad's authors by username or name and returns one page: username, display name, bio, avatar, verified flag, published story count and follower count. limit is 1 to 100 (default 20) and offset pages the results. Authors with a private profile or who have opted out of crawling are left out, so a page can hold fewer authors than limit; advance with next_offset.

### `wattpad_story`

Get a Wattpad story. Returns one Wattpad story's public details: title, description, cover, link, author, votes, reads, comments, chapter count, completed and mature flags, language, category ids, tags, first chapter id, last published date, rating and copyright codes, paywall flag and dates. story_id is the numeric id from the story's wattpad.com link; the full link is also accepted. A story that does not exist returns not found. Chapter text is never returned.

### `wattpad_story_parts`

List a Wattpad story's chapters. Returns a Wattpad story's chapter list, in reading order: id, title, link, word count, reads, votes, comments, length, and created and modified dates for every chapter. The per-chapter reads show where readers drop off. Use it to see how a story is paced and which chapters readers react to. story_id is the numeric story id, or its wattpad.com link. Chapter text is never returned.

### `wattpad_story_recommendations`

List stories Wattpad recommends for a story. Returns the stories Wattpad recommends alongside one story (readers of this also read these), with the same fields as wattpad-search: id, title, description, cover, link, author, votes, reads, comments, chapter count, completed and mature flags, language, category ids, tags and dates. story_id is the numeric story id or its wattpad.com link. Wattpad returns at most 18 recommendations and does not page; limit is 1 to 20.

### `wattpad_user`

Get a Wattpad author profile. Returns a Wattpad author's public profile: username, display name, bio, avatar, location, website, verified and ambassador flags, follower and following counts, votes received, published story count, reading list count and join date. username is the name from the author's wattpad.com/user/ link, case-insensitive. Authors with a private profile or who have opted out of crawling are not returned. An unknown author returns not found.

### `wattpad_user_stories`

List a Wattpad author's stories. Returns one page of the stories a Wattpad author has published, with the same fields as wattpad-search: id, title, description, cover, link, votes, reads, comments, chapter count, completed and mature flags, language, category ids, tags and dates. username is the name from the author's wattpad.com/user/ link. limit is 1 to 100 (default 20) and offset pages the list; next_offset is absent on the last page. Authors with a private profile or who have opted out of crawling are not returned. This call reads the author's access settings first, so it costs two requests.

### `wayfair_categories`

List Wayfair categories. Returns a page of Wayfair categories discovered from Wayfair's own published sitemap, closing the discovery gap where a category id otherwise has to be found elsewhere. Pair a returned id with GET /wayfair/category to browse that category's product grid. name is derived from the category's own URL slug (title-cased), not an authoritative site-provided label. q, if set, case-insensitively filters to categories whose derived name or department contains it.

### `wayfair_category`

Browse a Wayfair category. Returns a Wayfair category page's product grid, with real page-based pagination. category accepts a bare Wayfair category id ("478390"), a "c"-prefixed id ("c478390"), a category slug ("office-chairs-c478390"), or a full category URL copied from wayfair.com. Returns products with name, brand, pricing, and image.

### `wayfair_product`

Get a Wayfair product's full detail. Returns one Wayfair product's full detail: name, brand, price, stock status, aggregate rating with a 1-5 star breakdown, images, every selectable variant option (e.g. color, finish), and site-selected feature highlights. id is the product's own "W"-prefixed id (e.g. W100794312), taken from a category result's product_id field or a product page's URL. An unrecognized id returns 404.

### `wccftech_article`

Get a Wccftech article. Returns one Wccftech article by its canonical 'url' on 'wccftech.com' or 'www.wccftech.com', covering news, reviews, how-tos, roundups and best-of pages. The response has the title, description, authors, section, times, lead image and body 'paragraphs' where the site serves them, plus a 'paywalled' flag.

### `wccftech_author`
